paras.en: Flávio Bolsonaro, the right-wing candidate for president and a strong advocate of environmental deregulation, has backed policies that scientists say could hurt the Amazon rainforest. We mapped how deforestation of the Amazon has changed in Brazil depending on who is in power.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）是右翼总统候选人，也是环境放松管制的坚定倡导者，他支持科学家认为可能损害亚马逊雨林的政策。我们绘制了巴西亚马逊森林砍伐的变化图，具体取决于谁掌权。

paras.en: Deforestation of the Amazon surged under President Jair Bolsonaro, then dropped to the lowest level on record under Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. But a win by Mr. Bolsonaro’s son could reverse that. He has promised to make it easier for miners and ranchers to clear trees. And his supporters have warned Indigenous groups that they plan to invade their lands if he wins.
paras.zh: 在总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗（ Jair Bolsonaro ）的领导下，亚马逊森林砍伐飙升，然后降至路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula d但博尔索纳罗的儿子获胜可能会扭转这一局面。他承诺让矿工和牧场主更容易清理树木。他的支持者警告土著群体，如果他获胜，他们计划入侵他们的土地。

paras.en: In the run-up to Sunday’s election, the leftist president of Brazil and independent watchdog groups accused Meta and its social media platforms of giving the leader’s right-wing rival favorable treatment.
paras.zh: 在周日大选前夕，巴西左翼总统和独立监督组织指责Meta及其社交媒体平台给予该领导人的右翼对手优惠待遇。

paras.en: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and groups monitoring social media charged that search results omitted progressive activists, that videos critical of his right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro were taken down without explanation and that posts favoring Mr. Lula reached fewer people.
paras.zh: 总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）和监控社交媒体的团体指控称，搜索结果忽略了进步活动人士，批评其右翼挑战者弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）的视频在没有任何解释的情况下被删除，支持卢拉先生的帖子

paras.en: Mr. Lula’s campaign, which was trying shore up his position before the runoff against Mr. Bolsonaro, filed a complaint with the nation’s electoral court on Oct. 10, demanding fair treatment online.
paras.zh: 卢拉的竞选活动在针对博尔索纳罗的第二轮选举之前试图巩固自己的地位，于10月10日向该国选举法院提起诉讼，要求在网上获得公平待遇。

paras.en: “The scenario is,” the complaint said, “that of a platform illegally practicing algorithmic selectivity, in the midst of a fierce presidential contest.’’
paras.zh: “情况是，”投诉说， “一个平台在激烈的总统竞选中非法实行算法选择性。”

paras.en: Meta has firmly rejected claims of political bias, asserting firmly in a response to the court that it “does not operate its systems to harm or favor candidacies.”
paras.zh: Meta坚决驳回了政治偏见的主张，在回应法院时坚定地声称，它“不会运用其系统来伤害或偏袒候选人”。

paras.en: But in Brazil, where social media and disinformation have played a central role in recent elections, fears that online debate could again sway a narrow presidential race have touched a nerve.
paras.zh: 但在巴西，社交媒体和虚假信息在最近的选举中发挥了核心作用，人们担心在线辩论可能会再次影响狭隘的总统竞选，这触动了人们的神经。

paras.en: Videos made with artificial intelligence, ranging from the amusing to deceitful, have flooded the Brazilian internet ahead of Sunday’s high-stakes presidential election.
paras.zh: 在周日高风险的总统选举之前，用人工智能制作的视频，从有趣到欺骗，已经淹没了巴西的互联网。

paras.en: The use of A.I. to craft messages has turned Brazil, Latin America’s largest democracy, into a laboratory of sorts for how the technology can be used in elections. There are parallels in the United States and other nations grappling with A.I.’s political effects.
paras.zh: 使用人工智能来制作信息已将拉丁美洲最大的民主国家巴西变成了如何在选举中使用该技术的实验室。美国和其他国家在应对人工智能的政治影响方面存在相似之处。

paras.en: In Brazil, a nation of 214 million, disinformation has defined elections for nearly a decade. The country has some of the world’s strictest regulations against spreading falsehoods during elections.
paras.zh: 在巴西这个拥有2.14亿人口的国家，虚假信息已经定义了近十年的选举。该国有一些世界上最严格的规定，禁止在选举期间传播虚假信息。

paras.en: But the deluge of A.I. — made by candidates, strategists and ordinary citizens — has become a stark test of the nation’s capacity to police online content, posing a new challenge for the Brazilian authorities trying to protect the integrity of the vote.
paras.zh: 但是，由候选人、战略家和普通公民制造的人工智能的泛滥已经成为对国家监管在线内容能力的严峻考验，对试图保护投票完整性的巴西当局构成了新的挑战。

paras.en: “We made the rules, now we’re watching to see what happens,” said Kássio Nunes Marques, chief justice of Brazil’s electoral court, which oversees the vote.
paras.zh: “我们制定了规则，现在我们正在观察会发生什么，”负责监督投票的巴西选举法院首席大法官卡西奥·努内斯·马克斯（ Kássio Nunes Marques ）说。

paras.en: Depending on whom you ask, Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes is either a hero who protected Brazil’s democracy, or a villain who used authoritarian measures to target the far right.
paras.zh: 根据您的要求，最高法院法官亚历山大·德莫赖斯（ Alexandre de Moraes ）要么是保护巴西民主的英雄，要么是使用专制措施瞄准极右翼的恶棍。

paras.en: In a series of polarizing decisions, Justice Moraes cracked down on online falsehoods, punished rioters who falsely claimed the last election had been stolen and sentenced the former president, Jair Bolsonaro, on charges of trying to retain power after he lost the last election.
paras.zh: 在一系列两极分化的决定中，莫赖斯法官打击了在线谎言，惩罚了那些错误地声称上次选举被盗的暴徒，并判处前总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗（ Jair Bolsonaro ）在上次选举失败后试图保住权力。

paras.en: But earlier this year, the justice’s reputation was shattered when he was publicly linked to a banker accused of fraud. According to a leaked police dossier, Justice Moraes had exchanged text messages with the banker, who was seeking help in avoiding arrest and mentioned paying millions to a law firm run by the justice’s wife. The police have never said if Justice Moraes responded to the request or helped the banker in some way.
paras.zh: 但今年早些时候，当他与一名被指控欺诈的银行家公开联系时，法官的声誉被打破了。根据泄露的警方档案，莫赖斯法官与这位银行家交换了短信，这位银行家正在寻求帮助以避免被捕，并提到向这位法官的妻子经营的一家律师事务所支付了数百万美元。警方从未说过Moraes法官是否回应了这一请求或以某种方式帮助了银行家。

paras.en: Still, the revelation has become a major issue in the presidential election being decided on Sunday.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这一启示已经成为周日总统选举中的一个主要问题。

paras.en: For starters, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, a leftist, was saddled with the fallout of the scandal at the Supreme Court that tarnished Justice Moraes, his ally.
paras.zh: 首先，左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）背负着最高法院丑闻的后果，该丑闻玷污了他的盟友莫赖斯法官。

paras.en: But the scandal has also galvanized many right-leaning voters in their support for Jair Bolsonaro’s son, Flávio, who is challenging Mr. Lula for the presidency. Mr. Bolsonaro used the scandal to whip up support in his stump speeches.
paras.zh: 但这一丑闻也激励了许多右倾选民支持贾尔·博尔索纳罗(Jair Bolsonaro)的儿子弗拉维奥(Flávio) ，后者正在挑战卢拉竞选总统。博尔索纳罗利用这一丑闻在他的树桩演讲中赢得了支持。

paras.en: “To vote for Lula is to vote for Alexandre de Moraes,” Mr. Bolsonaro recently told a crowd of supporters. “And I’m not going to let that happen.”
paras.zh: “投票给卢拉就是投票给亚历山大·德莫赖斯，”博尔索纳罗最近告诉一群支持者。“我不会让这种情况发生。”

paras.en: “It gave Flávio’s campaign a simple slogan,” said Luciano da Ros, a Brazilian political scientist. “And it united different segments on the right around a powerful common enemy.”
paras.zh: 巴西政治学家卢西亚诺·达罗斯（ Luciano da Ros ）说： “这给了弗拉维奥的竞选活动一个简单的口号。“它将右翼的不同派别团结在一个强大的共同敌人周围。”

paras.en: Mr. Lula, eager to shield his campaign, has tried to distance himself from Justice Moraes. “Nobody is above the law,” he said in an interview. He urged an investigation into the justice’s conduct and a broad judicial overhaul.

A number of right-wing leaders have recently swept into power in Latin America, riding a wave of dissatisfaction with incumbent governments and deepening worries about security and a rising cost of living.

Until now, Brazil, the region’s largest nation, had been the exception. The left-wing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, began his third nonconsecutive term in 2023. His predecessor and rival, Jair Bolsonaro, had been convicted of trying to stage a coup to prevent Mr. Lula from taking office and was sentenced to 27 years, which he is currently serving under house arrest for health reasons.

Now Mr. Lula, weighed down by widespread perceptions of rising crime and economic woes, faces a challenge from the former president’s son, Flávio Bolsonaro, a right-wing senator. Mr. Bolsonaro’s formidable performance in the first voting round this month gave him the edge going into a two-way contest.
The outcome will have a profound effect on Brazil and its relations with the United States in particular. Here are some of the major issues at stake.
Mr. Bolsonaro has already said he would add Brazil to the Trump administration’s anti-cartel coalition, called the Shield of the Americas, and work with the United States to fight Brazilian gangs.

He suggested in social media posts last year that he would welcome U.S. military intervention in Brazil, though he denied that in recent interviews, saying the cooperation would be limited to intelligence. But it was Mr. Bolsonaro who successfully lobbied Mr. Trump to designate two Brazilian gangs as terrorist groups.
Mr. Lula has resisted joining the coalition, warning that intertwining too closely with the United States on security matters could threaten the nation’s sovereignty.

The Trump administration imposed tariffs on Brazilian products in an unsuccessful pressure campaign to disrupt the prosecution of Jair Bolsonaro. Many of those tariffs were eventually scaled back, and Brazil’s economy has remained largely unharmed by President Trump’s tariff campaign.

Another term for Mr. Lula, however, would increase the risk of more economic conflicts with the United States that might hurt the Brazilian economy. Of course, Mr. Bolsonaro would not be immune to those problems; Mr. Trump has been known to levy tariffs against allies as well as adversaries.

The Trump administration has signaled an interest in importing Brazilian oil to counter disruptions related to the Iran war and the country’s rare-earth minerals to reduce U.S. dependence on China for those resources. Mr. Bolsonaro is expected to align Brazil more closely with the United States than Mr. Lula has on trade issues, but neither leader can afford to anger China, a major trading partner.
The election could also affect Brazil’s ability to negotiate trade with the United States as a bloc with other countries in the region.

“Brazil’s relations with its neighbors have been extremely challenging,” said Carolina Moehlecke, an assistant professor of international relations at Getúlio Vargas Foundation, a research institution. This was especially true of its neighbor, Argentina, she added, whose right-wing president is a close ally of Mr. Trump. Mr. Bolsonaro, she said, might have an easier time cooperating with fellow right-wing leaders in Latin America.

If Mr. Bolsonaro carries the vote, conservationists fear a return to his father’s policies of allowing rapid deforestation in the Amazon rainforest, a trend that was largely reversed under President Lula. The younger Mr. Bolsonaro does not believe that climate change is caused by humans and has defended opening up protected lands to mining and farming.

He has also pledged to stem the nation’s rising debt. If he attempts to accomplish that through cuts to public spending, that could prove politically sensitive, Ms. Moehlecke said, especially when it comes to social welfare policies with broad popularity in Brazil. In the lead-up to Sunday’s elections, Mr. Lula had promised to increase welfare payments.

Mr. Lula has framed the election as a test of the nation’s democracy and portrays the Bolsonaros as a threat to democratic institutions. Ms. Moehlecke said it was likely Mr. Bolsonaro would take the country in a more authoritarian direction, though his rhetoric is generally tamer than his father’s.

But if Mr. Bolsonaro wins, his party’s gains in the legislature could allow him to deliver on some of his most polarizing promises: amnesty for his father, pardons for rioters who stormed Brazil’s halls of power after the last election, and a Senate more willing to try to remove justices who convicted his father.

If Mr. Lula wins, he most likely will face significant checks against his power. Right-wing candidates, including four other members of the Bolsonaro family, have made significant strides in the nation’s legislative races.

articles.title: The presidential election in Brazil is a test of Trump’s power as a kingmaker.
articles.author: Ana Ionova and Adam B. Ellick

paras.en: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva of Brazil surged to a remarkable re-election on Sunday, according to official preliminary results, but his opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, said he would not accept the results after a chaotic Election Day.
paras.zh: 根据官方初步结果，巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦周日顺利连任，但他的对手弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗表示，在混乱的选举日之后，他不会接受选举结果。

paras.en: Mr. Lula’s victory, which ended a string of conservative wins in Latin America cheered on by President Trump, came after a judge ordered polls to remain open an additional two hours — a move requested by both campaigns after transportation delays and bad weather disrupted voting. At a news conference, Mr. Bolsonaro called for the election to be annulled, saying the decision to keep the polls open “changed the rules in the middle of the game.”
paras.zh: 卢拉的胜利结束了特朗普总统欢呼的拉丁美洲保守派的一系列胜利，此前一名法官下令民意调查再开放两个小时——在交通延误和恶劣天气扰乱投票后，双方竞选团队都要求采取这一举措。在新闻发布会上，博尔索纳罗呼吁取消选举，称保持投票开放的决定“改变了游戏中的规则”。

paras.en: “There’s a lot that needs to be cleared up before Brazil simply accepts this foul play that took place in these elections,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “在巴西简单地接受这些选举中发生的犯规之前，还有很多事情需要清理。”

paras.en: Mr. Lula received 51.8 percent of the vote, versus 48.2 percent for Flávio Bolsonaro, with 99.9 percent of the ballots counted, according to official preliminary results.
paras.zh: 根据官方初步结果，卢拉获得了51.8%的选票，而弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗获得了48.2%的选票， 99.9%的选票被计算在内。

paras.en: The leftist’s margin of victory was wider than four years ago, and was predicted by few pollsters. Even more stunning was that he achieved the comeback after placing second in the first round of voting earlier this month, a first in Brazilian history.
paras.zh: 左翼的胜利优势比四年前更大，并且很少有民意调查机构预测到这一点。更令人惊叹的是，他在本月早些时候的第一轮投票中获得第二名后实现了复出，这在巴西历史上尚属首次。

paras.en: “I would like to thank the Brazilian people for the generosity they have shown me for a long time,” Mr. Lula said in a victory speech in São Paulo.
paras.zh: “我要感谢巴西人民长期以来对我的慷慨，”卢拉在圣保罗的胜利演讲中说道。

paras.en: Mr. Lula, 80, had framed his candidacy as a vote for democracy and the only way to bar the return of the Bolsonaro family to power. He has frequently and defiantly clashed with Mr. Trump, who attempted to use tariffs and sanctions to keep Mr. Bolsonaro’s father, Jair, out of prison for his attempted coup four years ago.
paras.zh: 80 岁的卢拉将自己的候选资格视为对民主的投票，也是阻止博尔索纳罗家族重新掌权的唯一途径。他经常与特朗普发生挑衅性冲突，特朗普试图利用关税和制裁来让博尔索纳罗的父亲贾尔因四年前的未遂政变而免于入狱。

paras.en: Mr. Lula’s victory snapped a string of seven straight wins by right-wing leaders in the region over the last 18 months, and suggested that Latin America’s left-wing forces still wield some influence despite the losses.
paras.zh: 卢拉的胜利结束了过去 18 个月该地区右翼领导人的七连胜，这表明拉丁美洲的左翼势力尽管遭受了损失，但仍然发挥着一定的影响力。

paras.en: On Paulista Avenue, a main drag in São Paulo, fireworks crackled, horns blared and supporters cried in disbelief. Vendors sold popcorn and beer, with their stands plastered with Lula stickers.
paras.zh: 在圣保罗的主要阻力保利斯塔大道上，烟花爆裂，喇叭响起，支持者难以置信地哭泣。小贩们出售爆米花和啤酒，他们的摊位上贴着卢拉贴纸。

paras.en: The candidates offered starkly different visions on issues that included fighting organized crime and revitalizing a sluggish economy. The outcome could reshape Brazil’s trajectory on many divisive issues for years to come because the next president will have the right to fill four open seats on the country’s powerful Supreme Court, which has 11 seats in total.
paras.zh: 两位候选人在打击有组织犯罪和振兴疲软经济等问题上提出了截然不同的愿景。这一结果可能会重塑巴西未来几年在许多有争议问题上的发展轨迹，因为下一任总统将有权填补该国强大的最高法院的四个空缺席位，该法院共有 11 个席位。

paras.en: - Extra two hours: Both candidates asked for polls to be kept open. Mr. Bolsonaro said that flooding in a part of the country where he held electoral advantages would unfairly hurt him, while Mr. Lula accused public officials of purposefully slowing down public transportation in areas where he won in an earlier round of voting.
paras.zh: - 额外两个小时：两位候选人都要求投票保持开放。博尔索纳罗表示，他拥有选举优势的地区发生洪水会对他造成不公平的伤害，而卢拉则指责公职人员故意减慢他在上一轮投票中获胜地区的公共交通速度。

paras.en: - The Bolsonaros: Looming over the contest was an epic political struggle that has roiled and defined Brazilian politics for more than a decade. Mr. Bolsonaro ran in lieu of his father, who could not stand for office because he was convicted of attempting a coup against Mr. Lula after losing the last election in 2022. He was sentenced to 27 years in prison and is serving his time at home because of health reasons.
paras.zh: - Bolsonaros ：笼罩着这场比赛是一场史诗般的政治斗争，十多年来一直困扰着并定义着巴西政治。博尔索纳罗先生代替他的父亲竞选，他的父亲无法参选，因为他在2022年的上一次选举中失败后被判犯有企图对卢拉先生发动政变的罪名。他被判处27年监禁，并因健康原因在家服刑。

paras.en: Flávio Bolsonaro’s Liberal Party has two possible paths to challenge the result, said Raquel Machado, a professor at the Federal University of Ceará. It could seek a technical audit to determine whether unequal voting conditions affected the outcome, potentially leading to the election’s annulment. Or it could pursue an abuse-of-power case through the Superior Electoral Court’s inspector general, which could disqualify the Lula-Alckmin ticket even after it takes office.
paras.zh: 塞阿拉联邦大学教授拉奎尔·马查多（ Raquel Machado ）说，弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）的自由党有两条可能的途径来挑战这一结果。它可以寻求技术审计，以确定不平等的投票条件是否影响了选举结果，从而可能导致选举被废除。或者，它可以通过高等选举法院的监察长追究滥用权力的案件，即使在卢拉-阿尔克明就职后也可能取消其资格。

paras.en: But Professor Machado noted that many polling stations had already closed when the Supreme Court’s order was made public, and she said that there had been no significant influx of voters after 5 p.m. local time.
paras.zh: 但马查多教授指出，最高法院的命令公布时，许多投票站已经关闭，她表示下午 5 点之后并没有出现大量选民涌入。当地时间。

paras.en: Lula’s Workers’ Party could bring its own challenge over restrictions on public bus services on Election Day. If those restrictions were found to be an abuse of power, Flávio, his running mate and others involved could be barred from running for office for eight years.
paras.zh: 卢拉的工人党可能会对选举日公共巴士服务的限制提出自己的挑战。如果这些限制被发现滥用权力，弗拉维奥、他的竞选搭档和其他相关人员可能会被禁止八年内竞选公职。

paras.en: President Trump has not yet weighed in on Lula’s victory, but President Claudia Sheinbaum of Mexico and Prime Minister Mark Carney of Canada have congratulated him in social media posts. “Long live democracy, the people of Brazil won,” Sheinbaum wrote.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统尚未对卢拉的胜利发表评论，但墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·辛鲍姆和加拿大总理马克·卡尼在社交媒体上发帖祝贺他。 “民主万岁，巴西人民获胜，”希因鲍姆写道。

paras.en: Sheinbaum, a fellow leftist, has generally been more cautious than Lulu about publicly antagonizing Washington. But she is still a key ally for him in Latin America, where right-wing governments have dominated elections over the past year and a half.
paras.zh: 谢因鲍姆是一位左翼人士，在公开对抗华盛顿方面总体上比露露更加谨慎。但她仍然是他在拉丁美洲的重要盟友，过去一年半里右翼政府在拉丁美洲的选举中占据主导地位。

paras.en: I covered the chaos following Brazil’s election in 2022, when then-President Jair Bolsonaro claimed fraud. Now his son Flávio is contesting tonight’s results, but we are not yet seeing major street protests, as we did by this time four years ago.
paras.zh: 我报道了2022年巴西大选后的混乱局面，当时的总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗（ Jair Bolsonaro ）声称存在欺诈行为。现在，他的儿子弗拉维奥正在争夺今晚的结果，但我们还没有看到像四年前这个时候那样的大型街头抗议活动。

paras.en: I see signs that Flávio Bolsonaro might not get as much traction as his father did. He is not as popular, for starters, and he doesn’t control the government or the armed forces. He also did not spend months undermining the integrity of Brazil’s voting systems, as his father did.
paras.zh: 我看到迹象表明弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗可能不会像他的父亲那样受到那么多关注。首先，他并不那么受欢迎，而且他不控制政府或武装部队。他也没有像他父亲那样花几个月的时间破坏巴西投票系统的完整性。

paras.en: Also, the margin of victory – 4.4 million votes, according to official preliminary results, versus 2.1 million in 2022 – is much larger this time. And while Jair Bolsonaro’s fraud claims were broad, his son’s supporters mostly seem to be focusing tonight on the narrow fact that a Supreme Court justice ordered the polls open for two extra hours, a delay that both Flavio and Lula had requested.
paras.zh: 此外，根据官方初步结果，这次的胜利幅度（ 440万张选票，而2022年为210万张）要大得多。虽然Jair Bolsonaro的欺诈指控很广泛，但他儿子的支持者今晚似乎主要关注这样一个狭隘的事实，即最高法院大法官下令投票站额外开放两个小时，这是Flavio和Lula都要求的延迟。

paras.en: Supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro gathered outside the National Museum in the capital, Brasília. One of them, Valéria Maria de Melo, 49, cried upon learning of Lula’s victory. “We know we were robbed,” she said, wearing a T-shirt plastered with Bolsonaro stickers.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗的支持者聚集在首都巴西利亚国家博物馆外。其中一位 49 岁的瓦莱丽娅·玛丽亚·德梅洛 (Valéria Maria de Melo) 在得知卢拉获胜的消息后哭了。 “我们知道我们被抢劫了，”她穿着一件贴有博尔索纳罗贴纸的 T 恤说道。

paras.en: Around midnight, President Lula arrived on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo. The scene feels part carnival, part music festival. It’s nearly impossible to walk: I’ve spent the last 15 minutes moving about 10 steps. People have climbed atop subway station entrances. I see people of all ages and races, from babies to people in their 80s. There are monks. Strangers are dancing and hugging one another. The crowd is chanting, “No amnesty!” in reference to Bolsonaro’s pledge to seek amnesty for his father, Jair Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 午夜时分，卢拉总统抵达圣保罗保利斯塔大道。这个场景感觉一半是嘉年华，一半是音乐节。走路几乎是不可能的：过去 15 分钟我走了大约 10 步。人们爬上地铁站入口处。我见过各种年龄和种族的人，从婴儿到 80 多岁的老人。有僧人。陌生人跳舞、互相拥抱。人群高呼“不特赦！”提及博尔索纳罗承诺为其父亲贾尔·博尔索纳罗寻求特赦。

paras.en: Bolsonaro’s party will now have to petition electoral authorities for a review of the result. Since Brazil’s return to democracy, no presidential election has been annulled. In 2014, the losing party requested an audit, but the review found no evidence of fraud, and the results were upheld.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的政党现在将不得不向选举当局请愿，要求对结果进行审查。自巴西恢复民主以来，没有任何总统选举被废除。2014年，败诉方要求进行审计，但审查未发现欺诈证据，结果维持不变。

paras.en: In 2022, Bolsonaro’s Liberal Party similarly challenged his father’s election loss, but the court fined the party 22 million reais for failing to provide evidence to support its allegations.
paras.zh: 2022年，博尔索纳罗的自由党同样对父亲的选举失败提出质疑，但法院因该党未能提供证据支持其指控而对其处以2200万雷亚尔的罚款。

paras.en: Leaders across Latin America have congratulated Lula on his victory, including right-wing presidents in Chile, Paraguay and Peru. But the United States has remained notably silent.
paras.zh: 拉丁美洲各国领导人对卢拉的胜利表示祝贺，包括智利、巴拉圭和秘鲁的右翼总统。但美国一直保持着明显的沉默。

paras.en: Many Brazilians, as well as members of the Lula administration, had feared that Washington would try to interfere in the election. Brazilian sovereignty even became a rallying cry during Lula’s campaign. But Trump never explicitly endorsed a candidate.
paras.zh: 许多巴西人以及卢拉政府成员都担心华盛顿会试图干涉选举。巴西主权甚至成为卢拉竞选期间的口号。但特朗普从未明确支持候选人。

paras.en: On Sunday night, right-wing figures in the United States, including Donald Trump Jr., began casting doubt on the elections results.
paras.zh: 周日晚上，包括小唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump Jr. ）在内的美国右翼人士开始对选举结果表示怀疑。

paras.en: Digging into tonight’s numbers, Lula’s comeback is remarkable. After finishing behind in the first round, few pollsters expected him to turn things around. Most assumed that voters whose preferred candidates had been eliminated would break for Flávio Bolsonaro in Sunday’s runoff. But that’s not what happened.
paras.zh: 深入挖掘今晚的数据，卢拉的卷土重来令人瞩目。在第一轮落后之后，很少有民意测验专家指望他能扭转局面。大多数人认为，首选候选人被淘汰的选民将在周日的决选中支持弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）。但事实并非如此。

paras.en: There were about 14 million additional votes up for grabs in the runoff, including those of new voters, supporters of eliminated candidates and people who had cast blank or invalid ballots in the first round.
paras.zh: 在第二轮投票中，还有大约1400万张选票可供争夺，其中包括新选民、被淘汰候选人的支持者以及在第一轮投票中投出空白或无效选票的人。

paras.en: Lula captured three out of every four of those votes, a stunning turnaround. He gained 10.4 million votes between the first and second rounds, compared with just 3.7 million for Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 卢拉获得了四分之三的选票，这是一个惊人的转变。他在第一轮和第二轮投票中获得了1040万张选票，而博尔索纳罗仅获得370万张选票。

paras.en: Flávio Bolsonaro also accused a Supreme Court justice who previously served as Lula’s lawyer of having “changed the rules in the middle of the game” by extending voting hours. “What happened today was not normal and it was even unacceptable,” he said.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）还指责曾担任卢拉律师的最高法院法官通过延长投票时间“在比赛中改变了规则”。“今天发生的事情是不正常的，甚至是不可接受的，”他说。

paras.en: In a news conference, Flávio Bolsonaro refused to recognize Lula’s victory and said he would seek to have the election annulled. He described the court’s decision to extend the voting as a “dirty trick.”
paras.zh: 在新闻发布会上，弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）拒绝承认卢拉的胜利，并表示他将寻求取消选举。他将法院延长投票的决定描述为“肮脏的伎俩”。

paras.en: “There’s a lot that needs to be cleared up before Brazil simply accepts this foul play that took place in these elections,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “在巴西简单地接受这些选举中发生的犯规之前，还有很多事情需要清理。”

paras.en: Lula, speaking at a hotel surrounded by his wife, his running mate and his political allies, looked relatively calm. He said the outpouring of rallies in the last week “was a demonstration that this country refuses to be anyone’s backyard.” That appeared to be a reference to the United States, which has been trying to exert new levels of control over Latin America through tariffs, sanctions, election interventions and other means.
paras.zh: 卢拉在一家被妻子、竞选伙伴和政治盟友包围的酒店讲话时，看起来相对平静。他说，上周的大量集会“表明这个国家拒绝成为任何人的后院。“这似乎是指美国一直试图通过关税、制裁、选举干预和其他手段对拉丁美洲施加新水平的控制。

paras.en: On Paulista Avenue, one of São Paulo’s main thoroughfares, a massive, spontaneous celebration continues to grow. Fireworks began erupting even before the election was called, and they are still crackling overhead. Horns are blaring, adding to the deafening noise. Supporters are crying in disbelief. Vendors are selling popcorn and beer from stands plastered with Lula stickers.
paras.zh: 在圣保罗的主要街道之一保利斯塔大道上，一场大规模的自发庆祝活动不断发展。甚至在选举之前就开始爆发烟花，它们仍然在头顶上啪啪作响。喇叭响起，加剧了震耳欲聋的噪音。支持者难以置信地哭泣。摊贩们正在出售印有卢拉贴纸的摊位上的爆米花和啤酒。

paras.en: “I would like to thank the Brazilian people for the generosity they have shown me for a long time,” said Lula in a victory speech in São Paulo. “And, in this second round, I want to thank the generosity of the Brazilian youth, who took to the streets to defend democracy.”
paras.zh: 卢拉在圣保罗的胜利演讲中说： “我要感谢巴西人民长期以来对我的慷慨。” “在第二轮中，我要感谢巴西青年的慷慨，他们走上街头捍卫民主。”

paras.en: Numerous poll workers nationwide said they received confusing and sometimes contradictory orders from electoral authorities. At a polling site in central São Paulo, one election worker said that by 5 p.m. local time, she and her colleagues heard that the Supreme Court had ordered polling sites to remain open two more hours. However, local authorities ordered them to shut down. The worker, who gave her name only as Bárbara because she feared repercussions, said they eventually got orders to reopen by 6 p.m., but it was too late for many voters.

paras.en: Lula is re-elected, according to official preliminary results from Brazil’s top electoral court.
paras.zh: 根据巴西最高选举法院的官方初步结果，卢拉再次当选。

paras.en: Since taking office, President Trump has become something of an electoral kingmaker in Latin America. Right-wing candidates aligned with Washington have won the past seven elections in the region, with Mr. Trump explicitly endorsing the winner in two of them.
paras.zh: 自上任以来，特朗普总统已成为拉丁美洲的选举国王。与华盛顿结盟的右翼候选人赢得了该地区过去七次选举，特朗普在其中两次选举中明确支持获胜者。

paras.en: Now comes the biggest regional test for the right and for Mr. Trump’s recent record of success: Brazil.
paras.zh: 现在是对右翼和特朗普最近成功记录的最大地区考验：巴西。

paras.en: As Brazilians headed to the polls on Sunday, the question looming over Latin America’s largest democracy was whether Mr. Trump would have an influence.
paras.zh: 随着巴西人周日前往投票站，围绕拉丁美洲最大民主国家的问题是特朗普是否会有影响力。

paras.en: He has not openly championed either Brazilian candidate. But the Trump administration did try in more subtle ways to lift the right-wing challenger, Flávio Bolsonaro, who is running against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, a leftist.
paras.zh: 他没有公开支持任何一位巴西候选人。但特朗普政府确实以更微妙的方式试图提升右翼挑战者弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ） ，他正在与左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）竞

paras.en: Having watched Mr. Trump wade into other elections and experienced his failed attempt to intervene in the trial of Mr. Bolsonaro’s father, who was ultimately convicted for plotting a coup, Brazil has sought to erect a firewall to try to shield its vote from potential U.S. meddling. (The elder Bolsonaro is currently serving a 27-year sentence at home, given his health.)
paras.zh: 看着特朗普涉足其他选举，并经历了他试图干预对博尔索纳罗的父亲的审判失败，博尔索纳罗的父亲最终因策划政变而被定罪，巴西试图竖起一道防火墙，试图保护其选票免受美国的潜在干涉。（鉴于Bolsonaro的健康状况，他目前正在家中服刑27年。）

paras.en: The Trump administration has rejected Brazil’s claims that it is seeking to interfere, even though it tried this summer to send a U.S. delegation to investigate Brazil’s electoral integrity.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府拒绝了巴西声称它正在寻求干预的说法，尽管它在今年夏天试图派遣一个美国代表团调查巴西的选举诚信。

paras.en: A raucous rally featuring supporters for Lula gathered on a major avenue in São Paulo. Soon, the military police arrived with shields and rubber bullets.
paras.zh: 卢拉的支持者举行了一场喧闹的集会，聚集在圣保罗的一条主要大道上。很快，宪兵带着盾牌和橡皮子弹赶到。

paras.en: A security guard at a São Paulo polling station told me to stop filming. Then a Lula supporter stepped in, and the squabble that followed captured the mood of this tense election day.
paras.zh: 圣保罗投票站的一名保安告诉我停止拍摄。然后卢拉的支持者介入，随后的争吵抓住了这个紧张的选举日的情绪。

paras.en: Several electoral lawyers say today’s vote could be annulled due to confusion over the late decision to extend voting hours. All four lawyers interviewed call the situation unprecedented. “This is an extremely serious, critical situation,” said Priscilla Sodré Pereira, an electoral lawyer. Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin decided, minutes before polls closed, to extend all polling stations by two additional hours. By the time of the announcement, some polling centers had already closed, their voting machines had shut down, and they could not reopen. Fernnado Neisser, an electoral law professor at Fundação Getulio Vargas, a Brazilian research institute, said the election could be annulled if the margin is very narrow and it is shown that polling stations stayed open longer in areas that strongly favor one candidate.

paras.en: Flávio Bolsonaro, the right-wing candidate for president and a strong advocate of environmental deregulation, has backed policies that scientists say could hurt the Amazon rainforest. We mapped how deforestation of the Amazon has changed in Brazil depending on who is in power.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）是右翼总统候选人，也是环境放松管制的坚定倡导者，他支持科学家认为可能损害亚马逊雨林的政策。我们绘制了巴西亚马逊森林砍伐的变化图，具体取决于谁掌权。

paras.en: Deforestation of the Amazon surged under President Jair Bolsonaro, then dropped to the lowest level on record under Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. But a win by Mr. Bolsonaro’s son could reverse that. He has promised to make it easier for miners and ranchers to clear trees. And his supporters have warned Indigenous groups that they plan to invade their lands if he wins.
paras.zh: 在总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗（ Jair Bolsonaro ）的领导下，亚马逊森林砍伐飙升，然后降至路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula d但博尔索纳罗的儿子获胜可能会扭转这一局面。他承诺让矿工和牧场主更容易清理树木。他的支持者警告土著群体，如果他获胜，他们计划入侵他们的土地。

paras.en: In the run-up to Sunday’s election, the leftist president of Brazil and independent watchdog groups accused Meta and its social media platforms of giving the leader’s right-wing rival favorable treatment.
paras.zh: 在周日大选前夕，巴西左翼总统和独立监督组织指责Meta及其社交媒体平台给予该领导人的右翼对手优惠待遇。

paras.en: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and groups monitoring social media charged that search results omitted progressive activists, that videos critical of his right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro were taken down without explanation and that posts favoring Mr. Lula reached fewer people.
paras.zh: 总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）和监控社交媒体的团体指控称，搜索结果忽略了进步活动人士，批评其右翼挑战者弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）的视频在没有任何解释的情况下被删除，支持卢拉先生的帖子

paras.en: Mr. Lula’s campaign, which was trying shore up his position before the runoff against Mr. Bolsonaro, filed a complaint with the nation’s electoral court on Oct. 10, demanding fair treatment online.
paras.zh: 卢拉的竞选活动在针对博尔索纳罗的第二轮选举之前试图巩固自己的地位，于10月10日向该国选举法院提起诉讼，要求在网上获得公平待遇。

paras.en: “The scenario is,” the complaint said, “that of a platform illegally practicing algorithmic selectivity, in the midst of a fierce presidential contest.’’
paras.zh: “情况是，”投诉说， “一个平台在激烈的总统竞选中非法实行算法选择性。”

paras.en: Meta has firmly rejected claims of political bias, asserting firmly in a response to the court that it “does not operate its systems to harm or favor candidacies.”
paras.zh: Meta坚决驳回了政治偏见的主张，在回应法院时坚定地声称，它“不会运用其系统来伤害或偏袒候选人”。

paras.en: But in Brazil, where social media and disinformation have played a central role in recent elections, fears that online debate could again sway a narrow presidential race have touched a nerve.
paras.zh: 但在巴西，社交媒体和虚假信息在最近的选举中发挥了核心作用，人们担心在线辩论可能会再次影响狭隘的总统竞选，这触动了人们的神经。

paras.en: Videos made with artificial intelligence, ranging from the amusing to deceitful, have flooded the Brazilian internet ahead of Sunday’s high-stakes presidential election.
paras.zh: 在周日高风险的总统选举之前，用人工智能制作的视频，从有趣到欺骗，已经淹没了巴西的互联网。

paras.en: The use of A.I. to craft messages has turned Brazil, Latin America’s largest democracy, into a laboratory of sorts for how the technology can be used in elections. There are parallels in the United States and other nations grappling with A.I.’s political effects.
paras.zh: 使用人工智能来制作信息已将拉丁美洲最大的民主国家巴西变成了如何在选举中使用该技术的实验室。美国和其他国家在应对人工智能的政治影响方面存在相似之处。

paras.en: In Brazil, a nation of 214 million, disinformation has defined elections for nearly a decade. The country has some of the world’s strictest regulations against spreading falsehoods during elections.
paras.zh: 在巴西这个拥有2.14亿人口的国家，虚假信息已经定义了近十年的选举。该国有一些世界上最严格的规定，禁止在选举期间传播虚假信息。

paras.en: But the deluge of A.I. — made by candidates, strategists and ordinary citizens — has become a stark test of the nation’s capacity to police online content, posing a new challenge for the Brazilian authorities trying to protect the integrity of the vote.
paras.zh: 但是，由候选人、战略家和普通公民制造的人工智能的泛滥已经成为对国家监管在线内容能力的严峻考验，对试图保护投票完整性的巴西当局构成了新的挑战。

paras.en: “We made the rules, now we’re watching to see what happens,” said Kássio Nunes Marques, chief justice of Brazil’s electoral court, which oversees the vote.
paras.zh: “我们制定了规则，现在我们正在观察会发生什么，”负责监督投票的巴西选举法院首席大法官卡西奥·努内斯·马克斯（ Kássio Nunes Marques ）说。

paras.en: Depending on whom you ask, Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes is either a hero who protected Brazil’s democracy, or a villain who used authoritarian measures to target the far right.
paras.zh: 根据您的要求，最高法院法官亚历山大·德莫赖斯（ Alexandre de Moraes ）要么是保护巴西民主的英雄，要么是使用专制措施瞄准极右翼的恶棍。

paras.en: In a series of polarizing decisions, Justice Moraes cracked down on online falsehoods, punished rioters who falsely claimed the last election had been stolen and sentenced the former president, Jair Bolsonaro, on charges of trying to retain power after he lost the last election.
paras.zh: 在一系列两极分化的决定中，莫赖斯法官打击了在线谎言，惩罚了那些错误地声称上次选举被盗的暴徒，并判处前总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗（ Jair Bolsonaro ）在上次选举失败后试图保住权力。

paras.en: But earlier this year, the justice’s reputation was shattered when he was publicly linked to a banker accused of fraud. According to a leaked police dossier, Justice Moraes had exchanged text messages with the banker, who was seeking help in avoiding arrest and mentioned paying millions to a law firm run by the justice’s wife. The police have never said if Justice Moraes responded to the request or helped the banker in some way.
paras.zh: 但今年早些时候，当他与一名被指控欺诈的银行家公开联系时，法官的声誉被打破了。根据泄露的警方档案，莫赖斯法官与这位银行家交换了短信，这位银行家正在寻求帮助以避免被捕，并提到向这位法官的妻子经营的一家律师事务所支付了数百万美元。警方从未说过Moraes法官是否回应了这一请求或以某种方式帮助了银行家。

paras.en: Still, the revelation has become a major issue in the presidential election being decided on Sunday.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这一启示已经成为周日总统选举中的一个主要问题。

paras.en: For starters, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, a leftist, was saddled with the fallout of the scandal at the Supreme Court that tarnished Justice Moraes, his ally.
paras.zh: 首先，左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）背负着最高法院丑闻的后果，该丑闻玷污了他的盟友莫赖斯法官。

paras.en: But the scandal has also galvanized many right-leaning voters in their support for Jair Bolsonaro’s son, Flávio, who is challenging Mr. Lula for the presidency. Mr. Bolsonaro used the scandal to whip up support in his stump speeches.
paras.zh: 但这一丑闻也激励了许多右倾选民支持贾尔·博尔索纳罗(Jair Bolsonaro)的儿子弗拉维奥(Flávio) ，后者正在挑战卢拉竞选总统。博尔索纳罗利用这一丑闻在他的树桩演讲中赢得了支持。

paras.en: “To vote for Lula is to vote for Alexandre de Moraes,” Mr. Bolsonaro recently told a crowd of supporters. “And I’m not going to let that happen.”
paras.zh: “投票给卢拉就是投票给亚历山大·德莫赖斯，”博尔索纳罗最近告诉一群支持者。“我不会让这种情况发生。”

paras.en: “It gave Flávio’s campaign a simple slogan,” said Luciano da Ros, a Brazilian political scientist. “And it united different segments on the right around a powerful common enemy.”
paras.zh: 巴西政治学家卢西亚诺·达罗斯（ Luciano da Ros ）说： “这给了弗拉维奥的竞选活动一个简单的口号。“它将右翼的不同派别团结在一个强大的共同敌人周围。”

paras.en: Mr. Lula, eager to shield his campaign, has tried to distance himself from Justice Moraes. “Nobody is above the law,” he said in an interview. He urged an investigation into the justice’s conduct and a broad judicial overhaul.

A number of right-wing leaders have recently swept into power in Latin America, riding a wave of dissatisfaction with incumbent governments and deepening worries about security and a rising cost of living.

Until now, Brazil, the region’s largest nation, had been the exception. The left-wing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, began his third nonconsecutive term in 2023. His predecessor and rival, Jair Bolsonaro, had been convicted of trying to stage a coup to prevent Mr. Lula from taking office and was sentenced to 27 years, which he is currently serving under house arrest for health reasons.

Now Mr. Lula, weighed down by widespread perceptions of rising crime and economic woes, faces a challenge from the former president’s son, Flávio Bolsonaro, a right-wing senator. Mr. Bolsonaro’s formidable performance in the first voting round this month gave him the edge going into a two-way contest.
The outcome will have a profound effect on Brazil and its relations with the United States in particular. Here are some of the major issues at stake.
Mr. Bolsonaro has already said he would add Brazil to the Trump administration’s anti-cartel coalition, called the Shield of the Americas, and work with the United States to fight Brazilian gangs.

He suggested in social media posts last year that he would welcome U.S. military intervention in Brazil, though he denied that in recent interviews, saying the cooperation would be limited to intelligence. But it was Mr. Bolsonaro who successfully lobbied Mr. Trump to designate two Brazilian gangs as terrorist groups.
Mr. Lula has resisted joining the coalition, warning that intertwining too closely with the United States on security matters could threaten the nation’s sovereignty.

The Trump administration imposed tariffs on Brazilian products in an unsuccessful pressure campaign to disrupt the prosecution of Jair Bolsonaro. Many of those tariffs were eventually scaled back, and Brazil’s economy has remained largely unharmed by President Trump’s tariff campaign.

Another term for Mr. Lula, however, would increase the risk of more economic conflicts with the United States that might hurt the Brazilian economy. Of course, Mr. Bolsonaro would not be immune to those problems; Mr. Trump has been known to levy tariffs against allies as well as adversaries.

The Trump administration has signaled an interest in importing Brazilian oil to counter disruptions related to the Iran war and the country’s rare-earth minerals to reduce U.S. dependence on China for those resources. Mr. Bolsonaro is expected to align Brazil more closely with the United States than Mr. Lula has on trade issues, but neither leader can afford to anger China, a major trading partner.
The election could also affect Brazil’s ability to negotiate trade with the United States as a bloc with other countries in the region.

“Brazil’s relations with its neighbors have been extremely challenging,” said Carolina Moehlecke, an assistant professor of international relations at Getúlio Vargas Foundation, a research institution. This was especially true of its neighbor, Argentina, she added, whose right-wing president is a close ally of Mr. Trump. Mr. Bolsonaro, she said, might have an easier time cooperating with fellow right-wing leaders in Latin America.

If Mr. Bolsonaro carries the vote, conservationists fear a return to his father’s policies of allowing rapid deforestation in the Amazon rainforest, a trend that was largely reversed under President Lula. The younger Mr. Bolsonaro does not believe that climate change is caused by humans and has defended opening up protected lands to mining and farming.

He has also pledged to stem the nation’s rising debt. If he attempts to accomplish that through cuts to public spending, that could prove politically sensitive, Ms. Moehlecke said, especially when it comes to social welfare policies with broad popularity in Brazil. In the lead-up to Sunday’s elections, Mr. Lula had promised to increase welfare payments.

Mr. Lula has framed the election as a test of the nation’s democracy and portrays the Bolsonaros as a threat to democratic institutions. Ms. Moehlecke said it was likely Mr. Bolsonaro would take the country in a more authoritarian direction, though his rhetoric is generally tamer than his father’s.

But if Mr. Bolsonaro wins, his party’s gains in the legislature could allow him to deliver on some of his most polarizing promises: amnesty for his father, pardons for rioters who stormed Brazil’s halls of power after the last election, and a Senate more willing to try to remove justices who convicted his father.

If Mr. Lula wins, he most likely will face significant checks against his power. Right-wing candidates, including four other members of the Bolsonaro family, have made significant strides in the nation’s legislative races.

articles.title: Here’s the latest.
articles.author: Adam B. Ellick and Ana Ionova

paras.en: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva of Brazil surged to a remarkable re-election on Sunday, according to official preliminary results, but his opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, said he would not accept the results after a chaotic Election Day.
paras.zh: 根据官方初步结果，巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦周日顺利连任，但他的对手弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗表示，在混乱的选举日之后，他不会接受选举结果。

paras.en: Mr. Lula’s victory, which ended a string of conservative wins in Latin America cheered on by President Trump, came after a judge ordered polls to remain open an additional two hours — a move requested by both campaigns after transportation delays and bad weather disrupted voting. At a news conference, Mr. Bolsonaro called for the election to be annulled, saying the decision to keep the polls open “changed the rules in the middle of the game.”
paras.zh: 卢拉的胜利结束了特朗普总统欢呼的拉丁美洲保守派的一系列胜利，此前一名法官下令民意调查再开放两个小时——在交通延误和恶劣天气扰乱投票后，双方竞选团队都要求采取这一举措。在新闻发布会上，博尔索纳罗呼吁取消选举，称保持投票开放的决定“改变了游戏中的规则”。

paras.en: “There’s a lot that needs to be cleared up before Brazil simply accepts this foul play that took place in these elections,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “在巴西简单地接受这些选举中发生的犯规之前，还有很多事情需要清理。”

paras.en: Mr. Lula received 51.8 percent of the vote, versus 48.2 percent for Flávio Bolsonaro, with 99.9 percent of the ballots counted, according to official preliminary results.
paras.zh: 根据官方初步结果，卢拉获得了51.8%的选票，而弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗获得了48.2%的选票， 99.9%的选票被计算在内。

paras.en: The leftist’s margin of victory was wider than four years ago, and was predicted by few pollsters. Even more stunning was that he achieved the comeback after placing second in the first round of voting earlier this month, a first in Brazilian history.
paras.zh: 左翼的胜利优势比四年前更大，并且很少有民意调查机构预测到这一点。更令人惊叹的是，他在本月早些时候的第一轮投票中获得第二名后实现了复出，这在巴西历史上尚属首次。

paras.en: “I would like to thank the Brazilian people for the generosity they have shown me for a long time,” Mr. Lula said in a victory speech in São Paulo.
paras.zh: “我要感谢巴西人民长期以来对我的慷慨，”卢拉在圣保罗的胜利演讲中说道。

paras.en: Mr. Lula, 80, had framed his candidacy as a vote for democracy and the only way to bar the return of the Bolsonaro family to power. He has frequently and defiantly clashed with Mr. Trump, who attempted to use tariffs and sanctions to keep Mr. Bolsonaro’s father, Jair, out of prison for his attempted coup four years ago.
paras.zh: 80 岁的卢拉将自己的候选资格视为对民主的投票，也是阻止博尔索纳罗家族重新掌权的唯一途径。他经常与特朗普发生挑衅性冲突，特朗普试图利用关税和制裁来让博尔索纳罗的父亲贾尔因四年前的未遂政变而免于入狱。

paras.en: Mr. Lula’s victory snapped a string of seven straight wins by right-wing leaders in the region over the last 18 months, and suggested that Latin America’s left-wing forces still wield some influence despite the losses.
paras.zh: 卢拉的胜利结束了过去 18 个月该地区右翼领导人的七连胜，这表明拉丁美洲的左翼势力尽管遭受了损失，但仍然发挥着一定的影响力。

paras.en: On Paulista Avenue, a main drag in São Paulo, fireworks crackled, horns blared and supporters cried in disbelief. Vendors sold popcorn and beer, with their stands plastered with Lula stickers.
paras.zh: 在圣保罗的主要阻力保利斯塔大道上，烟花爆裂，喇叭响起，支持者难以置信地哭泣。小贩们出售爆米花和啤酒，他们的摊位上贴着卢拉贴纸。

paras.en: The candidates offered starkly different visions on issues that included fighting organized crime and revitalizing a sluggish economy. The outcome could reshape Brazil’s trajectory on many divisive issues for years to come because the next president will have the right to fill four open seats on the country’s powerful Supreme Court, which has 11 seats in total.
paras.zh: 两位候选人在打击有组织犯罪和振兴疲软经济等问题上提出了截然不同的愿景。这一结果可能会重塑巴西未来几年在许多有争议问题上的发展轨迹，因为下一任总统将有权填补该国强大的最高法院的四个空缺席位，该法院共有 11 个席位。

paras.en: - Extra two hours: Both candidates asked for polls to be kept open. Mr. Bolsonaro said that flooding in a part of the country where he held electoral advantages would unfairly hurt him, while Mr. Lula accused public officials of purposefully slowing down public transportation in areas where he won in an earlier round of voting.
paras.zh: - 额外两个小时：两位候选人都要求投票保持开放。博尔索纳罗表示，他拥有选举优势的地区发生洪水会对他造成不公平的伤害，而卢拉则指责公职人员故意减慢他在上一轮投票中获胜地区的公共交通速度。

paras.en: - The Bolsonaros: Looming over the contest was an epic political struggle that has roiled and defined Brazilian politics for more than a decade. Mr. Bolsonaro ran in lieu of his father, who could not stand for office because he was convicted of attempting a coup against Mr. Lula after losing the last election in 2022. He was sentenced to 27 years in prison and is serving his time at home because of health reasons.
paras.zh: - Bolsonaros ：笼罩着这场比赛是一场史诗般的政治斗争，十多年来一直困扰着并定义着巴西政治。博尔索纳罗先生代替他的父亲竞选，他的父亲无法参选，因为他在2022年的上一次选举中失败后被判犯有企图对卢拉先生发动政变的罪名。他被判处27年监禁，并因健康原因在家服刑。

paras.en: Flávio Bolsonaro’s Liberal Party has two possible paths to challenge the result, said Raquel Machado, a professor at the Federal University of Ceará. It could seek a technical audit to determine whether unequal voting conditions affected the outcome, potentially leading to the election’s annulment. Or it could pursue an abuse-of-power case through the Superior Electoral Court’s inspector general, which could disqualify the Lula-Alckmin ticket even after it takes office.
paras.zh: 塞阿拉联邦大学教授拉奎尔·马查多（ Raquel Machado ）说，弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）的自由党有两条可能的途径来挑战这一结果。它可以寻求技术审计，以确定不平等的投票条件是否影响了选举结果，从而可能导致选举被废除。或者，它可以通过高等选举法院的监察长追究滥用权力的案件，即使在卢拉-阿尔克明就职后也可能取消其资格。

paras.en: But Professor Machado noted that many polling stations had already closed when the Supreme Court’s order was made public, and she said that there had been no significant influx of voters after 5 p.m. local time.
paras.zh: 但马查多教授指出，最高法院的命令公布时，许多投票站已经关闭，她表示下午 5 点之后并没有出现大量选民涌入。当地时间。

paras.en: Lula’s Workers’ Party could bring its own challenge over restrictions on public bus services on Election Day. If those restrictions were found to be an abuse of power, Flávio, his running mate and others involved could be barred from running for office for eight years.
paras.zh: 卢拉的工人党可能会对选举日公共巴士服务的限制提出自己的挑战。如果这些限制被发现滥用权力，弗拉维奥、他的竞选搭档和其他相关人员可能会被禁止八年内竞选公职。

paras.en: President Trump has not yet weighed in on Lula’s victory, but President Claudia Sheinbaum of Mexico and Prime Minister Mark Carney of Canada have congratulated him in social media posts. “Long live democracy, the people of Brazil won,” Sheinbaum wrote.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统尚未对卢拉的胜利发表评论，但墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·辛鲍姆和加拿大总理马克·卡尼在社交媒体上发帖祝贺他。 “民主万岁，巴西人民获胜，”希因鲍姆写道。

paras.en: Sheinbaum, a fellow leftist, has generally been more cautious than Lulu about publicly antagonizing Washington. But she is still a key ally for him in Latin America, where right-wing governments have dominated elections over the past year and a half.
paras.zh: 谢因鲍姆是一位左翼人士，在公开对抗华盛顿方面总体上比露露更加谨慎。但她仍然是他在拉丁美洲的重要盟友，过去一年半里右翼政府在拉丁美洲的选举中占据主导地位。

paras.en: I covered the chaos following Brazil’s election in 2022, when then-President Jair Bolsonaro claimed fraud. Now his son Flávio is contesting tonight’s results, but we are not yet seeing major street protests, as we did by this time four years ago.
paras.zh: 我报道了2022年巴西大选后的混乱局面，当时的总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗（ Jair Bolsonaro ）声称存在欺诈行为。现在，他的儿子弗拉维奥正在争夺今晚的结果，但我们还没有看到像四年前这个时候那样的大型街头抗议活动。

paras.en: I see signs that Flávio Bolsonaro might not get as much traction as his father did. He is not as popular, for starters, and he doesn’t control the government or the armed forces. He also did not spend months undermining the integrity of Brazil’s voting systems, as his father did.
paras.zh: 我看到迹象表明弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗可能不会像他的父亲那样受到那么多关注。首先，他并不那么受欢迎，而且他不控制政府或武装部队。他也没有像他父亲那样花几个月的时间破坏巴西投票系统的完整性。

paras.en: Also, the margin of victory – 4.4 million votes, according to official preliminary results, versus 2.1 million in 2022 – is much larger this time. And while Jair Bolsonaro’s fraud claims were broad, his son’s supporters mostly seem to be focusing tonight on the narrow fact that a Supreme Court justice ordered the polls open for two extra hours, a delay that both Flavio and Lula had requested.
paras.zh: 此外，根据官方初步结果，这次的胜利幅度（ 440万张选票，而2022年为210万张）要大得多。虽然Jair Bolsonaro的欺诈指控很广泛，但他儿子的支持者今晚似乎主要关注这样一个狭隘的事实，即最高法院大法官下令投票站额外开放两个小时，这是Flavio和Lula都要求的延迟。

paras.en: Supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro gathered outside the National Museum in the capital, Brasília. One of them, Valéria Maria de Melo, 49, cried upon learning of Lula’s victory. “We know we were robbed,” she said, wearing a T-shirt plastered with Bolsonaro stickers.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗的支持者聚集在首都巴西利亚国家博物馆外。其中一位 49 岁的瓦莱丽娅·玛丽亚·德梅洛 (Valéria Maria de Melo) 在得知卢拉获胜的消息后哭了。 “我们知道我们被抢劫了，”她穿着一件贴有博尔索纳罗贴纸的 T 恤说道。

paras.en: Around midnight, President Lula arrived on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo. The scene feels part carnival, part music festival. It’s nearly impossible to walk: I’ve spent the last 15 minutes moving about 10 steps. People have climbed atop subway station entrances. I see people of all ages and races, from babies to people in their 80s. There are monks. Strangers are dancing and hugging one another. The crowd is chanting, “No amnesty!” in reference to Bolsonaro’s pledge to seek amnesty for his father, Jair Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 午夜时分，卢拉总统抵达圣保罗保利斯塔大道。这个场景感觉一半是嘉年华，一半是音乐节。走路几乎是不可能的：过去 15 分钟我走了大约 10 步。人们爬上地铁站入口处。我见过各种年龄和种族的人，从婴儿到 80 多岁的老人。有僧人。陌生人跳舞、互相拥抱。人群高呼“不特赦！”提及博尔索纳罗承诺为其父亲贾尔·博尔索纳罗寻求特赦。

paras.en: Bolsonaro’s party will now have to petition electoral authorities for a review of the result. Since Brazil’s return to democracy, no presidential election has been annulled. In 2014, the losing party requested an audit, but the review found no evidence of fraud, and the results were upheld.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的政党现在将不得不向选举当局请愿，要求对结果进行审查。自巴西恢复民主以来，没有任何总统选举被废除。2014年，败诉方要求进行审计，但审查未发现欺诈证据，结果维持不变。

paras.en: In 2022, Bolsonaro’s Liberal Party similarly challenged his father’s election loss, but the court fined the party 22 million reais for failing to provide evidence to support its allegations.
paras.zh: 2022年，博尔索纳罗的自由党同样对父亲的选举失败提出质疑，但法院因该党未能提供证据支持其指控而对其处以2200万雷亚尔的罚款。

paras.en: Leaders across Latin America have congratulated Lula on his victory, including right-wing presidents in Chile, Paraguay and Peru. But the United States has remained notably silent.
paras.zh: 拉丁美洲各国领导人对卢拉的胜利表示祝贺，包括智利、巴拉圭和秘鲁的右翼总统。但美国一直保持着明显的沉默。

paras.en: Many Brazilians, as well as members of the Lula administration, had feared that Washington would try to interfere in the election. Brazilian sovereignty even became a rallying cry during Lula’s campaign. But Trump never explicitly endorsed a candidate.
paras.zh: 许多巴西人以及卢拉政府成员都担心华盛顿会试图干涉选举。巴西主权甚至成为卢拉竞选期间的口号。但特朗普从未明确支持候选人。

paras.en: On Sunday night, right-wing figures in the United States, including Donald Trump Jr., began casting doubt on the elections results.
paras.zh: 周日晚上，包括小唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump Jr. ）在内的美国右翼人士开始对选举结果表示怀疑。

paras.en: Digging into tonight’s numbers, Lula’s comeback is remarkable. After finishing behind in the first round, few pollsters expected him to turn things around. Most assumed that voters whose preferred candidates had been eliminated would break for Flávio Bolsonaro in Sunday’s runoff. But that’s not what happened.
paras.zh: 深入挖掘今晚的数据，卢拉的卷土重来令人瞩目。在第一轮落后之后，很少有民意测验专家指望他能扭转局面。大多数人认为，首选候选人被淘汰的选民将在周日的决选中支持弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）。但事实并非如此。

paras.en: There were about 14 million additional votes up for grabs in the runoff, including those of new voters, supporters of eliminated candidates and people who had cast blank or invalid ballots in the first round.
paras.zh: 在第二轮投票中，还有大约1400万张选票可供争夺，其中包括新选民、被淘汰候选人的支持者以及在第一轮投票中投出空白或无效选票的人。

paras.en: Lula captured three out of every four of those votes, a stunning turnaround. He gained 10.4 million votes between the first and second rounds, compared with just 3.7 million for Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 卢拉获得了四分之三的选票，这是一个惊人的转变。他在第一轮和第二轮投票中获得了1040万张选票，而博尔索纳罗仅获得370万张选票。

paras.en: Flávio Bolsonaro also accused a Supreme Court justice who previously served as Lula’s lawyer of having “changed the rules in the middle of the game” by extending voting hours. “What happened today was not normal and it was even unacceptable,” he said.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）还指责曾担任卢拉律师的最高法院法官通过延长投票时间“在比赛中改变了规则”。“今天发生的事情是不正常的，甚至是不可接受的，”他说。

paras.en: In a news conference, Flávio Bolsonaro refused to recognize Lula’s victory and said he would seek to have the election annulled. He described the court’s decision to extend the voting as a “dirty trick.”
paras.zh: 在新闻发布会上，弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）拒绝承认卢拉的胜利，并表示他将寻求取消选举。他将法院延长投票的决定描述为“肮脏的伎俩”。

paras.en: “There’s a lot that needs to be cleared up before Brazil simply accepts this foul play that took place in these elections,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “在巴西简单地接受这些选举中发生的犯规之前，还有很多事情需要清理。”

paras.en: Lula, speaking at a hotel surrounded by his wife, his running mate and his political allies, looked relatively calm. He said the outpouring of rallies in the last week “was a demonstration that this country refuses to be anyone’s backyard.” That appeared to be a reference to the United States, which has been trying to exert new levels of control over Latin America through tariffs, sanctions, election interventions and other means.
paras.zh: 卢拉在一家被妻子、竞选伙伴和政治盟友包围的酒店讲话时，看起来相对平静。他说，上周的大量集会“表明这个国家拒绝成为任何人的后院。“这似乎是指美国一直试图通过关税、制裁、选举干预和其他手段对拉丁美洲施加新水平的控制。

paras.en: On Paulista Avenue, one of São Paulo’s main thoroughfares, a massive, spontaneous celebration continues to grow. Fireworks began erupting even before the election was called, and they are still crackling overhead. Horns are blaring, adding to the deafening noise. Supporters are crying in disbelief. Vendors are selling popcorn and beer from stands plastered with Lula stickers.
paras.zh: 在圣保罗的主要街道之一保利斯塔大道上，一场大规模的自发庆祝活动不断发展。甚至在选举之前就开始爆发烟花，它们仍然在头顶上啪啪作响。喇叭响起，加剧了震耳欲聋的噪音。支持者难以置信地哭泣。摊贩们正在出售印有卢拉贴纸的摊位上的爆米花和啤酒。

paras.en: “I would like to thank the Brazilian people for the generosity they have shown me for a long time,” said Lula in a victory speech in São Paulo. “And, in this second round, I want to thank the generosity of the Brazilian youth, who took to the streets to defend democracy.”
paras.zh: 卢拉在圣保罗的胜利演讲中说： “我要感谢巴西人民长期以来对我的慷慨。” “在第二轮中，我要感谢巴西青年的慷慨，他们走上街头捍卫民主。”

paras.en: Numerous poll workers nationwide said they received confusing and sometimes contradictory orders from electoral authorities. At a polling site in central São Paulo, one election worker said that by 5 p.m. local time, she and her colleagues heard that the Supreme Court had ordered polling sites to remain open two more hours. However, local authorities ordered them to shut down. The worker, who gave her name only as Bárbara because she feared repercussions, said they eventually got orders to reopen by 6 p.m., but it was too late for many voters.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Lula is re-elected, according to official preliminary results from Brazil’s top electoral court.
paras.zh: 根据巴西最高选举法院的官方初步结果，卢拉再次当选。

paras.en: Since taking office, President Trump has become something of an electoral kingmaker in Latin America. Right-wing candidates aligned with Washington have won the past seven elections in the region, with Mr. Trump explicitly endorsing the winner in two of them.
paras.zh: 自上任以来，特朗普总统已成为拉丁美洲的选举国王。与华盛顿结盟的右翼候选人赢得了该地区过去七次选举，特朗普在其中两次选举中明确支持获胜者。

paras.en: Now comes the biggest regional test for the right and for Mr. Trump’s recent record of success: Brazil.
paras.zh: 现在是对右翼和特朗普最近成功记录的最大地区考验：巴西。

paras.en: As Brazilians headed to the polls on Sunday, the question looming over Latin America’s largest democracy was whether Mr. Trump would have an influence.
paras.zh: 随着巴西人周日前往投票站，围绕拉丁美洲最大民主国家的问题是特朗普是否会有影响力。

paras.en: He has not openly championed either Brazilian candidate. But the Trump administration did try in more subtle ways to lift the right-wing challenger, Flávio Bolsonaro, who is running against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, a leftist.
paras.zh: 他没有公开支持任何一位巴西候选人。但特朗普政府确实以更微妙的方式试图提升右翼挑战者弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ） ，他正在与左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）竞

paras.en: Having watched Mr. Trump wade into other elections and experienced his failed attempt to intervene in the trial of Mr. Bolsonaro’s father, who was ultimately convicted for plotting a coup, Brazil has sought to erect a firewall to try to shield its vote from potential U.S. meddling. (The elder Bolsonaro is currently serving a 27-year sentence at home, given his health.)
paras.zh: 看着特朗普涉足其他选举，并经历了他试图干预对博尔索纳罗的父亲的审判失败，博尔索纳罗的父亲最终因策划政变而被定罪，巴西试图竖起一道防火墙，试图保护其选票免受美国的潜在干涉。（鉴于Bolsonaro的健康状况，他目前正在家中服刑27年。）

paras.en: The Trump administration has rejected Brazil’s claims that it is seeking to interfere, even though it tried this summer to send a U.S. delegation to investigate Brazil’s electoral integrity.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府拒绝了巴西声称它正在寻求干预的说法，尽管它在今年夏天试图派遣一个美国代表团调查巴西的选举诚信。

paras.en: A raucous rally featuring supporters for Lula gathered on a major avenue in São Paulo. Soon, the military police arrived with shields and rubber bullets.
paras.zh: 卢拉的支持者举行了一场喧闹的集会，聚集在圣保罗的一条主要大道上。很快，宪兵带着盾牌和橡皮子弹赶到。

paras.en: A security guard at a São Paulo polling station told me to stop filming. Then a Lula supporter stepped in, and the squabble that followed captured the mood of this tense election day.
paras.zh: 圣保罗投票站的一名保安告诉我停止拍摄。然后卢拉的支持者介入，随后的争吵抓住了这个紧张的选举日的情绪。

paras.en: Several electoral lawyers say today’s vote could be annulled due to confusion over the late decision to extend voting hours. All four lawyers interviewed call the situation unprecedented. “This is an extremely serious, critical situation,” said Priscilla Sodré Pereira, an electoral lawyer. Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin decided, minutes before polls closed, to extend all polling stations by two additional hours. By the time of the announcement, some polling centers had already closed, their voting machines had shut down, and they could not reopen. Fernnado Neisser, an electoral law professor at Fundação Getulio Vargas, a Brazilian research institute, said the election could be annulled if the margin is very narrow and it is shown that polling stations stayed open longer in areas that strongly favor one candidate.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Flávio Bolsonaro, the right-wing candidate for president and a strong advocate of environmental deregulation, has backed policies that scientists say could hurt the Amazon rainforest. We mapped how deforestation of the Amazon has changed in Brazil depending on who is in power.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）是右翼总统候选人，也是环境放松管制的坚定倡导者，他支持科学家认为可能损害亚马逊雨林的政策。我们绘制了巴西亚马逊森林砍伐的变化图，具体取决于谁掌权。

paras.en: Deforestation of the Amazon surged under President Jair Bolsonaro, then dropped to the lowest level on record under Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. But a win by Mr. Bolsonaro’s son could reverse that. He has promised to make it easier for miners and ranchers to clear trees. And his supporters have warned Indigenous groups that they plan to invade their lands if he wins.
paras.zh: 在总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗（ Jair Bolsonaro ）的领导下，亚马逊森林砍伐飙升，然后降至路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula d但博尔索纳罗的儿子获胜可能会扭转这一局面。他承诺让矿工和牧场主更容易清理树木。他的支持者警告土著群体，如果他获胜，他们计划入侵他们的土地。

paras.en: In the run-up to Sunday’s election, the leftist president of Brazil and independent watchdog groups accused Meta and its social media platforms of giving the leader’s right-wing rival favorable treatment.
paras.zh: 在周日大选前夕，巴西左翼总统和独立监督组织指责Meta及其社交媒体平台给予该领导人的右翼对手优惠待遇。

paras.en: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and groups monitoring social media charged that search results omitted progressive activists, that videos critical of his right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro were taken down without explanation and that posts favoring Mr. Lula reached fewer people.
paras.zh: 总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）和监控社交媒体的团体指控称，搜索结果忽略了进步活动人士，批评其右翼挑战者弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）的视频在没有任何解释的情况下被删除，支持卢拉先生的帖子

paras.en: Mr. Lula’s campaign, which was trying shore up his position before the runoff against Mr. Bolsonaro, filed a complaint with the nation’s electoral court on Oct. 10, demanding fair treatment online.
paras.zh: 卢拉的竞选活动在针对博尔索纳罗的第二轮选举之前试图巩固自己的地位，于10月10日向该国选举法院提起诉讼，要求在网上获得公平待遇。

paras.en: “The scenario is,” the complaint said, “that of a platform illegally practicing algorithmic selectivity, in the midst of a fierce presidential contest.’’
paras.zh: “情况是，”投诉说， “一个平台在激烈的总统竞选中非法实行算法选择性。”

paras.en: Meta has firmly rejected claims of political bias, asserting firmly in a response to the court that it “does not operate its systems to harm or favor candidacies.”
paras.zh: Meta坚决驳回了政治偏见的主张，在回应法院时坚定地声称，它“不会运用其系统来伤害或偏袒候选人”。

paras.en: But in Brazil, where social media and disinformation have played a central role in recent elections, fears that online debate could again sway a narrow presidential race have touched a nerve.
paras.zh: 但在巴西，社交媒体和虚假信息在最近的选举中发挥了核心作用，人们担心在线辩论可能会再次影响狭隘的总统竞选，这触动了人们的神经。

paras.en: Videos made with artificial intelligence, ranging from the amusing to deceitful, have flooded the Brazilian internet ahead of Sunday’s high-stakes presidential election.
paras.zh: 在周日高风险的总统选举之前，用人工智能制作的视频，从有趣到欺骗，已经淹没了巴西的互联网。

paras.en: The use of A.I. to craft messages has turned Brazil, Latin America’s largest democracy, into a laboratory of sorts for how the technology can be used in elections. There are parallels in the United States and other nations grappling with A.I.’s political effects.
paras.zh: 使用人工智能来制作信息已将拉丁美洲最大的民主国家巴西变成了如何在选举中使用该技术的实验室。美国和其他国家在应对人工智能的政治影响方面存在相似之处。

paras.en: In Brazil, a nation of 214 million, disinformation has defined elections for nearly a decade. The country has some of the world’s strictest regulations against spreading falsehoods during elections.
paras.zh: 在巴西这个拥有2.14亿人口的国家，虚假信息已经定义了近十年的选举。该国有一些世界上最严格的规定，禁止在选举期间传播虚假信息。

paras.en: But the deluge of A.I. — made by candidates, strategists and ordinary citizens — has become a stark test of the nation’s capacity to police online content, posing a new challenge for the Brazilian authorities trying to protect the integrity of the vote.
paras.zh: 但是，由候选人、战略家和普通公民制造的人工智能的泛滥已经成为对国家监管在线内容能力的严峻考验，对试图保护投票完整性的巴西当局构成了新的挑战。

paras.en: “We made the rules, now we’re watching to see what happens,” said Kássio Nunes Marques, chief justice of Brazil’s electoral court, which oversees the vote.
paras.zh: “我们制定了规则，现在我们正在观察会发生什么，”负责监督投票的巴西选举法院首席大法官卡西奥·努内斯·马克斯（ Kássio Nunes Marques ）说。

paras.en: Depending on whom you ask, Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes is either a hero who protected Brazil’s democracy, or a villain who used authoritarian measures to target the far right.
paras.zh: 根据您的要求，最高法院法官亚历山大·德莫赖斯（ Alexandre de Moraes ）要么是保护巴西民主的英雄，要么是使用专制措施瞄准极右翼的恶棍。

paras.en: In a series of polarizing decisions, Justice Moraes cracked down on online falsehoods, punished rioters who falsely claimed the last election had been stolen and sentenced the former president, Jair Bolsonaro, on charges of trying to retain power after he lost the last election.
paras.zh: 在一系列两极分化的决定中，莫赖斯法官打击了在线谎言，惩罚了那些错误地声称上次选举被盗的暴徒，并判处前总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗（ Jair Bolsonaro ）在上次选举失败后试图保住权力。

paras.en: But earlier this year, the justice’s reputation was shattered when he was publicly linked to a banker accused of fraud. According to a leaked police dossier, Justice Moraes had exchanged text messages with the banker, who was seeking help in avoiding arrest and mentioned paying millions to a law firm run by the justice’s wife. The police have never said if Justice Moraes responded to the request or helped the banker in some way.
paras.zh: 但今年早些时候，当他与一名被指控欺诈的银行家公开联系时，法官的声誉被打破了。根据泄露的警方档案，莫赖斯法官与这位银行家交换了短信，这位银行家正在寻求帮助以避免被捕，并提到向这位法官的妻子经营的一家律师事务所支付了数百万美元。警方从未说过Moraes法官是否回应了这一请求或以某种方式帮助了银行家。

paras.en: Still, the revelation has become a major issue in the presidential election being decided on Sunday.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这一启示已经成为周日总统选举中的一个主要问题。

paras.en: For starters, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, a leftist, was saddled with the fallout of the scandal at the Supreme Court that tarnished Justice Moraes, his ally.
paras.zh: 首先，左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）背负着最高法院丑闻的后果，该丑闻玷污了他的盟友莫赖斯法官。

paras.en: But the scandal has also galvanized many right-leaning voters in their support for Jair Bolsonaro’s son, Flávio, who is challenging Mr. Lula for the presidency. Mr. Bolsonaro used the scandal to whip up support in his stump speeches.
paras.zh: 但这一丑闻也激励了许多右倾选民支持贾尔·博尔索纳罗(Jair Bolsonaro)的儿子弗拉维奥(Flávio) ，后者正在挑战卢拉竞选总统。博尔索纳罗利用这一丑闻在他的树桩演讲中赢得了支持。

paras.en: “To vote for Lula is to vote for Alexandre de Moraes,” Mr. Bolsonaro recently told a crowd of supporters. “And I’m not going to let that happen.”
paras.zh: “投票给卢拉就是投票给亚历山大·德莫赖斯，”博尔索纳罗最近告诉一群支持者。“我不会让这种情况发生。”

paras.en: “It gave Flávio’s campaign a simple slogan,” said Luciano da Ros, a Brazilian political scientist. “And it united different segments on the right around a powerful common enemy.”
paras.zh: 巴西政治学家卢西亚诺·达罗斯（ Luciano da Ros ）说： “这给了弗拉维奥的竞选活动一个简单的口号。“它将右翼的不同派别团结在一个强大的共同敌人周围。”

paras.en: Mr. Lula, eager to shield his campaign, has tried to distance himself from Justice Moraes. “Nobody is above the law,” he said in an interview. He urged an investigation into the justice’s conduct and a broad judicial overhaul.

A number of right-wing leaders have recently swept into power in Latin America, riding a wave of dissatisfaction with incumbent governments and deepening worries about security and a rising cost of living.

Until now, Brazil, the region’s largest nation, had been the exception. The left-wing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, began his third nonconsecutive term in 2023. His predecessor and rival, Jair Bolsonaro, had been convicted of trying to stage a coup to prevent Mr. Lula from taking office and was sentenced to 27 years, which he is currently serving under house arrest for health reasons.

Now Mr. Lula, weighed down by widespread perceptions of rising crime and economic woes, faces a challenge from the former president’s son, Flávio Bolsonaro, a right-wing senator. Mr. Bolsonaro’s formidable performance in the first voting round this month gave him the edge going into a two-way contest.
The outcome will have a profound effect on Brazil and its relations with the United States in particular. Here are some of the major issues at stake.
Mr. Bolsonaro has already said he would add Brazil to the Trump administration’s anti-cartel coalition, called the Shield of the Americas, and work with the United States to fight Brazilian gangs.

He suggested in social media posts last year that he would welcome U.S. military intervention in Brazil, though he denied that in recent interviews, saying the cooperation would be limited to intelligence. But it was Mr. Bolsonaro who successfully lobbied Mr. Trump to designate two Brazilian gangs as terrorist groups.
Mr. Lula has resisted joining the coalition, warning that intertwining too closely with the United States on security matters could threaten the nation’s sovereignty.

The Trump administration imposed tariffs on Brazilian products in an unsuccessful pressure campaign to disrupt the prosecution of Jair Bolsonaro. Many of those tariffs were eventually scaled back, and Brazil’s economy has remained largely unharmed by President Trump’s tariff campaign.

Another term for Mr. Lula, however, would increase the risk of more economic conflicts with the United States that might hurt the Brazilian economy. Of course, Mr. Bolsonaro would not be immune to those problems; Mr. Trump has been known to levy tariffs against allies as well as adversaries.

The Trump administration has signaled an interest in importing Brazilian oil to counter disruptions related to the Iran war and the country’s rare-earth minerals to reduce U.S. dependence on China for those resources. Mr. Bolsonaro is expected to align Brazil more closely with the United States than Mr. Lula has on trade issues, but neither leader can afford to anger China, a major trading partner.
The election could also affect Brazil’s ability to negotiate trade with the United States as a bloc with other countries in the region.

“Brazil’s relations with its neighbors have been extremely challenging,” said Carolina Moehlecke, an assistant professor of international relations at Getúlio Vargas Foundation, a research institution. This was especially true of its neighbor, Argentina, she added, whose right-wing president is a close ally of Mr. Trump. Mr. Bolsonaro, she said, might have an easier time cooperating with fellow right-wing leaders in Latin America.

If Mr. Bolsonaro carries the vote, conservationists fear a return to his father’s policies of allowing rapid deforestation in the Amazon rainforest, a trend that was largely reversed under President Lula. The younger Mr. Bolsonaro does not believe that climate change is caused by humans and has defended opening up protected lands to mining and farming.

He has also pledged to stem the nation’s rising debt. If he attempts to accomplish that through cuts to public spending, that could prove politically sensitive, Ms. Moehlecke said, especially when it comes to social welfare policies with broad popularity in Brazil. In the lead-up to Sunday’s elections, Mr. Lula had promised to increase welfare payments.

Mr. Lula has framed the election as a test of the nation’s democracy and portrays the Bolsonaros as a threat to democratic institutions. Ms. Moehlecke said it was likely Mr. Bolsonaro would take the country in a more authoritarian direction, though his rhetoric is generally tamer than his father’s.

But if Mr. Bolsonaro wins, his party’s gains in the legislature could allow him to deliver on some of his most polarizing promises: amnesty for his father, pardons for rioters who stormed Brazil’s halls of power after the last election, and a Senate more willing to try to remove justices who convicted his father.

If Mr. Lula wins, he most likely will face significant checks against his power. Right-wing candidates, including four other members of the Bolsonaro family, have made significant strides in the nation’s legislative races.

articles.title: Jack Antonoff Was ‘Worried’ About Performing Songs He Wrote for Margaret Qualley Following Split
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: In the words of his longtime friend and collaborator Taylor Swift, Jack Antonoff can do it with a broken heart. Following his split from Margaret Qualley, the Bleachers frontman opened up to The Guardian in an interview published Sunday (Oct. 25) about his plans to keep performing songs about his ex, no matter how painful they are to sing.
paras.zh: 用他长期的朋友和合作者泰勒·斯威夫特（ Taylor Swift ）的话来说，杰克·安东诺夫（ Jack Antonoff ）可以用一颗破碎的心做到这一点。在与Margaret Qualley分道扬镳之后， Bleachers乐队的主唱在周日（ 10月25日）发表的一次采访中向《卫报》敞开了大门，谈到他计划继续表演关于他的前任的歌曲，无论他们唱得多么痛苦。

paras.en: When asked about whether recent events in his personal life have tempted him to switch up the setlist on his ongoing Bleachers Forever Tour, Antonoff began, “Oh, I can imagine what you’re going to say: It’s bizarre.”
paras.zh: 当被问及他个人生活中最近发生的事件是否促使他改变正在进行的 Bleachers Forever 巡演的曲目时，安东诺夫开始说道：“哦，我可以想象你会说什么：这很奇怪。”

paras.en: “I obviously was really worried about this specific thing,” he continued candidly. “I sat long and hard with it and thought: ‘If I change the setlist …,’ and in my gut there was a unanimous jury that said, ‘No, this is the deal.’ The deal I’ve made with my audience is that I’m going to tell you honestly how I feel and I’m going to risk at any moment having to stand behind it for f–king ever.”
paras.zh: “显然我真的很担心这件事，”他坦诚地继续说道。 “我苦苦地坐了很长时间，想：‘如果我改变歌单……’，在我的内心深处，有一个一致的陪审团说，‘不，就这么定了。’我与观众达成的协议是，我将诚实地告诉你们我的感受，并且我随时都会冒着永远支持它的风险。”

paras.en: The chart-topping producer added that “it’s actually been really beautiful” to perform songs about his past relationship to his fans, knowing that they’re aware of his change in circumstances. “For people to come together, to know what I write a song about, to know how that must feel for me now, to know what that song means to you as an audience member, to just hold it all and sort of celebrate … I would rather live through something publicly than even escape it privately.”
paras.zh: 这位位居排行榜榜首的制作人补充说，演唱有关他过去与歌迷的关系的歌曲“实际上真的很美”，因为知道他们知道他情况的变化。 “让人们聚集在一起，了解我写的一首歌的内容，了解我现在的感受，了解这首歌对作为观众的你意味着什么，只是持有这一切并进行庆祝……我宁愿公开经历一些事情，也不愿私下逃避它。”

paras.en: It was first reported in July that Antonoff and Qualley had split after about three years of marriage. Prior to tying the knot in New Jersey with a number of celebrities (Swift included) in attendance, they’d dated for about a year before reportedly getting engaged in the first half of 2022.
paras.zh: 据7月份首次报道， Antonoff和Qualley在结婚约三年后分手。在新泽西州与一些名人（包括Swift ）结盟之前，他们约会了大约一年，据报道在2022年上半年订婚。

paras.en: At press time, it seems that neither Antonoff nor the Substance star have filed to legally end their marriage. “There was no infidelity or anything outside of respect and partnership in this relationship,” a rep for Qualley told E! News following news of their separation, adding the pair still “have deep love and care for one another.”
paras.zh: 截至发稿时，安东诺夫和物质明星似乎都没有提出合法结束婚姻的申请。 “在这段关系中，不存在不忠或任何超出尊重和伙伴关系的事情，”奎利的一位代表告诉 E!继他们分居的消息传出后，补充说两人仍然“深爱着彼此”。

paras.en: Antonoff did not name specific songs to The Guardian, but tracks such as “You and Forever” — the music video for which starred Qualley — and “Tiny Moves” are likely to have taken on a new meaning for the bandleader as he performs them at Bleachers shows. He previously joked with fans at a show in Los Angeles in September, telling a fan who’d requested 2017 love song “Let’s Get Married,” “Read the news, brother.”
paras.zh: 安东诺夫没有为《卫报》命名具体的歌曲，但“You and Forever” （由Qualley主演的音乐视频）和“Tiny Moves”等歌曲很可能在Bleachers演出时为乐队领队带来了新的含义。他此前曾于9月在洛杉矶的一场表演中与粉丝开玩笑，告诉一位要求2017年情歌“让我们结婚”的粉丝， “读新闻，兄弟。”

paras.en: “I don’t give a f–k any more,” Antonoff added in the new interview of online commentary, on his relationship or otherwise. “It’s like, the very act of engaging negatively on the internet is inarguably such a f–king low-vibrational joke, and I think artists for too long over the past decade have read into it and there’s less than nothing there.”
paras.zh: “我不再在乎了，”安东诺夫在网上评论的新采访中补充道，无论是关于他的关系还是其他方面。“这就像，在互联网上消极参与的行为无疑是一个低振动的笑话，我认为艺术家在过去十年中已经阅读了太久，那里几乎没有任何东西。”

articles.title: Beyoncé Explains Why Even People Who ‘Can’t Stand’ Her Music Like Her Hair-Care Products
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: Beyoncé’s Cécred has quickly become a blockbuster hair-care brand since its introduction in February 2024. Led by the formidable $56 Edge Drops serum, the pop supernova is basking in the early success of her line, which was decades in the making.
paras.zh: 自2024年2月推出以来， Beyoncé的Cécred已迅速成为轰动一时的护发品牌。在强大的$ 56 Edge Drops精华液的带领下，流行超新星正沐浴在她几十年来酝酿的早期成功系列中。

paras.en: Bey graces the latest cover of i-D and a portion of the interview published on Monday (Oct. 26) found the Grammy-winning artist detailing the “fulfilling” experience of bringing Cécred to fruition.
paras.zh: Bey 为 i-D 的最新封面增光添彩，周一（10 月 26 日）发表的部分采访显示，这位格莱美获奖艺术家详细介绍了将 Cécred 付诸实践的“充实”经历。

paras.en: “My mother and I poured decades of experience, tradition, and love into Cécred, so seeing our community grow across every ethnicity, texture, generation and gender is so fulfilling,” she said. “In the beginning, it took some conditioning from the world’s perception of how to launch a brand founded by someone like me.”
paras.zh: “我和我的母亲将数十年的经验、传统和爱倾注在 Cécred 身上，因此看到我们的社区在各个种族、质地、世代和性别中不断发展，我们感到非常满足，”她说。 “一开始，世界对如何推出一个由像我这样的人创立的品牌的看法进行了一些调整。”

paras.en: Beyoncé continued to quip that the products are so effective that even her haters are lining up to buy them.
paras.zh: 碧昂斯继续打趣说，这些产品非常有效，甚至连她的讨厌者也在排队购买。

paras.en: “I’m the founder, visionary and sole investor — not the face or model for this brand,” she added. “I had a vision to build something that solved real problems and performed so incredibly that the people who can’t stand my music still use Cécred, haaaa! … because it works.”
paras.zh: “我是创始人、有远见的人和唯一投资者，而不是这个品牌的代言人或模特，”她补充道。 “我的愿景是打造一款能够解决实际问题并且表现出色的产品，让那些无法忍受我的音乐的人仍然使用 Cécred，哈哈哈！……因为它有效。”

paras.en: Beyoncé’s Cécred is exclusively available at Ulta Beauty. The products are primarily sold as part of the Foundation Collection, the Protection Collection and the Styling Collection.
paras.zh: Beyoncé的Cécred在Ulta Beauty独家提供。这些产品主要作为基础系列、保护系列和造型系列的一部分出售。

paras.en: While the Beyhive patiently awaits the rumored Act III, Beyoncé released the “Morning Dew (Donk) Remix” featuring her husband and rap mogul Jay-Z in August, which reached No. 26 on the July 18-dated Billboard Hot 100.
paras.zh: 当 Beyhive 耐心等待传闻中的第三幕时，碧昂丝在 8 月发布了与她的丈夫兼说唱大亨 Jay-Z 合作的“Morning Dew (Donk) Remix”，该歌曲在 7 月 18 日的 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜上排名第 26 位。

articles.title: Spotify Streaming Fraud Lawsuit That Claimed Drake Gets Billions of Fake Plays Dismissed by Judge
articles.author: Bill Donahue

paras.en: A class-action lawsuit claiming Spotify allows billions of fake bot streams of Drake and other stars has been dismissed again by a federal judge — this time for good.
paras.zh: 一项集体诉讼声称 Spotify 允许 Drake 和其他明星的数十亿虚假机器人流被联邦法官再次驳回——这一次是永久驳回。

paras.en: The case was filed last year by a rapper named RBX (Eric Collins), who accused the music streaming giant of turning a “blind eye” to the problem of streaming fraud by major artists, thus depriving tens of thousands of others of fair royalties.
paras.zh: 该案由一位名叫 RBX（埃里克·柯林斯饰）的说唱歌手去年提起，他指控这家音乐流媒体巨头对主要艺术家的流媒体欺诈问题“视而不见”，从而剥夺了数以万计的其他人的公平版税。

paras.en: Though the lawsuit was dismissed earlier this year as too “vague” to move forward, a judge gave RBX a chance to fix his case’s problems. But on Monday (Oct. 26), Judge Josephine Staton rejected the lawsuit with prejudice, meaning the litigation is now permanently over.
paras.zh: 尽管今年早些时候该诉讼因过于“模糊”而无法继续推进而被驳回，但法官给了 RBX 一个解决案件问题的机会。但周一（10 月 26 日），法官 Josephine Staton 带着偏见驳回了诉讼，这意味着诉讼现已永久结束。

paras.en: “Other than conclusory statements about Spotify turning a ‘blind eye’ to artificial streaming of tracks from popular artists like Drake, the [lawsuit] contains no other allegations about how Spotify selectively enforces its policies against artificial streaming,” Staton wrote in her ruling, obtained and first reported by Billboard.
paras.zh: 斯塔顿在《公告牌》获得并首先报道的裁决中写道：“除了关于 Spotify 对 Drake 等流行艺术家的人工流媒体歌曲‘视而不见’的结论性声明外，[诉讼]没有包含有关 Spotify 如何有选择地执行其反对人工流媒体政策的其他指控。”

paras.en: Streaming fraud — the use of illicit means to inflate song play totals — is a longstanding problem for the music business, made worse by the boom in artificial intelligence. And since royalties on digital services are divvied up among rights holders from a finite pie, such phony numbers siphon off revenue from legitimate streams.
paras.zh: 流媒体欺诈——使用非法手段夸大歌曲播放总数——是音乐行业长期存在的问题，人工智能的蓬勃发展使这一问题变得更加严重。由于数字服务的版税是在有限的蛋糕中由权利持有者分配的，因此此类虚假数字会从合法流中窃取收入。

paras.en: Spotify has said it heavily invests in systems to detect, remove and penalize fake streams, resulting in a “best-in-class system” to fight the problem.
