articles.title: The Canadian Artist Jean Paul Riopelle Was 'Completely Absorbed by the Act of Painting.' His Abstract Works Finally Have Their Own Home in a Quebec Museum

paras.en: Nearly 25 years after the death of one of Canada’s most celebrated modern artists, a brand-new pavilion at Quebec’s Musée National des Beaux-Arts is opening this week in his honor.
paras.zh: 加拿大最著名的现代艺术家之一去世近 25 年后，魁北克国家美术博物馆的一座全新展馆将于本周开放，以纪念他。

paras.en: The Espace Riopelle-Michael Audain Pavilion is named for the acclaimed Quebecois painter and sculptor Jean Paul Riopelle and Michael Audain, a philanthropist and co-founder of the Jean Paul Riopelle Foundation.
paras.zh: Espace Riopelle-Michael Audain 馆以著名的魁北克画家和雕塑家 Jean Paul Riopelle 和慈善家兼 Jean Paul Riopelle 基金会联合创始人 Michael Audain 的名字命名。

paras.en: Born in Montreal in 1923, Riopelle earned international recognition in the 20th century as an influential abstract expressionist. Riopelle’s unique “mosaic” style works, which he made by squeezing oil paint straight from the tube, then spreading it using a palette knife, gained particular renown.
paras.zh: 里奥佩尔 1923 年出生于蒙特利尔，作为 20 世纪颇具影响力的抽象表现主义画家而获得国际认可。里奥佩尔独特的“马赛克”风格的作品，他通过直接从管子中挤出油画颜料，然后用调色刀将其涂抹而制成，获得了特别的声誉。

paras.en: Riopelle was a key member of the Automatistes, a radical artistic movement founded in Quebec in the 1940s that was influenced by French surrealists and automatism, a philosophy of creating art without conscious thought. In 1948, the group published a controversial manifesto called Le Refus Global, or Total Refusal, which sought to shatter apart stodgy Quebecois culture with exhortations like: “Make way for magic! Make way for objective enigmas! Make way for love! Make way for what is needed!”
paras.zh: Riopelle 是 Automatistes 的重要成员，Automatistes 是 20 世纪 40 年代在魁北克创立的激进艺术运动，受到法国超现实主义者和自动主义的影响，自动主义是一种在没有意识思考的情况下创造艺术的哲学。 1948年，该组织发表了一份颇具争议的宣言，名为“Le Refus Global”或“全面拒绝”，旨在粉碎古板的魁北克文化，其劝告包括：“为魔法让路！为客观的谜题让路！为爱让路！为需要的东西让路！”

paras.en: Riopelle’s style was devoted to radical abstraction and spur-of-the-moment, unconscious creation—an ethos immortalized in his diverse array of art works, spanning his more than 50-year career.
paras.zh: Riopelle 的风格致力于激进的抽象和即兴、无意识的创作——这种精神在他 50 多年的职业生涯中的各种艺术作品中得到了永垂不朽。

paras.en: “I paint all in one go, without stopping, whether it’s one canvas or ten, without wondering when it began or when it’ll end, completely absorbed by the act of painting,” Riopelle said, per a statement from the museum. “I have no idea if an hour has gone by, or a whole night!”
paras.zh: 根据博物馆的一份声明，里奥佩尔说：“我一口气画完，不停歇，无论是一张画布还是十张画布，都不知道它何时开始或何时结束，完全沉浸在绘画行为中。” “我不知道是一个小时过去了，还是一整夜过去了！”

paras.en: Riopelle’s vast body of work and artistic legacy now have a permanent home at the museum in Quebec City. The $61-million gallery, built with architectural nods to the artist’s home studio, comprises three stories and nearly 54,000 square-feet. It overlooks both the Plains of Abraham and the St. Lawrence River. With more than 130 of his works on display, the museum is officially home to the largest public Riopelle collection in the world.
paras.zh: 里奥佩尔的大量作品和艺术遗产现在在魁北克市的博物馆中拥有永久的家。这座耗资 6100 万美元的画廊的建筑风格是向艺术家的家庭工作室致敬，共有三层楼，面积近 54,000 平方英尺。它俯瞰亚伯拉罕平原和圣劳伦斯河。该博物馆展出了他的 130 多幅作品，是世界上最大的里奥佩尔公共收藏的正式所在地。

paras.en: “Riopelle finally has a space entirely dedicated to him,” Jean-Luc Murray, the museum’s director, tells the Art Newspaper’s Hadani Ditmars. “The [museum] has long wanted to showcase his work while making it more accessible, and the Espace Riopelle-Michael Audain Pavilion does so brilliantly.”
paras.zh: “里奥佩尔终于拥有了一个完全属于他的空间，”博物馆馆长让-吕克·穆雷 (Jean-Luc Murray) 告诉《艺术报》的哈达尼·迪特马斯 (Hadani Ditmars)。 “[博物馆]长期以来一直希望展示他的作品，同时让其更容易接近，而 Espace Riopelle-Michael Audain 展馆做得非常出色。”

paras.en: The pavilion opens with four inaugural exhibitions that engage with Riopelle’s art and life in different ways. The primary show, “Riopelle: The Expression of Gesture,” is a permanent retrospective of Riopelle’s career, divided into seven themes on his constant artistic evolution. These include early works from his Automatiste era, 1950s mosaic works, depictions of bestiaries, prints of Quebec’s natural landscape and murals he created later in his life.
paras.zh: 展馆以四个开幕展览开幕，以不同的方式展示里奥佩尔的艺术和生活。主要展览“里奥佩尔：姿态的表达”是对里奥佩尔职业生涯的永久回顾，分为七个主题，展示他不断的艺术演变。其中包括他 Automatiste 时代的早期作品、20 世纪 50 年代的马赛克作品、动物寓言的描绘、魁北克自然景观的版画以及他晚年创作的壁画。

paras.en: “[Riopelle is] arguably Canada’s most internationally known artist,” Audain tells the Art Newspaper. “He broke new ground by painting the landscape in a way that no one had ever painted it before … I think the most important and innovative aspect of Riopelle’s work was disaggregating the landscape and reducing it to strokes of a palette knife.”
paras.zh: “[里奥佩尔]可以说是加拿大最国际知名的艺术家，”奥丹告诉《艺术新闻》。 “他以一种前所未有的方式描绘风景，开辟了新天地……我认为里奥佩尔作品中最重要和最具创新性的方面是分解风景并将其简化为调色刀的笔触。”

paras.en: The other three exhibitions shed light on Riopelle’s relationships, affiliations and perceptions. “Challenging: Modern Art in Quebec” features works by some 50 Quebecois modern artists, including other members of the Automatistes. In “Art and Emotions” visitors will be able to share the feelings evoked by Riopelle’s works in real-time in an effort to help the museum “design new artificial intelligence-based tools to personalize exhibition pathways,” according to the exhibition’s online description.
paras.zh: 其他三个展览揭示了里奥佩尔的人际关系、从属关系和看法。 “挑战：魁北克现代艺术”展出了约 50 名魁北克现代艺术家的作品，其中包括 Automatistes 的其他成员。根据展览的在线描述，在“艺术与情感”中，参观者将能够实时分享里奥佩尔作品所唤起的感受，以帮助博物馆“设计新的基于人工智能的工具来个性化展览路径”。

paras.en: Finally, the gallery will have a specially designed space for Riopelle’s largest work, a 130-foot-long work composed of 30 paintings. Entitled Tribute to Rosa Luxemburg, he created the wall-spanning masterpiece over a period of three months in 1992 following the death of Joan Mitchell, Riopelle’s partner of roughly 20 years.
paras.zh: 最后，画廊将为Riopelle最大的作品专门设计一个空间，这是一件由30幅画组成的130英尺长的作品。 1992 年，里奥佩尔大约 20 年的伴侣琼·米切尔去世后，他花了三个月的时间创作了这部名为《向罗莎·卢森堡致敬》的杰作。

paras.en: “After he experimented with sculpture, his paintings changed because he explored form in a different way,” André Gilbert, the new pavilion’s curator, tells La Presse’s Jean Siag. “Riopelle took lots of risks. He painted his Rosa fresco using stencils and spray paint, the tools of graffiti artists. It feels as if we’re dealing with five or six artists at once.”
paras.zh: “在他尝试雕塑之后，他的画作发生了变化，因为他以不同的方式探索形式，”新馆馆长安德烈·吉尔伯特告诉《新闻报》的让·西格。 “里奥佩尔冒了很多风险。他使用模板和喷漆（涂鸦艺术家的工具）绘制了《罗莎》壁画。感觉就像我们同时与五六位艺术家打交道。”

articles.title: One in Four Cases of Depression Could Be Caused by a Dysregulated Body Clock, Study Says

paras.en: One in four people with depression could have a newly identified subtype called “circadian depression” caused by a dysregulated body clock, suggests a new study.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究表明，四分之一的抑郁症患者可能患有一种新发现的亚型，称为“昼夜节律抑郁症”，这是由生物钟失调引起的。

paras.en: The work, published in the British Journal of Psychiatry on October 21, deepens our understanding of depression and could lead to more effective intervention and treatment for people affected by this subtype.
paras.zh: 这项研究于 10 月 21 日发表在《英国精神病学杂志》上，加深了我们对抑郁症的理解，并可能为受这种亚型影响的人带来更有效的干预和治疗。

paras.en: “Depression is not a uniform illness, and understanding the characteristics of different subtypes means that we can give people earlier access to treatments that will be most effective for them,” says study co-author Emiliana Tonini to Lauren Roberts at the Australian Broadcasting Corporation.
paras.zh: “抑郁症并不是一种统一的疾病，了解不同亚型的特征意味着我们可以让人们更早地获得对他们最有效的治疗，”研究合著者埃米利亚娜·托尼尼对澳大利亚广播公司的劳伦·罗伯茨说。

paras.en: However, the study also had several limitations, and outside experts say that more research is needed before circadian depression can be classified as a subtype.
paras.zh: 然而，这项研究也有一些局限性，外部专家表示，在将昼夜节律抑郁症归类为亚型之前，还需要进行更多研究。

paras.en: To conduct the study, Tonini and her colleagues surveyed more than 11,000 Australians of European descent with severe depression and asked them about their sleep patterns, tiredness and other characteristics. The participants also provided saliva samples.
paras.zh: 为了进行这项研究，托尼尼和她的同事调查了超过 11,000 名患有严重抑郁症的欧洲裔澳大利亚人，并询问他们的睡眠模式、疲劳程度和其他特征。参与者还提供了唾液样本。

paras.en: The researchers found that 2,604 people met at least three of the researchers’ criteria for circadian depression: morning sleepiness, delayed sleep timing, social jet lag, excessive sleeping during depressive episodes and seasonality.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，2,604 人至少符合研究人员的昼夜节律抑郁标准中的三个：早晨嗜睡、睡眠时间延迟、社交时差、抑郁发作期间睡眠过多以及季节性。

paras.en: “It’s not only about the quantity or the amount of sleep, it’s really about the rhythm and the regularity of sleep,” Tonini explains to Alice Klein at New Scientist.
paras.zh: “这不仅与睡眠的数量或时间长短有关，还与睡眠的节奏和规律有关，”托尼尼向《新科学家》杂志的爱丽丝·克莱因解释道。

paras.en: Did you know? Sleep plays a role in longevity
paras.zh: 你可知道？睡眠在长寿中发挥着重要作用

paras.en: - A study published in December 2025 found a strong correlation between sleep and life span. The researchers discovered that sleep—more than diet, exercise and social connections—could predict life expectancy.
paras.zh: - 2025 年 12 月发表的一项研究发现，睡眠与寿命之间存在很强的相关性。研究人员发现，睡眠比饮食、锻炼和社交关系更能预测预期寿命。

paras.en: The team also found that those with the subtype had higher genetic risk factors for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and mood disorders, as well as “a series of metabolic and inflammatory markers,” says Tonini to Donna Lu at the Guardian. That suggests that with circadian depression, “there is an underlying biology that is quite distinct from other forms of depression.”
paras.zh: 托尼尼对《卫报》的唐娜·卢说，研究小组还发现，患有这种亚型的人有更高的注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）和情绪障碍的遗传风险因素，以及“一系列代谢和炎症标志物”。这表明，昼夜节律抑郁症“存在一种与其他形式的抑郁症截然不同的潜在生物学原理。”

paras.en: Those with circadian depression tended to have more severe mental health symptoms that began at a younger age compared to those with non-circadian depression. They were also less likely to respond to standard antidepressants like selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), which include drugs such as Prozac.
paras.zh: 与非昼夜节律抑郁症患者相比，昼夜节律抑郁症患者往往会出现更严重的心理健康症状，而且这些症状在较年轻的时候就开始出现。他们也不太可能对标准抗抑郁药产生反应，例如选择性血清素再摄取抑制剂（SSRI），其中包括百忧解等药物。

paras.en: “One of the things I hate most in the depression world is the name ‘treatment-resistant depression’—as if, if you failed two SSRIs or an SNRI, somehow your depression won’t respond. When really, you’ve been on the wrong track since the start,” says study co-author Ian Hickie, a psychiatrist at the University of Sydney, to Euan Black at the Financial Review. For people with this subtype of depression, drugs that target the circadian system are more likely to be effective, he suggests.
paras.zh: “在抑郁症领域，我最讨厌的事情之一就是‘难治性抑郁症’这个名字——就好像，如果你两次 SSRIs 或一次 SNRI 治疗失败，你的抑郁症就会以某种方式不起作用。事实上，你从一开始就走在了错误的道路上，”该研究的合著者、悉尼大学精神病学家伊恩·希基 (Ian Hickie) 在《金融评论》上对尤安·布莱克 (Euan Black) 说道。他建议，对于患有这种抑郁症亚型的人来说，针对昼夜节律系统的药物可能更有效。

paras.en: The findings are “really useful because they advance the field in terms of understanding the whole circadian rhythm aspect of depression and how it might be related to biological measures like genetics and inflammatory markers,” says Colleen Loo, a clinical psychiatrist at the University of New South Wales who wasn’t involved in the work, to New Scientist.
paras.zh: 未参与这项工作的新南威尔士大学临床精神病学家科琳·卢 (Colleen Loo) 向《新科学家》表示，这些发现“非常有用，因为它们在理解抑郁症的整个昼夜节律方面以及它如何与遗传学和炎症标记物等生物学指标相关方面推动了该领域的发展”。

paras.en: However, they also have several limitations. For one, the study is based on self-reported data about symptoms, Loo tells Rachel Fieldhouse at Nature, so more work is needed to establish the connection between circadian rhythm and depression.
paras.zh: 然而，它们也有一些局限性。首先，这项研究是基于自我报告的症状数据，卢告诉《自然》杂志的雷切尔·菲尔德豪斯，因此需要做更多的工作来建立昼夜节律和抑郁症之间的联系。

paras.en: The study’s sample size was also limited to people with European ancestry; future work needs to look at people from other populations. Andrew Coogan, a behavioral neuroscientist at Maynooth University in Ireland who wasn’t involved in the work, tells the Guardian that the proposed subtype has a “lack of detail as to how the cluster of features of, and the criteria for, the proposed circadian subtype of depression was arrived at.”
paras.zh: 该研究的样本量也仅限于有欧洲血统的人。未来的工作需要关注其他人群。爱尔兰梅努斯大学的行为神经科学家安德鲁·库根（Andrew Coogan）没有参与这项工作，他告诉《卫报》，拟议的亚型“缺乏关于如何得出拟议的抑郁症昼夜节律亚型的特征集和标准的细节”。

paras.en: “The results of this exploratory study are best interpreted as initial if interesting findings that warrant further examination,” he adds.
paras.zh: “这项探索性研究的结果最好被解释为初步的、有趣的发现，值得进一步检查，”他补充道。

articles.title: This Mysterious Medieval Manuscript Has Stumped Scholars for Well Over a Century. Could Its Pages Have Been Bound Out of Order This Whole Time?

paras.en: The Voynich Manuscript has been baffling researchers for over a century. Housed at Yale University’s Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library, it is, on its surface, a handwritten and illustrated manuscript likely from 16th-century Europe. But no one (including artificial intelligence) has successfully deciphered its script, a language or code so unique that it has been dubbed “Voynichese.”
paras.zh: 一个多世纪以来，伏尼契手稿一直让研究人员感到困惑。它位于耶鲁大学的拜内克稀有书籍和手稿图书馆，表面上是一份手写和插图的手稿，可能来自16世纪的欧洲。但没有人（包括人工智能）成功破译了它的脚本，这种语言或代码如此独特，以至于它被称为“Voynichese”。

paras.en: As it turns out, there might be another reason why experts are unable to make sense of the Voynich Manuscript. According to a study recently published in the journal Digital Medievalist, there is “strong evidence” that the manuscript’s pages are incorrectly bound.
paras.zh: 事实证明，专家们无法理解伏尼契手稿的原因可能还有另一个。根据最近发表在《数字中世纪主义者》杂志上的一项研究，有“强有力的证据”表明手稿的页面装订不正确。

paras.en: While the manuscript is currently bound as a quire—several pages folded and sewn together to form a booklet—the study suggests it was originally designed as “a collection of individual bifolia,” or sheets folded in half to form two pages and stacked up and “meant to be read in sequence.”
paras.zh: 虽然这份手稿目前被装订成一本小册子——几页折叠并缝在一起形成一本小册子——但研究表明，它最初被设计为“一本单独的双叶书集”，即对折形成两页并堆叠起来的纸张，“旨在按顺序阅读”。

paras.en: “This means that any research that relies on the current sequence of pages needs to be revisited, since the manuscript is out of order,” study co-author Lisa Fagin Davis, the executive director of the Medieval Academy of America, tells Gizmodo’s Gayoung Lee.
paras.zh: “这意味着任何依赖当前页面顺序的研究都需要重新审视，因为手稿的顺序已经乱了，”研究合著者、美国中世纪学院执行主任丽莎·法金·戴维斯 (Lisa Fagin Davis) 告诉 Gizmodo 的 Gayoung Lee。

paras.en: The Voynich Manuscript is named for Polish-American bookseller Wilfrid Voynich, who purchased the text from a Jesuit college in Italy in 1912. It was bequeathed and sold a few times before ending up at Yale in 1969.
paras.zh: 《伏尼契手稿》以波兰裔美国书商威尔弗里德·伏尼契 (Wilfrid Voynich) 的名字命名，他于 1912 年从意大利的一所耶稣会学院购买了该手稿。该手稿被遗赠并出售了几次，最终于 1969 年在耶鲁大学出售。

paras.en: The book’s pages are made of vellum, or calf skin, which has been carbon dated to the early 1400s; its earliest recorded owner lived in Germany in the late 1500s. The manuscript’s 240 pages are filled with colorful illustrations and lines of carefully inked, repetitive letters with a passing resemblance to modern Western alphabets.
paras.zh: 这本书的书页由牛皮纸或小牛皮制成，经碳测年可追溯到 1400 年代初期；有记载的最早主人生活在 1500 年代末的德国。这份 240 页的手稿充满了色彩缤纷的插图和精心涂墨的重复字母，与现代西方字母有些相似。

paras.en: “It could be a code, a lost language, nonsense or something else entirely,” Davis tells Gizmodo. “The illustrations are equally bizarre, with fantastical plants, astronomical and zodiacal diagrams, bathing women and other illustrations that are not interpretable yet.”
paras.zh: “它可能是一种代码、一种失落的语言、胡言乱语或完全是其他东西，”戴维斯告诉 Gizmodo。 “这些插图同样奇异，有奇幻的植物、天文和黄道图、沐浴的女人以及其他尚无法解释的插图。”

paras.en: Davis has studied the Voynich Manuscript before. In 2020, she concluded that five different scribes created the text. The differences between these scribes’ writing styles was key to the recent study, co-authored by Colin Layfield, an information scientist at the University of Malta.
paras.zh: 戴维斯之前研究过伏尼契手稿。 2020 年，她得出结论，该文本是由五位不同的抄写员创作的。马耳他大学信息科学家科林·雷菲尔德 (Colin Layfield) 与人合着的最新研究的关键是这些抄写员写作风格之间的差异。

paras.en: Building on a paper from May, Davis and Layfield applied latent semantic analysis, a technique that can compare "any two pieces of text and derive a similarity score based on the words that are present and how related they are to one another and how they are used in general,” per the study.
paras.zh: 根据这项研究，戴维斯和雷菲尔德在 5 月发表的一篇论文的基础上应用了潜在语义分析，这种技术可以比较“任何两段文本，并根据出现的单词、它们彼此之间的相关程度以及它们的一般使用方式得出相似度分数”。

paras.en: Looks for patterns and similarities among the text’s symbols, they found that the pages of the manuscript alternate illogically in penmanship. One page will be written by one scribe, the next page by another, and so on. It doesn’t match the normal medieval manuscript creation process.
paras.zh: 在寻找文本符号之间的模式和相似性时，他们发现手稿的页面在书写上不合逻辑地交替。一页将由一名抄写员书写，下一页将由另一位抄写员书写，依此类推。它与正常的中世纪手稿创作过程不符。

paras.en: “Typically a single scribe writes in a quire ‘booklet,’ but the current binding has different scribes in the same quire, which, to be blunt, is simply not [how it is] done,” Layfield tells Gizmodo.
paras.zh: “通常由一个抄写员在一本奎尔‘小册子’中书写，但当前的装订在同一个奎尔中有不同的抄写员，坦率地说，这根本就不是[如何]完成的，”雷菲尔德告诉Gizmodo。

paras.en: There were other oddities, too, such as a large water stain on the top of the book that doesn’t appear symmetrically on concurrent pages, Davis tells Live Science’s Kristina Killgrove.
paras.zh: 戴维斯告诉《生活科学》的克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫，还有其他奇怪的地方，比如书的顶部有一个大水渍，但在并发页面上却没有对称地出现。

paras.en: Also, she adds, “there are several examples where the image goes off the page in the middle and comes out on the other side, even though there are a bunch of pages in between.”
paras.zh: 此外，她补充道，“有几个例子，图像从中间脱离页面并出现在另一侧，即使中间有一堆页面。”

paras.en: It all suggests that the Voynich Manuscript was supposed to be “a collection of individual bifolia meant to be read in sequence,” per the study. At some point, those bifolia were incorrectly nested together.
paras.zh: 根据这项研究，这一切都表明伏尼契手稿应该是“一本旨在按顺序阅读的个体双叶书的集合”。在某些时候，这些双叶植物被错误地嵌套在一起。

paras.en: “Once you treat them as loose pages stacked together, all these artistic anomalies suddenly join up,” Layfield tells the Guardian’s Philip Oltermann.
paras.zh: “一旦你将它们视为堆叠在一起的松散页面，所有这些艺术异常就会突然结合在一起，”雷菲尔德告诉卫报的菲利普·奥尔特曼。

paras.en: There are still a lot of unknowns surrounding the Voynich Manuscript. The letters, or symbols, remain undeciphered. Experts have theorized that scribes purposefully encoded the text to keep it secret, or that they were attempting to put a written script to a mysterious language that was only ever spoken. Others believe the whole book is a hoax, written in gibberish by a medieval con man to dupe collectors.
paras.zh: 伏尼契手稿仍有很多未知之处。这些字母或符号仍然无法破译。专家推测，抄写员故意对文本进行编码以保密，或者他们试图将书面文字写入一种仅被使用过的神秘语言。其他人则认为整本书是一个骗局，是一个中世纪骗子用胡言乱语写的，目的是欺骗收藏家。

paras.en: “I think it’s likely we are looking … at an object that was made by a community that wanted to pass its knowledge forward,” Davis tells the Guardian. She says that some of the manuscript’s illustrations suggest its content relates to female sexuality and reproduction, as previous studies have suggested.
paras.zh: 戴维斯告诉《卫报》：“我认为我们正在寻找……一个由想要传播知识的社区制作的物品。”她说，正如之前的研究表明的那样，手稿的一些插图表明其内容与女性性行为和生殖有关。

paras.en: The new research may give experts a new edge in their efforts to decipher the vexing manuscript, whose very existence may be owed to the person who incorrectly compiled it.
paras.zh: 这项新研究可能会给专家们破译这份令人烦恼的手稿带来新的优势，这份手稿的存在可能要归功于错误编译它的人。

paras.en: “So few manuscripts have survived from the Middle Ages, because they weren’t bound,” Davis tells the Guardian. “The irony is that whoever misbound this manuscript still did us a huge favor by ensuring its survival.”
paras.zh: “中世纪幸存下来的手稿很少，因为它们没有装订，”戴维斯告诉卫报。 “具有讽刺意味的是，无论谁装订错误，这份手稿仍然帮了我们一个大忙，确保了它的保存。”

articles.title: 6 Best Folding Phones (2026): Samsung, Apple, Google, Motorola
articles.author: Julian Chokkattu, Simon Hill

paras.en: You may be scoffing as you read this. The best folding phones? Really? Aren’t those just gimmicks? I'm here to tell you they're pretty darn useful. And yes, there are quite a few now (even Apple is in on the action), so you have options. Folding phones are an evolution of the traditional single-screen slab of glass we've all been using for nearly two decades.
paras.zh: 当你读到这里的时候，你可能会嗤之以鼻。最好的折叠手机？真的吗？这些不就是噱头吗？我来这里是想告诉你它们非常有用。是的，现在有很多（甚至苹果公司也在采取行动），所以你有选择。折叠手机是我们近二十年来一直使用的传统单屏玻璃板的演变。

paras.en: They largely come in two forms: a folding flip phone or a folding book-like phone, enabling you to either relive the glory days of small phones or expand your multitasking options while on the go. A folding phone is a personal decision—arguably even more than a traditional smartphone, since it hinges (heh) on what style you prefer. We have tested almost all of them, and these are our favorites.
paras.zh: 它们主要有两种形式：折叠式翻盖手机或折叠式书本式手机，使您能够重温小型手机的辉煌岁月，或在旅途中扩展您的多任务处理选项。折叠手机是个人决定，甚至可以说比传统智能手机更重要，因为它取决于（呵呵）你喜欢什么风格。我们测试了几乎所有这些，这些是我们最喜欢的。

paras.en: Check out our other mobile buying guides, including the Best Android Phones, Best iPhones, Best Cheap Phones, Best Samsung Phones, Best Google Pixel Phones, Best Motorola Phones, Best Phones With a Headphone Jack, and Best Phones You Can't Buy in the US.
paras.zh: 查看我们的其他手机购买指南，包括最佳 Android 手机、最佳 iPhone、最便宜手机、最佳三星手机、最佳 Google Pixel 手机、最佳摩托罗拉手机、带耳机插孔的最佳手机以及在美国买不到的最佳手机。

paras.en: Updated October 2026: We've added the Apple iPhone Duo, more on the Z Flip8 after testing, and updated prices.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月更新：我们在测试后添加了 Apple iPhone Duo、Z Flip8 的更多内容，并更新了价格。

paras.en: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra for $2,100: The Z Fold8 Ultra is a refined release with a 6.5-inch cover display that opens to an expansive 8-inch screen that feels like two 6.5-inch displays side by side. It's fast and smooth, with a 5,000-mAh battery, but it's the camera that earns it the “Ultra” title. It's an impressive combo, including a 200-megapixel main shooter, 50-megapixel ultrawide, and a 10-megapixel telephoto lens that supports 3X optical zoom. Sadly, it lacks Qi2 support for magnetic wireless charging, and the camera module makes it rock when lying flat on a surface. But the main reason it misses out on a place above is that the smaller Fold8 is so much easier to handle.
paras.zh: 三星 Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra 售价 2,100 美元：Z Fold8 Ultra 是一款精致的产品，配备 6.5 英寸盖板显示屏，打开后可看到广阔的 8 英寸屏幕，感觉就像两个并排的 6.5 英寸显示屏。它速度快、流畅，配备 5,000mAh 电池，但相机为其赢得了“Ultra”称号。这是一个令人印象深刻的组合，包括 200 兆像素主摄像头、50 兆像素超广角镜头和支持 3 倍光学变焦的 10 兆像素长焦镜头。遗憾的是，它缺乏对磁性无线充电的 Qi2 支持，并且相机模块使其平放在表面上时会晃动。但它未能跻身上述位置的主要原因是较小的 Fold8 更容易操作。

paras.en: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 for $1,200: If you want something compact, the Galaxy Z Flip8 is the lightest and thinnest flip phone in the world with a redesigned chassis, and it comes a close second to Motorola's Razr Ultra. It has a 4.1-inch cover screen, and it flips open to become a 6.9-inch candy bar. It's also more durable than ever and boasts the same excellent chipset and performance as Samsung's larger Fold models. The 4,300-mAh battery is solid, but the camera system is relatively basic, comprising a 50-megapixel main shooter backed by a 12-megapixel ultrawide.
paras.zh: 三星 Galaxy Z Flip8 售价 1,200 美元：如果您想要紧凑型手机，Galaxy Z Flip8 是世界上最轻、最薄的翻盖手机，其底盘经过重新设计，仅次于摩托罗拉的 Razr Ultra。它有一个4.1英寸的保护屏，翻开后就变成了一个6.9英寸的直板。它也比以往任何时候都更耐用，并拥有与三星更大的 Fold 型号相同的出色芯片组和性能。 4,300mAh 电池很坚固，但相机系统相对基本，包括一个 50MP 主摄像头和一个 12MP 超广角摄像头。

paras.en: Motorola Razr Fold for $1,900: The first book-style foldable from Motorola is good, but not great. The front screen feels very much like a normal phone, and you can open it to enjoy the vast 8.1-inch display inside. Sadly, the Razr Fold lacks the top-end processor of the year, which is disappointing at this price. The highlight is the massive 6,000-mAh battery, which can stretch to nearly three days of use. Thankfully, it does come with seven years of software updates (unlike Motorola's Flip family). Motorola has also added a telephoto lens to the capable, triple 50-MP camera. But, overall, we prefer Google's Pixel 11 Pro Fold.
paras.zh: 摩托罗拉 Razr Fold 售价 1,900 美元：摩托罗拉首款书本式可折叠手机虽然不错，但并不是很好。正面屏幕的感觉与普通手机非常相似，打开它即可欣赏内部巨大的 8.1 英寸显示屏。遗憾的是，Razr Fold 缺少了年度最高端的处理器，在这个价位上令人失望。亮点是 6,000mAh 的大电池，可持续使用近三天。值得庆幸的是，它确实附带了七年的软件更新（与摩托罗拉的 Flip 系列不同）。摩托罗拉还在功能强大的三重 50-MP 相机中添加了一个长焦镜头。但总的来说，我们更喜欢谷歌的 Pixel 11 Pro Fold。

paras.en: Motorola Razr+ 2026 for $1,100: The awkward middle child in the Razr lineup lacks the bells and whistles or top-notch specs of the Ultra, but still costs more than $1,000. You can get very close to the same experience from the cheaper Razr and save hundreds. Even battery life is unimpressive, because it has the smallest capacity of the Razr family. The cover glass isn’t the ceramic glass mixture as on the Razr Ultra. I found out the hard way after dropping the phone once, roughly a 4-foot drop onto asphalt, and the front screen shattered. Get a screen protector!
paras.zh: 摩托罗拉 Razr+ 2026 售价 1,100 美元：Razr 系列中尴尬的中间产品，缺乏 Ultra 的花哨功能或顶级规格，但价格仍然超过 1,000 美元。您可以从更便宜的 Razr 获得非常接近相同的体验，并节省数百美元。就连电池续航时间也并不令人印象深刻，因为它的容量是 Razr 系列中最小的。盖板玻璃不是 Razr Ultra 上的陶瓷玻璃混合物。有一次我把手机从大约 4 英尺高的地方摔到沥青上，然后前屏幕碎裂了，我才发现这一点。买个屏幕保护膜吧！

paras.en: Oppo Find N6 for $1,929: With an 8.12-inch internal display, the Find N6 is a beautifully engineered folding phone that’s impossibly slim and light. Despite its promise of being creaseless, the fold is still discernible. You’ll hardly notice it when the screen is on, though you’ll feel it if you use the optional stylus. Performance is impressively slick, with enough stamina to see you through a busy day, and the camera system is excellent. It’s a big step up from last year’s N5, with a 200-MP main shooter, 50-MP telephoto, and 50-MP ultrawide. The global model can use familiar Google apps, but you’ll have to import it, as this phone won’t officially be released in the West.
paras.zh: Oppo Find N6 售价 1,929 美元：Find N6 配备 8.12 英寸内部显示屏，是一款设计精美的折叠手机，纤薄轻巧。尽管它承诺无折痕，但褶皱仍然清晰可辨。当屏幕打开时，您几乎不会注意到它，但如果您使用可选的手写笔，您会感觉到它。性能令人印象深刻，有足够的耐力让您度过忙碌的一天，并且摄像系统非常出色。与去年的 N5 相比，这是一个很大的进步，配备了 200MP 主摄、50MP 长焦和 50MP 超广角。全球型号可以使用熟悉的谷歌应用程序，但你必须导入它，因为这款手机不会在西方正式发布。

paras.en: Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold for $1,799: The only reason to consider the Pixel 10 Pro Fold right now is if you see it on sale. Google's Pixel 11 Pro Fold is superior, but the 10 Pro Fold isn't far behind this year's release. It's still a reasonably slim device with a large front screen that feels like a normal phone, an excellent 8-inch inner screen, and a triple-camera system that delivers great results, though not as great as the Pixel 10 Pro series. Read our Best Pixel Phones guide for more.
paras.zh: 谷歌 Pixel 10 Pro Fold 售价 1,799 美元：现在考虑 Pixel 10 Pro Fold 的唯一原因是你看到它打折。谷歌的 Pixel 11 Pro Fold 更出色，但 10 Pro Fold 也不落后于今年发布的手机。它仍然是一款相当纤薄的设备，拥有感觉像普通手机一样的大前屏、出色的 8 英寸内屏以及可提供出色效果的三摄像头系统，尽管不如 Pixel 10 Pro 系列那么好。请阅读我们的最佳 Pixel 手机指南了解更多信息。

paras.en: Xiaomi Mix Flip for $899: Xiaomi’s first flip phone has a lovely design with excellent displays inside and out, long battery life with fast charging, and flagship-level performance. It also boasts a solid dual-lens camera, opting for telephoto instead of ultrawide alongside the capable main shooter, which is more useful for most folks. The software lets the party down a little; there’s no IP rating, and it is pricey, but I had fun with this flip phone.
paras.zh: 小米 Mix Flip 售价 899 美元：小米首款翻盖手机，设计可爱，内外显示屏出色，续航长、快充，旗舰级性能。它还拥有坚固的双镜头相机，选择长焦而不是超广角以及功能强大的主射手，这对大多数人来说更有用。该软件让聚会有点失望；没有IP等级，而且价格昂贵，但我对这款翻盖手机很感兴趣。

paras.en: Folding phones are more fragile than normal phones. Folding phones have more parts than a traditional smartphone, not to mention a hinge. Companies advertise how many folds these devices have been tested for—usually around 200,000 or 500,000 folds—but a single drop can be incredibly damaging. They are not as dust-resistant, and some aren't as water-resistant (only the Pixel 11 Pro Fold and iPhone Duo are IP68-rated in the US), so you'll want to be especially careful. Use a case, and it may be worth investing in the manufacturer's device care policy.
paras.zh: 折叠手机比普通手机更脆弱。折叠手机比传统智能手机拥有更多的部件，更不用说铰链了。公司宣传这些设备经过了多少次折叠测试——通常约为 200,000 或 500,000 次——但一次跌落可能会造成难以置信的损坏。它们不那么防尘，有些不那么防水（只有 Pixel 11 Pro Fold 和 iPhone Duo 在美国达到 IP68 级），因此您需要特别小心。使用保护壳，可能值得投资于制造商的设备保养政策。

paras.en: Don't remove the built-in screen protector. Most of these folding phones have a film over the inner screen. You might be tempted to remove it, but don't—it can damage the display. The packaging usually includes instructions not to remove it and how to care for your device.
paras.zh: 请勿取下内置屏幕保护膜。大多数折叠手机的内屏幕上都有一层薄膜。您可能想将其取下，但不要这样做，否则可能会损坏显示屏。包装上通常包含请勿拆卸包装以及如何保养设备的说明。

paras.en: There's a small learning curve to the software. Flip-style folding phones are fairly straightforward, but book-like folding phones that double as tablets have new multitasking tricks that will take some getting used to if you want to make the most of them. I recommend taking some time to run through these features so you understand how they work.
paras.zh: 该软件的学习曲线很小。翻盖式折叠手机相当简单，但兼作平板电脑的书本式折叠手机具有新的多任务处理技巧，如果您想充分利用它们，则需要一些时间来适应。我建议您花一些时间来浏览这些功能，以便您了解它们的工作原理。

paras.en: They're expensive. Do you need one? Nobody needs a folding phone. If you think you'll benefit from one, know they're frequently discounted during big sale events like Black Friday, and you can also knock a few hundred dollars off if you trade in an eligible device.
paras.zh: 它们很贵。您需要一个吗？没有人需要折叠手机。如果您认为自己会从中受益，请知道它们在黑色星期五等大型促销活动期间经常打折，如果您以旧换新符合条件的设备，还可以节省数百美元。

paras.en: Folding flip phones are for people who want a compact device. Think of a normal phone you can fold in half. That's pretty much what you get, plus a screen on the front to monitor widgets and texts. This does mean you can flip the phone to answer a call and flip it shut to end one—super cool. You can put the phone at a 90-degree angle, and some apps will adapt to show controls on the bottom and important details at the top, like in video calling apps or when watching videos on YouTube, though this depends on the phone. Folding flip phones typically have mediocre battery life, and their cameras aren't as good as their non-folding counterparts.
paras.zh: 折叠式翻盖手机适合那些想要紧凑型设备的人。想象一下可以对折的普通手机。这就是您所得到的，再加上前面的一个屏幕来监视小部件和文本。这确实意味着您可以翻转手机来接听电话，然后翻转手机来结束通话——超级酷。你可以将手机呈 90 度角，一些应用程序会适应在底部显示控件并在顶部显示重要细节，例如在视频通话应用程序中或在 YouTube 上观看视频时，尽管这取决于手机。折叠式翻盖手机的电池续航时间通常很一般，而且它们的相机也不如非折叠式手机好。

paras.en: Folding book-like phones are for people who want the big-screen experience. Are you constantly watching full-length movies on your phone? Or do you always find yourself jumping back and forth between two apps? Then these are for you. They have good battery life and better cameras (though not as good as non-folding phones), but they're far more expensive. These include the short-lived triple-screen folding devices like Samsung's Galaxy Z TriFold. They're thick and heavy, though we're seeing newer models that are surprisingly thin. Still, you may have a hard time fitting them in your pockets.
paras.zh: 像书一样的折叠手机适合那些想要大屏幕体验的人。您是否经常用手机观看完整长度的电影？或者您是否总是发现自己在两个应用程序之间来回切换？那么这些就是给你的。它们具有良好的电池寿命和更好的相机（尽管不如非折叠手机），但它们的价格要贵得多。其中包括短命的三屏折叠设备，例如三星的 Galaxy Z TriFold。它们又厚又重，尽管我们看到较新的型号却出奇的薄。不过，您可能很难将它们放入口袋中。

paras.en: If you're team Android, this is a good time to buy. Samsung and Google just updated their foldables, and Motorola released its first big foldable in the summer and won't announce the Razr 2027 lineup until the spring. For folks outside the US, we probably won't see new foldables from Honor or Oppo until the spring, too.
paras.zh: 如果您是 Android 团队，那么现在是购买的好时机。三星和谷歌刚刚更新了他们的可折叠手机，摩托罗拉在夏季发布了首款大型可折叠手机，直到春季才会发布 Razr 2027 系列。对于美国以外的人来说，我们可能要到春季才能看到 Honor 或 Oppo 的新可折叠产品。

paras.en: If you're considering an iPhone, Apple is likely to unveil a new folding phone soon, so you might want to wait and see what it looks like.
paras.zh: 如果你正在考虑购买 iPhone，苹果可能很快就会推出一款新的折叠手机，所以你可能想等等看它的外观。

paras.en: Whichever style you go for, my favorite feature of folding phones is the ability to see the viewfinder on the external screen and snap a selfie with the high-quality rear cameras—just set the phone down slightly folded so it stays upright, and there's usually a button you can click in the camera app to send the preview to the external screen. You can usually trigger the shutter hands-free with a palm gesture. (Motorola's Razr Ultra lets you start and stop video recordings with hand gestures, too!) It's excellent when traveling if you want to take a photo of yourself next to a point of interest.
paras.zh: 无论您喜欢哪种风格，我最喜欢的折叠手机功能是能够在外部屏幕上看到取景器，并使用高品质后置摄像头进行自拍 - 只需将手机稍微折叠起来，使其保持直立，通常您可以在相机应用程序中单击一个按钮，将预览发送到外部屏幕。通常，您可以通过手掌手势免提触发快门。 （摩托罗拉的 Razr Ultra 还可以让您通过手势开始和停止视频录制！）如果您想在旅行时在某个景点旁边拍一张自己的照片，那么它非常适合您。

paras.en: Many of these phones offer similar functionality with translation—Samsung and Google, for example, let you show your words translated on the external screen so the person you are speaking to can see it, and then they can tap a button on the screen to have the phone start translating their words, which you'll see on the internal screen. It's a much nicer system than using Google Translate on a candy bar phone. —Julian Chokkattu
paras.zh: 许多此类手机都提供类似的翻译功能，例如三星和谷歌，让您在外部屏幕上显示翻译后的单词，以便与您交谈的人可以看到它，然后他们可以点击屏幕上的按钮，让手机开始翻译他们的单词，您将在内部屏幕上看到这些单词。这是一个比在直板手机上使用谷歌翻译更好的系统。 ——朱利安·乔卡图

articles.title: Scientists Trapped an Antimatter Particle for Months to Study Its Secrets
articles.author: Jorge Garay

paras.en: Antimatter is not known for being easy to get ahold of. That’s part of why these particles remain so cryptic. But recently, a team of physicists at Northwestern University managed to trap a single antimatter particle for months. Cooling it to temperatures near absolute zero, they could control its quantum states with great precision without even touching it. The experiment, published in Physical Review Letters, represents a breakthrough in our understanding of one of the great mysteries of physics.
paras.zh: 众所周知，反物质并不容易获得。这就是这些粒子仍然如此神秘的部分原因。但最近，西北大学的一组物理学家成功地捕获了一个反物质粒子数月。将其冷却到接近绝对零的温度，他们甚至可以在不接触它的情况下非常精确地控制它的量子态。该实验发表在《物理评论快报》上，代表了我们对物理学伟大奥秘之一理解的突破。

paras.en: In theory, antimatter should be everywhere. Mathematics predicts that every particle of matter has an equivalent antiparticle, a fact that scientists have verified experimentally. The universe should therefore contain similar amounts of both, but almost everything we observe is made up of ordinary matter, and we still don’t know why.
paras.zh: 理论上，反物质应该无处不在。数学预测物质的每个粒子都有一个等效的反粒子，科学家已经通过实验验证了这一事实。因此，宇宙应该含有相似数量的两者，但我们观察到的几乎所有东西都是由普通物质组成的，而我们仍然不知道为什么。

paras.en: It is possible to produce antimatter particles in laboratories, but studying them is still incredibly difficult. When an antiparticle comes into contact with ordinary matter, the two annihilate each other and release energy. To prevent research facilities from exploding, scientists use vacuum chambers and electromagnetic fields that suspend the antiparticles in isolation. But this only partially solves the problem. Studying these particles, especially experimenting with their behavior on a quantum scale, remains challenging.
paras.zh: 在实验室中生产反物质粒子是可能的，但研究它们仍然非常困难。当反粒子与普通物质接触时，两者会相互湮灭并释放能量。为了防止研究设施爆炸，科学家们使用真空室和电磁场来隔离悬浮反粒子。但这只能部分解决问题。研究这些粒子，特别是在量子尺度上实验它们的行为，仍然具有挑战性。

paras.en: For this experiment, researchers at Northwestern trapped a positron, the antimatter counterpart of electrons. The team, led by Gerald Gabrielse, developed a device known as a single-positron quantum cyclotron, which used electric and magnetic fields to hold the positron in a vacuum at a temperature close to absolute zero. This means the antimatter particle was at its lowest energy state, allowing the researchers to induce controlled changes in its quantum behavior. Unlike other methods in particle physics, this approach didn’t destroy the particle. The researchers were therefore able to keep the single antiparticle trapped for months, allowing them to repeat measurements.
paras.zh: 在这项实验中，西北大学的研究人员捕获了一个正电子，它是电子的反物质对应物。由杰拉尔德·加布里埃尔斯 (Gerald Gabrielse) 领导的团队开发了一种称为单正电子量子回旋加速器的装置，该装置利用电场和磁场将正电子保持在温度接近绝对零的真空中。这意味着反物质粒子处于最低能量状态，使研究人员能够诱发其量子行为的受控变化。与粒子物理学中的其他方法不同，这种方法不会破坏粒子。因此，研究人员能够将单个反粒子捕获数月，使他们能够重复测量。

paras.en: So what can taming antimatter particles actually teach us? Scientists know that matter and antimatter have very similar properties. For example, an electron and a positron have exactly the same mass, although their electric charges are opposite. However, questions still remain about exactly how similar these two forms of matter are and whether there are small differences that have gone unnoticed in experiments conducted to date.
paras.zh: 那么驯服反物质粒子实际上可以教会我们什么呢？科学家知道物质和反物质具有非常相似的特性。例如，电子和正电子具有完全相同的质量，尽管它们的电荷相反。然而，关于这两种形式的物质到底有多相似，以及是否存在迄今为止进行的实验中未被注意到的微小差异，仍然存在疑问。

paras.en: To this end, researchers want to compare the magnetic properties of both particles. Physicists have already made very precise measurements with electrons, but achieving the same level of precision with positrons has proven more difficult. According to the American Physical Society, the new device could enable measurements of antimatter particles about 30 times more precise than scientists were capable of before.
paras.zh: 为此，研究人员希望比较两种粒子的磁性。物理学家已经用电子进行了非常精确的测量，但事实证明，用正电子达到同样的精度水平更加困难。据美国物理学会称，这种新设备对反物质粒子的测量精度比科学家以前的测量精度高出约 30 倍。

paras.en: So far, the experiment has not revealed any unexpected differences between the two particles. What the researchers have achieved is an improvement in their ability to detect these differences in antimatter particles. If future measurements find that a positron responds to magnetic fields differently than an electron, scientists would have to revise some of the laws they use to explain the behavior of matter and antimatter.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，实验尚未发现这两种粒子之间有任何意想不到的差异。研究人员所取得的成就是提高了检测反物质粒子差异的能力。如果未来的测量发现正电子对磁场的反应与电子不同，科学家将不得不修改他们用来解释物质和反物质行为的一些定律。

paras.en: This story originally appeared in WIRED en Español and has been translated from Spanish.
paras.zh: 这个故事最初出现在《连线》西班牙文版中，现已翻译自西班牙语。

articles.title: Wallhack M-001 Review: When Fun Overrides Specs
articles.author: Henri Robbins

paras.en: With a tactile dongle for on-the-fly customization and a metal chassis, the Wallhack M-001 is the most fun I've had reviewing a gaming mouse in a long time.
paras.zh: Wallhack M-001 配有用于即时定制的触觉适配器和金属底盘，是我长期以来评测过的最有趣的游戏鼠标。

paras.en: Magnesium shell. Hot-swappable, rechargeable batteries. 52-gram weight. Functional and innovative dongle. Satisfying tactile experience. Great styling and design language.
paras.zh: 镁质外壳。可热插拔的可充电电池。重量 52 克。实用且创新的加密狗。令人满意的触觉体验。出色的造型和设计语言。

paras.en: High price point. Slightly outdated sensor. Only 2.4G wireless connectivity with dongle; no Bluetooth or USB-C connectivity on mouse.
paras.zh: 高价位。传感器有点过时。仅使用加密狗进行 2.4G 无线连接；鼠标上没有蓝牙或 USB-C 连接。

paras.en: Batteries. They're not typically thought of as a significant source of innovation. Most companies have spent the last few years removing mice in favor of more lightweight designs.
paras.zh: 电池。它们通常不被认为是创新的重要来源。在过去的几年里，大多数公司都在消除鼠标，转而采用更轻量的设计。

paras.en: That's what's made the return of the replaceable and rechargeable battery surprising—something I once thought to be a lost technology from a bygone era. A few companies have recently realized that the ability to pop out and replace your battery in seconds is a great way to extend mouse life without needing to increase battery size or efficiency.
paras.zh: 这就是可更换和可充电电池的回归令人惊讶的原因——我曾经认为这是过去时代的一项失传的技术。一些公司最近意识到，能够在几秒钟内弹出并更换电池是延长鼠标寿命的好方法，而无需增加电池尺寸或效率。

paras.en: From the handful of mice I’ve tested with hot-swappable batteries so far, Wallhack does it best. The mouse is designed around the function’s ease-of-use, and everything else comes together to make a mouse that feels not only competitive for gaming, but also well thought-out and satisfying to use in everyday life.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，在我测试过的几款使用热插拔电池的鼠标中，Wallhack 做得最好。该鼠标的设计围绕功能的易用性而设计，所有其他要素结合在一起，使这款鼠标不仅在游戏中具有竞争力，而且在日常生活中使用起来也经过深思熟虑和令人满意。

paras.en: The M-001’s shape is a standard right-handed, symmetrical design. This means the mouse’s left and right sides are shaped identically, but only the left side has thumb buttons. There are two main buttons, two side buttons, a standard ratcheting scroll wheel, and a power switch on the underside.
paras.zh: M-001的形状是标准的右手对称设计。这意味着鼠标的左右两侧形状相同，但只有左侧有拇指按钮。底部有两个主按钮、两个侧按钮、一个标准棘轮滚轮和一个电源开关。

paras.en: With a length of 120 mm, the M-001 is slightly shorter than contemporaries like the Razer Viper V4 Pro (125 mm) and Logitech Pro Superstrike X2 (127 mm). The overall width and height are comparable, at 63.5-mm tall and a 39-mm wide. The largest difference is the profile of the mouse: The front end sits significantly lower than other mice, and the rear has a more significant hump, which creates a more angled shape overall. When using a palm grip, this puts your hand at a slightly more aggressive forwards angle, with your palm sitting higher and your fingers pointing more downwards. It’s a slight difference, but I found this angle to be better for quick movements compared to a more “flat” design. However, like most shape-related choices, this is ultimately down to individual preference. (To compare mouse sizes, I typically use a website like eloshapes)
paras.zh: M-001 的长度为 120 毫米，比 Razer Viper V4 Pro（125 毫米）和 Logitech Pro Superstrike X2（127 毫米）等同类产品略短。整体宽度和高度相当，高 63.5 毫米，宽 39 毫米。最大的区别是鼠标的轮廓：前端明显低于其他鼠标，后部有更明显的驼峰，从而形成整体更有角度的形状。当使用手掌握法时，这会使你的手处于稍微更积极的向前角度，手掌位置更高，手指更向下。这是一个细微的差别，但我发现与更“平坦”的设计相比，这个角度更适合快速移动。然而，就像大多数与形状相关的选择一样，这最终取决于个人喜好。 （为了比较鼠标大小，我通常使用像 eloshapes 这样的网站）

paras.en: The two main buttons are lightly sculpted, with subtle concavity for fingers to comfortably rest in. Similarly, there is a subtle taper at the bottom center of the mouse which makes lifting and moving easier. The side buttons use a simple, rounded shape placed just above the taper, making it easy to rock your thumb upwards to press them without getting in the way. They’re just elevated enough that the buttons don’t recess into the shell when pressed. The only shape-related issue I had was the scroll wheel, which is a good bit more elevated than other mice. This isn’t a huge issue, and I adapted to it after a few hours of use, but it’s something I could see being off-putting for users accustomed to a lower-profile scroll wheel.
paras.zh: 两个主要按钮经过轻微雕刻，具有微妙的凹度，可以让手指舒适地休息。同样，鼠标底部中心有一个微妙的锥度，使抬起和移动更容易。侧面按钮采用简单的圆形形状，放置在锥度的正上方，使您可以轻松地向上摇动拇指来按下它们，而不会妨碍它们。它们的高度足够高，按下时按钮不会凹进外壳中。我遇到的唯一与形状相关的问题是滚轮，它比其他鼠标要高一些。这不是一个大问题，使用几个小时后我就适应了它，但我认为这对于习惯于低调滚轮的用户来说是令人反感的。

paras.en: The most important part of this mouse’s construction is the magnesium shell, which provides significantly more rigidity than the plastic shells used on most mice. Because of this, the mouse feels incredibly sturdy and solid. The metal shell also gives the mouse a cool, slick feeling underneath your fingertips, which I prefer to the matte plastic feeling that most mice have.
paras.zh: 这款鼠标结构中最重要的部分是镁外壳，它比大多数鼠标使用的塑料外壳具有更高的刚性。正因为如此，鼠标感觉非常坚固和坚固。金属外壳还给鼠标在指尖下带来凉爽、光滑的感觉，我更喜欢大多数鼠标所具有的哑光塑料感觉。

paras.en: Despite using metal, it only weighs 53.6 grams, making the M-001 quite light by most standards, It still falls slightly behind the Viper V4 Pro’s 50.3 grams and lags way behind Corsair’s superlight, 36-gram Sabre V2 Pro Ultralight. But the M-001 is incredibly solid, with none of the flexibility or flimsiness that most plastic mice have. When compared to other magnesium mice like the AngryMiao Infinity .97 or Corsair’s magnesium-shelled Sabre, the M-001 has an entirely solid upper shell without any cutouts or holes, which feels much better for regular use with a multitude of grip styles (plus, it’s much less likely to have dust, dead skin, or anything else build up inside of it). While the full magnesium shell increases weight, it’s a worthwhile trade-off for a smooth and rigid shape.
paras.zh: 尽管使用金属，但它的重量仅为 53.6 克，从大多数标准来看，M-001 都相当轻，但它仍然略低于 Viper V4 Pro 的 50.3 克，并且远远落后于 Corsair 的超轻、36 克 Sabre V2 Pro 超轻。但 M-001 非常坚固，没有大多数塑料鼠标所具有的灵活性或脆弱性。与 AngryMiao Infinity .97 或 Corsair 的镁壳 Sabre 等其他镁鼠标相比，M-001 具有完全坚固的上壳，没有任何切口或孔，这对于多种握持方式的常规使用来说感觉更好（此外，它内部不太可能积聚灰尘、死皮或其他任何东西）。虽然全镁外壳增加了重量，但为了光滑和坚固的形状，这是值得的权衡。

paras.en: It’s also worth noting that some of Wallhack’s promotional material depicts the mouse as being a solid black color, but this isn’t quite the case. The unit I received is much closer to a gunmetal color, with a significant amount of metallic flake across the finish. The color looks fantastic in person, but it's difficult to properly capture in images.
paras.zh: 还值得注意的是，Wallhack 的一些宣传材料将鼠标描述为纯黑色，但事实并非如此。我收到的装置更接近青铜色，表面有大量金属薄片。这种颜色在人眼看来非常棒，但在图像中很难正确捕捉。

paras.en: Flipping over this mouse reveals one of the more atypical design decisions being made: the lack of a bottom shell. Instead of an entire underside, there is a thin frame around the circumference of the mouse that holds six feet in place. Between them is a chasm that reveals the entire PCB and battery.
paras.zh: 翻转这款鼠标，可以看到正在做出的更非典型的设计决策之一：缺少底壳。鼠标周围有一个薄框架，而不是整个底面，可将六英尺固定到位。它们之间有一条裂缝，露出整个 PCB 和电池。

paras.en: Of particular note is the PCB’s function inside the mouse: Instead of simply sitting inside of the shell, the PCB works as a primary structural component. Similar techniques have been used in designing supercars and sport bikes, with the Ferrari F50 using the engine block as a stressed member that provides rigidity to the entire car, a technology borrowed from Ferrari’s F1 team. This provides some obvious benefits to rigidity and weight-savings, but it’s also just undeniably cool to be able to flip over your mouse and see the entire circuit board.
paras.zh: 特别值得注意的是 PCB 在鼠标内部的功能：PCB 不是简单地位于外壳内部，而是作为主要结构组件。类似的技术也被用于设计超级跑车和运动自行车，法拉利 F50 使用发动机缸体作为受力构件，为整个汽车提供刚性，这项技术借鉴自法拉利 F1 车队。这为刚性和减轻重量提供了一些明显的好处，但不可否认的是，能够翻转鼠标并看到整个电路板也是很酷的。

paras.en: Right behind the PCB is the star of the show, a hot-swappable battery. While I’ve tested quite a few mice with this technology, none of them have managed to make the battery-swapping so satisfying. Instead of being attached with magnets or a rotating locking mechanism, the batteries use a custom-made -spring-loaded ejector similar to an SD card or a Nintendo Switch cartridge. To insert the battery, simply press until you feel a click, and it will lock into place. To remove it, do the same: press until you feel a click, and it will pop out slightly. Of all the mice I’ve tested with removable batteries, this is by far my favorite mechanism to use: It’s intuitive, fun, and feels sturdy.
paras.zh: PCB 后面是本次展会的明星——热插拔电池。虽然我用这项技术测试了相当多的鼠标，但没有一个能够让电池更换如此令人满意。电池不是用磁铁或旋转锁定机构固定，而是使用定制的弹簧加载弹出器，类似于 SD 卡或 Nintendo Switch 卡带。要插入电池，只需按下直至听到咔哒声，电池就会锁定到位。要移除它，请执行相同的操作：按下直至感觉到咔哒声，它会稍微弹出。在我测试过的所有使用可拆卸电池的鼠标中，这是迄今为止我最喜欢使用的机制：它直观、有趣且感觉坚固。

paras.en: This battery system does come with a trade-off. Because hot-swappable batteries means an effectively-infinite battery life (as long as you remember to plug the old one into the dongle when you swap), Wallhack has decided to entirely remove the USB-C port on the mouse. This means it only functions as a 2.4G wireless mouse and cannot be plugged or charged in directly. This isn’t a huge issue (it never inconvenienced me, since there was always a fully charged battery ready to swap in), and it theoretically means the connection quality will be better, since there’s fewer components between the antenna and the receiver. But it is worth noting that, if a battery dies or your dongle craps out, there’s no other way to use this mouse.
paras.zh: 这种电池系统确实需要权衡。由于热插拔电池意味着无限的电池寿命（只要您记得在更换时将旧电池插入适配器），Wallhack 决定完全移除鼠标上的 USB-C 端口。这意味着它只能充当 2.4G 无线鼠标，不能直接插入或充电。这不是一个大问题（它从来没有给我带来不便，因为总是有一块充满电的电池可供更换），理论上意味着连接质量会更好，因为天线和接收器之间的组件更少。但值得注意的是，如果电池没电或适配器坏了，就没有其他方法可以使用这款鼠标。

paras.en: In every high-polling mouse I’ve reviewed, the dongle has been a bit of a pain point. A high polling rate necessitates proximity, which in turn requires in a small thing sitting on your desk. In most cases, these things have only one or two functions: They connect to the mouse, and they maybe have a small number of LED indicators (between 1 and 3) that can display battery life, connection quality, or some other setting. Almost every time, they’re small and light enough to slide around on your desk and will inevitably end up falling behind it once or twice due to the weight of the cable pulling it back.
paras.zh: 在我评测过的每一款高投票率鼠标中，适配器一直是一个痛点。高轮询率需要接近，这反过来又需要在你的桌子上放置一个小东西。在大多数情况下，这些东西只有一两个功能：它们连接到鼠标，并且可能有少量 LED 指示灯（1 到 3 个），可以显示电池寿命、连接质量或其他一些设置。几乎每次，它们都又小又轻，足以在您的桌子上滑动，并且由于电缆将其拉回的重量，最终不可避免地会掉落在桌子后面一两次。

paras.en: With the M-001, nearly all of these issues are resolved: The dongle is given purpose, function, and I’d even argue dignity. Instead of the small, existing-by-necessity designs that most manufacturers ship with their mice, Wallhack has managed to make a beautiful piece of industrial design. The dongle is a medium-sized metal wedge sporting a gunmetal gray finish identical to the mouse. It has two camera-like dials up front, a button, and a slot for a rechargeable battery. The DPI dial features numbering from 400 to 25,600, and the polling dial goes from 125 Hz to 8,000 Hz.
paras.zh: 有了 M-001，几乎所有这些问题都得到了解决：加密狗被赋予了目的、功能，我什至认为尊严。 Wallhack 没有采用大多数制造商随鼠标提供的小型、按需设计，而是成功地制作出了精美的工业设计。该适配器是一个中等大小的金属楔子，具有与鼠标相同的青铜灰色表面。它的前面有两个类似相机的转盘、一个按钮和一个可充电电池槽。 DPI 转盘的编号范围为 400 至 25,600，轮询转盘的编号范围为 125 Hz 至 8,000 Hz。

paras.en: The dials both have LED indicators next to them, which illuminate alongside the mouse to indicate a setting being changed. When rotated, they both have a satisfying ratcheting mechanism that’s stiff enough to avoid accidental inputs, without being difficult to turn using a single finger.
paras.zh: 转盘旁边都有 LED 指示灯，它们会在鼠标旁边亮起，以指示设置正在更改。旋转时，它们都具有令人满意的棘轮机构，该机构足够坚硬，可以避免意外输入，并且使用单根手指转动也很困难。

paras.en: While I loved these dials from the moment I saw them, I really didn’t expect to use them much. I’ve always been more of a set-and-forget type of person. But after testing this mouse for a while, I regularly found myself using both of the dials: On-the-fly DPI adjustments were great for games like Marvel Rivals. I tended to prefer, for example, a higher DPI for Thing and a lower for Thor. Polling adjustments, too, were useful in situations where older games (like Destiny 2) got grumpy when I was using a mouse above 1,000 Hz.
paras.zh: 虽然我从看到这些表盘的那一刻起就喜欢它们，但我真的没想到会经常使用它们。我一直都是那种一劳永逸的人。但在测试这款鼠标一段时间后，我发现自己经常使用这两个旋钮：动态 DPI 调整非常适合《Marvel Rivals》等游戏。例如，我倾向于为 Thing 提供较高的 DPI，为 Thor 提供较低的 DPI。当我使用高于 1,000 Hz 的鼠标时，旧游戏（例如《命运 2》）变得脾气暴躁，轮询调整也很有用。

paras.en: Like many mice today, the M-001 uses an in-browser customization client. Wallhack’s web client, Wallhack Terminal, takes a unique stylistic approach, relying on a black-and-white, text-based system that resembles Command Prompt more than a typical gaming software. This is both a breath of fresh air stylistically, and much more straightforward than some of the software I’ve used in the past.
paras.zh: 与当今的许多鼠标一样，M-001 使用浏览器内自定义客户端。 Wallhack 的网络客户端 Wallhack Terminal 采用独特的风格方法，依赖于黑白文本系统，该系统比典型的游戏软件更类似于命令提示符。这在风格上令人耳目一新，而且比我过去使用过的一些软件要简单得多。

paras.en: The configurator has an extensive feature set, including adjustments for mouse rotation, acceleration, and lift-off distance, which is adjustable by millimeters instead of the vague Low/Medium/High that some softwares use. The sensor can also be pushed to scan faster than the mouse’s 8,000 Hz polling rate, which can potentially improve the accuracy of the sensor, but limits battery life.
paras.zh: 该配置器具有广泛的功能集，包括对鼠标旋转、加速度和抬起距离的调整，这些距离可以毫米为单位进行调整，而不是某些软件使用的模糊的低/中/高。传感器的扫描速度也可以快于鼠标的 8,000 Hz 轮询率，这可能会提高传感器的准确性，但会限制电池寿命。

paras.en: Along with adjusting DPI and polling with the dials on the dongle, switching them to the red “DPI” And “Hz” text allows for more granular adjustments within the configurator.
paras.zh: 除了调整 DPI 和使用加密狗上的旋钮进行轮询之外，将它们切换到红色“DPI”和“Hz”文本还可以在配置器中进行更精细的调整。

paras.en: The sensor inside the mouse is a Pixart PAW3950. For anyone who doesn’t have an exhaustive list of mouse sensors floating around their head, this is the same type of sensor used in the 2022 Razer Viper V2 Pro (branded as the Razer Focus Pro 30k). That's four years old at this point. It’s not quite a cutting-edge sensor anymore. But unless you're in the top-tier of competitive play, the sensor will feel consistent and reliable enough, being able to easily track and manage direction changes during fast-paced shootouts. My personal daily driver is a Viper V2 Pro with the exact same sensor (I prefer the shape to the V3 and V4), and it’s still perfectly serviceable after four years of use.
paras.zh: 鼠标内部的传感器是 Pixart PAW3950。对于那些头上没有详尽的鼠标传感器列表的人来说，这与 2022 年 Razer Viper V2 Pro（品牌为 Razer Focus Pro 30k）中使用的传感器类型相同。此时已经四岁了。它不再是一个尖端传感器。但除非你处于顶级竞技比赛中，否则传感器会感觉足够一致和可靠，能够在快节奏的枪战中轻松跟踪和管理方向变化。我个人的日常驾驶是 Viper V2 Pro，具有完全相同的传感器（与 V3 和 V4 相比，我更喜欢其形状），并且在使用四年后仍然可以完美使用。

paras.en: The main buttons inside this mouse use Omron Optical switches, while the side buttons opt for low-profile Omron blue-dot mechanical switches. The scroll wheel’s encoder is a mechanical unit as well, which means it doesn’t have quite the same longevity as the optical units some mice are beginning to use. However, they are easier to replace or fix if something does go wrong.
paras.zh: 这款鼠标内部的主要按钮采用欧姆龙光学开关，而侧面按钮则选择低调的欧姆龙蓝点机械开关。滚轮的编码器也是一个机械单元，这意味着它的使用寿命不如一些鼠标开始使用的光学单元。然而，如果出现问题，它们更容易更换或修复。

paras.en: The internal design of this mouse is impressively simple: There are six feet on the underside, and the outer four all have screws underneath. When you remove these four screws, the bottom half of the shell comes off cleanly (no flimsy plastic clips!), and a few more screws separate the internals from the top shell.
paras.zh: 这款鼠标的内部设计非常简单：底部有六个脚，外面的四个脚底下都有螺丝。当您卸下这四个螺钉时，外壳的下半部分会干净地脱落（没有脆弱的塑料夹！），并且还有一些螺钉将内部结构与顶部外壳分开。

paras.en: I’ve said many times that, when it comes to peripherals, technical specs are only one part of the story. More than that, it’s important to have a device you enjoy using. Of all the mice I’ve tested, the M-001 is by far one of the most enjoyable. The shape is comfortable and natural for multiple grip styles, and the material ensures that the mouse feels rigid and stable despite its light weight. The dongle is a brilliant design that elevates itself from a sad desk tchotchke to a practical and functional device. And the battery mechanism is one of the most clever and fun designs I’ve seen in ages.
paras.zh: 我已经说过很多次了，当谈到外设时，技术规格只是故事的一部分。更重要的是，拥有一台您喜欢使用的设备非常重要。在我测试过的所有鼠标中，M-001 是迄今为止最令人愉悦的鼠标之一。形状舒适自然，适合多种握持方式，材质确保鼠标在重量轻的情况下感觉坚硬稳定。这款加密狗的设计非常出色，它从一个令人悲伤的办公桌小玩意升级为一款实用且功能齐全的设备。电池机制是我多年来见过的最聪明、最有趣的设计之一。

paras.en: Everything about this mouse is deeply satisfying, and I found myself excited to use it every time I sat down. Of course, this mouse isn’t at the cutting edge of sensors or switches, and because of this, I can’t exactly recommend this mouse to someone looking for an ultra-cost-effective option with min-maxed specs. But in using the mouse on the daily, I didn't find that it mattered as much as you might think. 8,000 Hz polling and a 25,600 DPI sensor are enough for all but the pros. Instead, it uses tried-and-true internals that function perfectly well and, more importantly, have crisp and precise tactile responses.
paras.zh: 这款鼠标的一切都非常令人满意，每次坐下来使用它时我都感到很兴奋。当然，这款鼠标并不处于传感器或开关的最前沿，因此，我不能完全向正在寻找具有最小最大规格的超成本效益选项的人推荐这款鼠标。但在日常使用鼠标时，我并没有发现它像你想象的那么重要。 8,000 Hz 轮询和 25,600 DPI 传感器对于除专业人士之外的所有人来说已经足够了。相反，它使用久经考验的内部结构，功能完美，更重要的是，具有清晰而精确的触觉响应。
