articles.title: Space Nuclear Power Corporation Awarded DARPA Agreement for Ground Test of Autonomous Nuclear Reactor Controller
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M. — October 21, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes) announced today that the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) has awarded the company an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under the Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program. Managed by Dr. Tabitha Dodson in DARPA’s Defense Sciences Office, the Fat Cat program seeks to advance autonomous reactor operation for national security missions. The contract supports development and ground testing of advanced reactor control technologies that extend the demonstrated capability of American nuclear power.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯 — 2026 年 10 月 21 日 — 太空核电公司 (SpaceNukes) 今天宣布，国防高级研究计划局 (DARPA) 已根据快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划授予该公司一份其他交易协议 (OTA)。 Fat Cat 项目由 DARPA 国防科学办公室的 Tabitha Dodson 博士管理，旨在推进国家安全任务的自主反应堆运行。该合同支持先进反应堆控制技术的开发和地面测试，以扩展美国核电的展示能力。

paras.en: The award extends a continuous line of nuclear power development and builds directly on SpaceNukes’ successful nuclear power demonstration heritage. In 2018, key members of the SpaceNukes team, while employed by Los Alamos National Laboratory and NASA, performed the foundational Kilopower Reactor Using Stirling Technology (KRUSTY) work — conducting the only full-power ground test of a new American space reactor in five decades. Under the current agreement, SpaceNukes and Los Alamos National Laboratory will design, build, and conduct a follow-on nuclear ground test of a Kilopower reactor incorporating active control rod operation—an advancement beyond the passively controlled architecture demonstrated in the 2018 KRUSTY test.
paras.zh: 该奖项延伸了核电开发的连续路线，并直接建立在 SpaceNukes 成功的核电示范遗产之上。 2018 年，SpaceNukes 团队的主要成员在受雇于洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室和 NASA 的同时，进行了使用斯特林技术的千功率反应堆 (KRUSTY) 的基础工作——对美国新型太空反应堆进行了 5 年来唯一的全功率地面测试。根据目前的协议，SpaceNukes 和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室将设计、建造并进行后续的 Kilopower 反应堆核地面测试，该反应堆采用主动控制棒操作，这是超越 2018 年 KRUSTY 测试中展示的被动控制架构的进步。

paras.en: “This award recognizes the maturity and continuity of the team that designed, built, and tested KRUSTY in 2018,” said Patrick McClure, COO of SpaceNukes. “We are proud to work alongside Dr. Dodson and Los Alamos National Laboratory to deliver the next demonstrated step in American nuclear power.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席运营官帕特里克·麦克卢尔 (Patrick McClure) 表示：“该奖项是对 2018 年设计、建造和测试 KRUSTY 团队的成熟度和连续性的认可。” “我们很自豪能够与多德森博士和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室合作，在美国核电领域迈出下一步。”

paras.en: The phased program structure includes design, procurement, and integration gates leading to the ground demonstration, producing both nuclear-tested hardware and the engineering basis for autonomous, actively-controlled reactor operation. Integration work will be conducted at SpaceNukes’ workshop in Medina, Ohio, led by Chief Engineer Marc Gibson. The work positions American industry to provide reliable nuclear power across a broader range of mission profiles, including those requiring dynamic power management and rapid response under varying operational conditions.
paras.zh: 分阶段的计划结构包括设计、采购和集成，直至地面演示，生产经过核测试的硬件和自主、主动控制反应堆运行的工程基础。集成工作将在 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的车间进行，由总工程师 Marc Gibson 领导。这项工作使美国工业界能够在更广泛的任务范围内提供可靠的核电，包括那些需要动态电力管理和在不同操作条件下快速响应的任务。

paras.en: “There is no substitute for demonstrated technology when American national security objectives are at stake,” said Andy Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “This award lets us advance the work begun in the KRUSTY program and bring another tested capability forward for the nation.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安迪·菲尔普斯 (Andy Phelps) 表示：“当美国国家安全目标受到威胁时，已证实的技术是无可替代的。” “这个奖项让我们能够推进 KRUSTY 计划中开始的工作，并为国家带来另一种经过考验的能力。”

paras.en: About Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes)
paras.zh: 关于太空核电公司（SpaceNukes）

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corporation was founded on the belief that nuclear power is essential to our future, both on Earth and in space. The company’s goal is to enable the successful deployment of fission reactors in space. SpaceNukes brings together the core engineering and program management team behind the foundational KRUSTY demonstration in 2018. David Poston (CTO) and Patrick McClure (COO) performed this work at Los Alamos National Laboratory; Marc Gibson (Chief Engineer) led the program at NASA Glenn Research Center. The team is joined by Omar Mireles (formerly NASA Marshall Space Flight Center) and Andy Phelps (CEO). SpaceNukes holds a license from Los Alamos National Laboratory for the Kilopower technology and operates from headquarters in Los Alamos, New Mexico, and workshops in Los Alamos with additive 3D printing and in Medina, Ohio, with thermal and vacuum capabilities.
paras.zh: 太空核电公司的成立基于这样的信念：核电对我们的未来至关重要，无论是在地球上还是在太空中。该公司的目标是在太空成功部署裂变反应堆。 SpaceNukes 汇集了 2018 年 KRUSTY 基础演示背后的核心工程和项目管理团队。David Poston（首席技术官）和 Patrick McClure（首席运营官）在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室执行了这项工作；马克·吉布森（首席工程师）在美国宇航局格伦研究中心领导了该项目。该团队由 Omar Mireles（前 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心）和 Andy Phelps（首席执行官）加入。 SpaceNukes 持有洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室的 Kilopower 技术许可证，总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，在洛斯阿拉莫斯设有增材 3D 打印车间，在俄亥俄州麦地那设有热力和真空能力的车间。

articles.title: Global Satcom Services Revenues to Reach $145 Billion by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | October 2026 – Global satellite services revenues are forecast to grow 44% to reach $145 billion by 2035, according to the 33rd edition of Novaspace’s Satellite Connectivity and Video Market report. The next decade will mark a fundamental shift in the industry as data services become the dominant growth engine, driving revenues to nearly $100 billion by 2035.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 10 月——根据 Novaspace 第 33 版卫星连接和视频市场报告，全球卫星服务收入预计将增长 44%，到 2035 年达到 1,450 亿美元。随着数据服务成为主要的增长引擎，到 2035 年收入将接近 1000 亿美元，未来十年将标志着该行业的根本性转变。

paras.en: Data services are expected to increase their share of total satellite services revenues from 26% to 68% over the decade, as demand for connectivity accelerates across consumer, defense, government, and enterprise markets.
paras.zh: 随着消费者、国防、政府和企业市场对连接的需求加速增长，数据服务在卫星服务总收入中的份额预计将在十年内从 26% 增加到 68%。

paras.en: While video remains the industry’s largest revenue segment today, future growth will be driven by connectivity. Consumer Broadband, Milsatcom, and Enterprise Networks are forecast to lead market expansion, adding $22.6 billion, $19.2 billion, and $17.2 billion in revenues, respectively, over the next decade.
paras.zh: 虽然视频仍然是当今行业最大的收入领域，但未来的增长将由连接性推动。消费者宽带、军事卫星通信和企业网络预计将引领市场扩张，在未来十年内分别增加 226 亿美元、192 亿美元和 172 亿美元的收入。

paras.en: Milsatcom is emerging as a particularly important growth engine, fueled by rising defense spending and broader adoption of satcom-enabled operational concepts across military forces. At the same time, NGSO constellations are becoming an increasingly important source of resilient capacity for government and defense users.
paras.zh: 在国防支出不断增加以及军队更广泛采用卫星通信作战概念的推动下，军事卫星通信正在成为一个特别重要的增长引擎。与此同时，NGSO 星座正成为政府和国防用户日益重要的弹性能力来源。

paras.en: “Satellite connectivity is moving firmly into the mainstream,” said Dimitri Buchs, Project Manager and Editor of the report. “The rapid expansion of NGSO capacity, declining bandwidth costs, and growing demand for resilient, always-available connectivity are fundamentally changing where and how satellite communications compete.”
paras.zh: “卫星连接正在坚定地成为主流，”项目经理兼报告编辑 Dimitri Buchs 说道。 “NGSO 容量的快速扩张、带宽成本的下降以及对弹性、始终可用连接的需求不断增长，正在从根本上改变卫星通信的竞争地点和方式。”

paras.en: The satellite capacity market is forecast to exceed $46 billion by 2035, more than tripling from 2025 levels. Video Distribution, the largest capacity segment in 2025, is expected to account for just 3% of capacity revenues by 2035. Consumer Broadband and Milsatcom, meanwhile, are projected to represent more than half of total capacity revenues.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，卫星容量市场将超过 460 亿美元，比 2025 年的水平增加两倍多。视频分发是 2025 年最大的容量部分，预计到 2035 年将仅占容量收入的 3%。与此同时，消费者宽带和军事卫星通信预计将占总容量收入的一半以上。

paras.en: Declining bandwidth costs, driven by HTS systems and a growing number of NGSO projects, are accelerating satellite connectivity’s expansion into mass-market applications. Providers such as Starlink are increasingly competing with terrestrial broadband on price, strengthening satellite broadband’s position as a viable alternative to fiber and wireless connectivity in a growing range of markets.
paras.zh: 在 HTS 系统和越来越多的 NGSO 项目的推动下，带宽成本不断下降，正在加速卫星连接向大众市场应用的扩展。 Starlink 等提供商在价格上与地面宽带的竞争日益激烈，从而巩固了卫星宽带在越来越多的市场中作为光纤和无线连接的可行替代方案的地位。

paras.en: The transformation is also reshaping the role of GEO operators. Following a low of six commercial GEO orders in 2024, the market rebounded to 10 orders in 2025, with another 14 recorded by mid-September 2026. The renewed activity reflects evolving multi-orbit strategies and continued demand for GEO capabilities alongside rapidly expanding NGSO systems.
paras.zh: 这一转变也正在重塑 GEO 运营商的角色。继 2024 年 6 个商业 GEO 订单的低点之后，市场在 2025 年反弹至 10 个订单，到 2026 年 9 月中旬又记录了 14 个订单。新的活动反映了不断发展的多轨道战略以及对 GEO 能力的持续需求以及快速扩展的 NGSO 系统。

paras.en: “This is not a return to the traditional GEO model,” Buchs added. “Software-defined satellites, more flexible commercial models, sovereign requirements, and growing multi-orbit strategies are redefining GEO’s role. The future of satellite communications will not be GEO or NGSO—it will increasingly be an ecosystem in which each architecture serves distinct and complementary requirements.”
paras.zh: “这并不是对传统 GEO 模式的回归，”布克斯补充道。 “软件定义的卫星、更灵活的商业模式、主权要求和不断增长的多轨道战略正在重新定义 GEO 的角色。卫星通信的未来将不再是 GEO 或 NGSO，而是越来越成为一个生态系统，其中每种架构都满足不同且互补的需求。”

paras.en: The 33rd edition of Satellite Connectivity and Video Market provides a comprehensive assessment of global satellite service revenues, capacity demand, pricing trends, competitive dynamics, and operator strategies across video, broadband, enterprise, mobility, government, and defense markets through 2035.
paras.zh: 第 33 版《卫星连接和视频市场》对 2035 年之前的视频、宽带、企业、移动、政府和国防市场的全球卫星服务收入、容量需求、定价趋势、竞争动态以及运营商战略进行了全面评估。

paras.en: This edition introduces a granular bottom-up model for Enterprise Networks Back-up terminals, providing greater visibility into market demand and deployment trends. It also features a revised commercial Milsatcom model with deeper analysis by region, frequency band, and infrastructure type.
paras.zh: 该版本引入了企业网络备份终端的细粒度自下而上模型，提供了对市场需求和部署趋势的更深入的了解。它还具有修订后的商业军事卫星通信模型，可按地区、频段和基础设施类型进行更深入的分析。

paras.en: The report also provides an updated assessment of major developments shaping the satellite communications market, including the evolution of NGSO constellations, emerging Q/V frequency bands and other regulatory developments, government and defense spending trends, and the changing competitive dynamics between satellite and terrestrial connectivity.
paras.zh: 该报告还对塑造卫星通信市场的主要发展进行了最新评估，包括NGSO星座的演变、新兴的Q/V频段和其他监管发展、政府和国防支出趋势，以及卫星和地面连接之间不断变化的竞争动态。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球运营，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。

articles.title: TechnoMile Recognized as a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Award Winner
articles.author: TechnoMile

paras.en: TechnoMile, the leading AI solution that unifies growth, contracts, compliance, and security workflows, has been named a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Awards winner, recognizing the company among the leading B2B partners supporting entrepreneurs and businesses across the country.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 是统一增长、合同、合规性和安全工作流程的领先 AI 解决方案，被评为 2026 年 Inc. Power 合作伙伴奖得主，认可该公司是支持全国企业家和企业的领先 B2B 合作伙伴之一。

paras.en: The annual Inc. Power Partner Awards honor B2B companies that have demonstrated a track record of helping entrepreneurs and businesses navigate the challenges of building and growing a company. From hiring and compliance to technology, infrastructure, fundraising, marketing, and more, these partners provide expertise and services that enable businesses to operate, scale, and pursue their ambitions.
paras.zh: 一年一度的 Inc. Power 合作伙伴奖旨在表彰那些在帮助企业家和企业应对创建和发展公司的挑战方面取得良好记录的 B2B 公司。从招聘和合规到技术、基础设施、筹款、营销等，这些合作伙伴提供专业知识和服务，使企业能够运营、扩大规模并实现其抱负。

paras.en: “Business owners have no shortage of tools at their disposal, and B2B companies need to make clear why their products and services are worth the investment,” says Bonny Ghosh, editorial director at Inc. “The companies on this year’s Power Partners list have done just that. They don’t just have customers – they have superfans and evangelists. Across industries like marketing, financial services, and technology, they’ve proved their dedication to helping fellow business owners grow and succeed.”
paras.zh: Inc 编辑总监 Bonny Ghosh 表示：“企业主并不缺乏可用的工具，B2B 公司需要明确为什么他们的产品和服务值得投资。今年 Power Partners 名单上的公司已经做到了这一点。他们不仅拥有客户，还拥有超级粉丝和传播者。在营销、金融服务和技术等行业，他们已经证明了自己致力于帮助其他企业主成长和成功。”

paras.en: TechnoMile was recognized for its investment in their clients’ long-term success, solving the persistent challenges that growing government contractors face – identifying the right opportunities among thousands of federal solicitations, managing pipelines through manual processes, lacking visibility to forecast and make confident pursuit decisions, and meeting stringent compliance and security requirements once contracts are won.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 因其对客户长期成功的投资而获得认可，解决了不断增长的政府承包商面临的持续挑战——在数千个联邦招标中识别合适的机会，通过手动流程管理管道，缺乏预测和做出自信的追求决策的可见性，以及赢得合同后满足严格的合规性和安全要求。

paras.en: TechnoMile’s unified platform connects growth, contracts, and security workflows, delivering GovCon, Defense, and Public Sector organizations greater visibility, stronger compliance, lower risk, and more efficient operations. By combining purpose-built technology, trusted AI, and deep government contracting experience, TechnoMile helps organizations compete for, win, and successfully execute mission-critical government work.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 的统一平台连接增长、合同和安全工作流程，为 GovCon、国防和公共部门组织提供更高的可视性、更强的合规性、更低的风险和更高效的运营。通过将专用技术、可信人工智能和深厚的政府签约经验相结合，TechnoMile 帮助组织竞争、获胜并成功执行关键任务的政府工作。

paras.en: “TechnoMile solves a real problem for the contracting market – providing a unified way to manage the full lifecycle of federal business,” said Ashish Khot, CEO of TechnoMile. “This award is a special honor because it is largely based on the feedback and experience of our customers and shows that we are living up to our promise to be a partner for business growth, helping companies better manage the work behind winning and delivering federal business.”
paras.zh: “TechnoMile 解决了承包市场的一个真正问题——提供统一的方式来管理联邦业务的整个生命周期，”TechnoMile 首席执行官 Ashish Khot 表示。 “这个奖项是一项特殊的荣誉，因为它主要基于我们客户的反馈和经验，表明我们正在履行我们的承诺，成为业务增长的合作伙伴，帮助公司更好地管理赢得和交付联邦业务背后的工作。”

paras.en: For more information on Inc.’s Power Partner Awards or to view the complete list of honorees, visit https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards.
paras.zh: 有关 Inc. 电力合作伙伴奖的更多信息或查看获奖者的完整列表，请访问 https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards。

paras.en: Inc. is the leading media brand and playbook for the entrepreneurs and business leaders shaping our future. Through its journalism, Inc. aims to inform, educate, and elevate the profile of its community: the risk-takers, the innovators, and the ultra-driven go-getters who are creating the future of business. Inc. is published by Mansueto Ventures, along with fellow leading business publication Fast Company. For more information, visit www.inc.com.

articles.title: NASA’s Swift Mission Ends, Leaves Behind Scientific Bonanza

paras.en: NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory has ended its science mission now that the spacecraft is orbiting less than 171 miles (275 kilometers) above Earth’s surface. The greater atmospheric drag at this height prevents the satellite’s telescopes from steadily gazing at their astronomical targets.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局尼尔·格尔尔斯·斯威夫特天文台现已结束其科学任务，该航天器的轨道距地球表面不到 171 英里（275 公里）。这个高度上更大的大气阻力使卫星望远镜无法稳定地凝视其天文目标。

paras.en: Swift conducted its final observation on Oct. 20. It is expected to re-enter the atmosphere in the next few weeks.
paras.zh: 斯威夫特于10月20日进行了最后一次观测。预计它将在未来几周内重新进入大气层。

paras.en: “Swift delivered an incredible, lasting return on investment for the nation, designed for a two-year primary mission but productive for more than 10 times as long,” said Shawn Domagal-Goldman, director, Astrophysics Division at NASA Headquarters in Washington. “In that time, Swift played a major role in advancing our understanding of the changing universe and was part of a revolution in astrophysics that showed how critical rapid-response observations are to the entire community. To support rapid response to cosmic events in a post-Swift world, we’re exploring our ability to use and augment NASA’s fleet of existing space telescopes, from fast-to-orbit commercial capabilities to efficient, innovative new missions. And Swift leaves us with an extraordinary archive of multiwavelength observations that will fuel new discoveries for decades more.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局华盛顿总部天体物理部主任肖恩·多马加尔-戈德曼 (Shawn Domagal-Goldman) 表示：“Swift 为国家带来了令人难以置信、持久的投资回报，它是为两年的主要任务而设计的，但其生产力却是其 10 倍以上。” “当时，Swift 在增进我们对不断变化的宇宙的理解方面发挥了重要作用，并且是天体物理学革命的一部分，这场革命表明了快速响应观测对整个社区的重要性。为了支持对后 Swift 世界中的宇宙事件的快速响应，我们正在探索使用和增强 NASA 现有太空望远镜群的能力，从快速入轨商业能力到高效、创新的新任务。Swift 为我们留下了非凡的多波长观测档案，这些档案将推动新的研究几十年来的发现。”

paras.en: In its storied career, Swift has observed more than 2,000 gamma-ray bursts, the most powerful explosions in the cosmos. It has studied more than 1,400 supernova explosions, witnessed stars shredded by black holes, monitored active galaxies, conducted an all-sky X-ray survey, studied asteroids and comets, and more. Swift data has contributed to about 7,000 published scientific papers.
paras.zh: 在其传奇的职业生涯中，斯威夫特观测到了 2000 多次伽马射线暴，这是宇宙中最强大的爆炸。它研究了超过 1,400 次超新星爆炸、目睹了被黑洞撕碎的恒星、监测了活跃星系、进行了全天 X 射线巡天、研究了小行星和彗星等等。 Swift 数据已为约 7,000 篇已发表的科学论文做出了贡献。

paras.en: “Swift was designed as a satellite dedicated to studying gamma-ray bursts, outbursts that came and went so quickly that no one could target them with large telescopes to learn more,” said S. Bradley Cenko, the mission’s principal investigator at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland. “Swift needed to detect and locate gamma-ray bursts, communicate their position to other observatories, and then swing its telescopes around to image the burst locations before their afterglows faded out. This typically took Swift about a minute to do.”
paras.zh: “雨燕被设计为一颗专门研究伽马射线爆发的卫星，这种爆发来得快，去得快，以至于没有人能够用大型望远镜瞄准它们来了解更多信息，”位于马里兰州格林贝尔特的美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心的该任务首席研究员 S. Bradley Cenko 说。 “斯威夫特需要探测和定位伽马射线爆发，将其位置传达给其他天文台，然后在余辉消失之前转动望远镜来拍摄爆发位置。这通常需要斯威夫特大约一分钟的时间才能完成。”

paras.en: Led by its first principal investigator, Neil Gehrels, Swift was born as a multiwavelength observatory, with co-aligned Optical/Ultraviolet and X-ray telescopes that could quickly image and refine a burst’s position. The mission launched into orbit on Nov. 20, 2004, and went to work the following month. In 2018, NASA renamed the mission to honor Gehrels following his death.
paras.zh: 在第一位首席研究员 Neil Gehrels 的领导下，雨燕天文台诞生了，它是一个多波长天文台，配备并排的光学/紫外线和 X 射线望远镜，可以快速成像并精确确定爆发的位置。该任务于2004年11月20日发射进入轨道，并于次月开始工作。 2018 年，美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 在格勒斯去世后重新命名了该任务，以纪念他。

paras.en: Speed was especially important for an elusive population called short gamma-ray bursts, which reach peak brightness in less than two seconds. Until Swift, it had been impossible to locate these bursts rapidly and precisely enough to observe their afterglows. In May 2005, Swift achieved this milestone with GRB 050509B, which lasted just 0.03 seconds. Swift turned to the burst fast enough to detect 11 X-ray photons, making this the first short burst with a detected afterglow. These observations validated long-standing theoretical models, showing that short gamma-ray bursts likely come from mergers of two neutron stars — objects with the mass of the Sun that have been crushed to the size of a city.
paras.zh: 速度对于一种被称为短伽马射线爆发的难以捉摸的群体尤其重要，这种爆发在不到两秒的时间内达到峰值亮度。在斯威夫特之前，人们不可能快速而精确地定位这些爆发，以观察它们的余辉。 2005 年 5 月，Swift 通过 GRB 050509B 实现了这一里程碑，仅持续了 0.03 秒。斯威夫特以足够快的速度转向爆发，检测到 11 个 X 射线光子，这使得这是第一个检测到余辉的短爆发。这些观测结果验证了长期存在的理论模型，表明短伽马射线爆发可能来自两颗中子星的合并，中子星是质量与太阳相当的物体，被压碎到了城市大小。

paras.en: Another factor led to Swift’s success as a kind of astronomical multitool. Its flexible planning system enabled astronomers to request "target-of-opportunity" observations that could be commanded from the ground in as little as a few minutes, or to set up monitoring programs for observing specific sources lasting from as little as a few minutes to months. The system could schedule up to 75 independent targets a day.
paras.zh: 另一个因素导致 Swift 作为一种天文多功能工具取得成功。其灵活的规划系统使天文学家能够请求“机会目标”观测，这些观测可以在短短几分钟内从地面发出指令，或者建立监测计划来观测特定的源，持续时间从短短几分钟到几个月不等。该系统每天最多可以安排 75 个独立目标。

paras.en: "The unique speed of response of the Swift hardware, the extraordinary success of the rapid mission operations, and the closely knit teamwork of the Swift Flight and Science Operations teams placed Swift at the crossroads of burgeoning areas of research," said John Nousek, the mission’s operations director and professor of astronomy and astrophysics in the Eberly College of Science at Penn State in University Park, Pennsylvania.
paras.zh: “Swift 硬件独特的响应速度、快速任务操作的非凡成功，以及 Swift 飞行和科学操作团队紧密的团队合作，使 Swift 处于新兴研究领域的十字路口，”任务操作主任、宾夕法尼亚州立大学埃伯利科学学院天文学和天体物理学教授约翰·努塞克 (John Nousek) 说。

paras.en: The Swift archive contains nearly 22 years of brightness measurements of all kinds of cosmic outbursts, multiwavelength spectra, more than 1.5 million images from its Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope, and much more. The full dataset, publicly available as part of NASA’s commitment to open, gold standard science, spans approximately 12 terabytes, the storage equivalent of about 600 high-definition movies.
paras.zh: Swift 档案包含近 22 年各种宇宙爆发的亮度测量、多波长光谱、来自紫外/光学望远镜的超过 150 万张图像等等。完整的数据集是 NASA 致力于开放、黄金标准科学的一部分，公开提供，其大小约为 12 TB，相当于约 600 部高清电影的存储空间。

paras.en: As part of the agency’s previous planning for Swift’s end of mission, NASA will continue to prioritize finding new options to react rapidly to cosmic events, using current missions to help fill the gap in the meantime.
paras.zh: 作为该机构之前针对雨燕号任务结束计划的一部分，美国宇航局将继续优先寻找新的选择来对宇宙事件做出快速反应，同时利用当前的任务来帮助填补空白。

paras.en: To learn more about the Swift mission, visit:
paras.zh: 要了解有关 Swift 任务的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: NASA’s Artemis III Mission to Test Future Moon Lander Operations
articles.author: Jason Costa

paras.en: Before astronauts return to the lunar surface, NASA will first conduct one of the most ambitious and complex test missions in the agency’s history.
paras.zh: 在宇航员返回月球表面之前，美国宇航局将首先执行该机构历史上最雄心勃勃、最复杂的测试任务之一。

paras.en: Launching in 2027, Artemis III will send NASA astronauts Randy Bresnik, Frank Rubio, Andre Douglas, and ESA (European Space Agency) astronaut Luca Parmitano aboard the Orion spacecraft into low Earth orbit to perform a series of demonstrations with test versions, or test articles, of human landing systems being developed by industry partners Blue Origin and SpaceX. During the planned 14-day mission, crews and flight controllers will practice the rendezvous, docking, habitation, and operational procedures that will be essential when Artemis astronauts begin landing near the Moon’s South Pole in 2028. The mission is designed to reduce risk, validate hardware, and gain operational experience before NASA attempts a crewed lunar landing.
paras.zh: Artemis III 将于 2027 年发射，将把 NASA 宇航员兰迪·布雷斯尼克 (Randy Bresnik)、弗兰克·鲁比奥 (Frank Rubio)、安德烈·道格拉斯 (Andre Douglas) 和欧洲航天局 (ESA) 宇航员卢卡·帕尔米塔诺 (Luca Parmitano) 搭乘猎户座飞船进入近地轨道，对由行业合作伙伴 Blue Origin 和 SpaceX 开发的载人着陆系统的测试版本或测试物品进行一系列演示。在计划为期 14 天的任务中，机组人员和飞行控制人员将练习交会、对接、居住和操作程序，这些对于 2028 年阿耳忒弥斯号宇航员开始在月球南极附近着陆时至关重要。该任务旨在在 NASA 尝试载人登月之前降低风险、验证硬件并获得操作经验。

paras.en: “Every piece of this mission in Earth orbit is designed to reduce risk before we put astronauts back on the Moon,” said Jeremy Parsons, NASA’s Artemis program manager. “We’re launching three spacecraft on three different rockets and testing how they operate together — something NASA has never attempted. Every lesson we learn here gets us closer to landing on the Moon in 2028.”
paras.zh: NASA 阿尔忒弥斯项目经理杰里米·帕森斯 (Jeremy Parsons) 表示：“这次地球轨道任务的每一项任务都是为了在将宇航员送回月球之前降低风险。” “我们正在用三枚不同的火箭发射三艘航天器，并测试它们如何协同运行——这是 NASA 从未尝试过的。我们在这里学到的每一个教训都让我们更接近 2028 年登陆月球。”

paras.en: First stop: Blue Origin’s lunar lander test article
paras.zh: 第一站：蓝色起源的月球着陆器测试文章

paras.en: Earlier Artemis missions used only NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) rocket and Orion spacecraft. Artemis III will involve three separate spacecraft launched on three different heavy-lift rockets within a relatively short period of time.
paras.zh: 早期的阿尔忒弥斯任务仅使用 NASA 的 SLS（太空发射系统）火箭和猎户座飞船。阿耳忒弥斯三号将涉及在相对较短的时间内由三枚不同的重型火箭发射的三艘独立的航天器。

paras.en: The mission begins with Blue Origin launching a test version of its Blue Moon Mark 2 lander into a circular low Earth orbit approximately 273 miles (237 nautical miles) above Earth. The spacecraft can remain on orbit for up to 30 days providing schedule flexibility. Artemis III is designed as a tightly choreographed campaign, with NASA planning to launch Orion on top of SLS from the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida only days after the Blue Moon test article launch and confirmation the vehicle is healthy and ready for joint operations.
paras.zh: 该任务首先将 Blue Origin 的 Blue Moon Mark 2 着陆器测试版本发射到距离地球约 273 英里（237 海里）的圆形近地轨道。该航天器可在轨道上停留长达 30 天，提供时间表灵活性。阿耳忒弥斯 III 被设计为一场精心设计的活动，美国宇航局计划在蓝月测试品发射并确认该飞行器状态良好并准备好进行联合作战几天后，从该机构位于佛罗里达州的肯尼迪航天中心发射猎户座号。

paras.en: Following launch, Orion will initially enter an elliptical Earth orbit of 18 x 1122 miles (16 x 975 nautical miles). It will use its service module to perform a series of maneuvers to transition to a circular orbit at about 345 miles (300 nautical miles) for thermal stabilization before then gradually setting up its rendezvous with the waiting Blue Moon lander test article. Because each spacecraft operates in slightly different orbital regimes optimized for its mission requirements, Artemis III requires a carefully choreographed sequence of orbital maneuvers and rendezvous operations throughout the flight.
paras.zh: 发射后，猎户座将首先进入 18 x 1122 英里（16 x 975 海里）的椭圆地球轨道。它将使用其服务舱执行一系列机动，过渡到约 345 英里（300 海里）的圆形轨道以实现热稳定，然后逐渐与等待的蓝月着陆器测试品建立交会。由于每艘航天器都在针对其任务要求进行优化的略微不同的轨道状态下运行，因此阿耳忒弥斯 III 需要在整个飞行过程中精心设计一系列轨道机动和交会操作。

paras.en: During the first two days of flight, the crew will check out Orion’s systems, prepare for proximity operations, and gradually position themselves for the mission’s first major objective: rendezvous and docking with the Blue Moon test vehicle.
paras.zh: 在飞行的前两天，机组人员将检查猎户座的系统，为近距离操作做好准备，并逐渐为任务的第一个主要目标做好准备：与蓝月测试飞行器交会对接。

paras.en: The operation represents NASA’s first opportunity to evaluate how Orion and a commercial lunar lander work together in space. Engineers will assess how software aboard both spacecraft, guidance systems, communications systems, and operational procedures perform in real-world conditions, while flight controllers gain experience coordinating activities across multiple teams and organizations.
paras.zh: 这次行动是美国宇航局第一次有机会评估猎户座和商业月球着陆器如何在太空中协同工作。工程师将评估航天器上的软件、制导系统、通信系统和操作程序在现实条件下的执行情况，而飞行控制器则获得协调多个团队和组织活动的经验。

paras.en: Once docked, astronauts will spend approximately two days conducting evaluations aboard the Blue Moon test article. Crew members will open the hatch and enter the spacecraft, allowing them to assess the cabin environment, controls, and life-support systems firsthand. Teams will verify the spacecraft’s ability to maintain the proper atmosphere and pressure.
paras.zh: 对接后，宇航员将花费大约两天的时间在蓝月测试品上进行评估。机组人员将打开舱门并进入航天器，以便他们直接评估舱内环境、控制装置和生命支持系统。团队将验证航天器维持适当大气和压力的能力。

paras.en: The Blue Moon test article incorporates many of the avionics, software, flight-control systems, crew-cabin technologies, and life-support functions planned for future lunar missions. Testing those systems in orbit will provide the first opportunity to evaluate how many of the lander’s flight systems perform in space as an integrated vehicle.
paras.zh: 蓝月测试项目包含了为未来月球任务计划的许多航空电子设备、软件、飞行控制系统、乘员舱技术和生命支持功能。在轨道上测试这些系统将首次有机会评估着陆器的飞行系统中有多少作为集成飞行器在太空中运行。

paras.en: By the time Orion undocks, NASA will have completed its first evaluation of a commercial lunar lander with crew, gathering data on spacecraft systems, crew operations, and spacecraft interoperability not possible on the ground.
paras.zh: 当猎户座脱离对接时，美国宇航局将完成对载有机组人员的商业月球着陆器的首次评估，收集有关航天器系统、机组人员操作和地面上无法实现的航天器互操作性的数据。

paras.en: After completing operations with Blue Origin’s lander, Orion will undock and reposition to support the next phase of the mission: a second rendezvous operation.
paras.zh: 在完成蓝色起源着陆器的操作后，猎户座将脱离对接并重新定位以支持任务的下一阶段：第二次交会操作。

paras.en: SpaceX will launch a Starship Version 3 test article from Florida. Because Starship is designed for a much shorter on-orbit lifetime than Blue Origin’s lander, launch occurs later in the mission, allowing NASA to efficiently sequence the two docking demonstrations. Starship will enter a lower orbit at 206 nautical miles, optimized for communications coverage, and will carry an added docking system mounted at the forward end.
paras.zh: SpaceX 将从佛罗里达州发射 Starship Version 3 测试品。由于星舰的设计在轨寿命比蓝色起源的着陆器短得多，因此发射发生在任务后期，使美国宇航局能够有效地排序两次对接演示。星舰将进入 206 海里的低轨道，针对通信覆盖范围进行优化，并将在前端安装一个额外的对接系统。

paras.en: Orion will rendezvous and dock with the spacecraft during a test expected to last up to two hours. Crew will not enter Starship during this test. The demonstration is focused on validating how Orion and Starship interact as a docked system in space. NASA and SpaceX plan to evaluate spacecraft controllability, communications, integrated software performance, and the dynamics associated with docking and undocking operations.
paras.zh: 猎户座飞船将在预计持续两个小时的测试中与航天器交会对接。在此测试期间，船员将不会进入星际飞船。该演示的重点是验证猎户座和星舰如何作为太空中的对接系统进行交互。 NASA 和 SpaceX 计划评估航天器的可控性、通信、集成软件性能以及与对接和脱离操作相关的动态。

paras.en: The docking itself also presents a unique test, using different docking geometries. Orion will connect to a port beside Blue Moon’s crew cabin, then later align its forward docking system with the one at Starship’s nose. Testing both approaches during a single mission gives NASA an opportunity to assess different operational concepts while gathering valuable engineering data.
paras.zh: 对接本身也提供了一种独特的测试，使用不同的对接几何形状。猎户座将连接到蓝月亮船员舱旁边的一个端口，然后将其前向对接系统与星舰机头的对接系统对齐。在一次任务中测试这两种方法使 NASA 有机会评估不同的操作概念，同时收集有价值的工程数据。

paras.en: Together, the two docking campaigns will demonstrate how Orion interfaces with two very different commercial lander architectures during a single mission.
paras.zh: 这两个对接活动将共同展示猎户座在一次任务中如何与两个截然不同的商业着陆器架构对接。

paras.en: Even after docking activities are complete, Artemis III will continue generating data that supports future missions.
paras.zh: 即使对接活动完成后，阿耳忒弥斯三号仍将继续生成支持未来任务的数据。

paras.en: Once the Starship demonstration is complete, Orion and its crew will have up to five additional days available in orbit before beginning preparations for the journey home. NASA plans to use this time to complete a variety of test objectives that support future Artemis missions, including additional evaluations of the Orion Crew Survival System suits, docking sensor tests, acoustic and thermal measurements, human-factors assessments, and a range of science and technology demonstrations.
paras.zh: 一旦星舰演示完成，猎户座及其船员在开始准备回家之旅之前将有最多五天的时间在轨道上运行。 NASA 计划利用这段时间完成支持未来阿尔忒弥斯任务的各种测试目标，包括对猎户座乘员生存系统套装的额外评估、对接传感器测试、声学和热测量、人为因素评估以及一系列科学和技术演示。

paras.en: Several investigations led by NASA will build on studies conducted during Artemis II, collecting additional data that will help inform future deep-space missions. The crew also will conduct a proof-of-concept study examining how astronauts could perform health-related assessments when they are unable to communicate directly with mission control, an important capability for future lunar surface expeditions and other missions farther from Earth.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局领导的几项调查将建立在阿尔忒弥斯二号期间进行的研究的基础上，收集更多数据，为未来的深空任务提供信息。机组人员还将进行一项概念验证研究，研究宇航员在无法直接与任务控制中心通信时如何进行与健康相关的评估，这是未来月球表面探险和其他远离地球的任务的重要能力。

paras.en: NASA also plans to fly a cellular biology experiment during the mission while researchers use the flight to test concepts for returning lunar samples to Earth. Teams will evaluate how future samples could be transported, received, and moved into curation facilities after landing, while also conducting assessments of Orion’s environment to better understand potential contamination considerations for future lunar missions.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局还计划在任务期间进行细胞生物学实验，同时研究人员利用这次飞行来测试将月球样本返回地球的概念。团队将评估未来样本在着陆后如何运输、接收和移入管理设施，同时对猎户座的环境进行评估，以更好地了解未来月球任务的潜在污染考虑因素。

paras.en: The mission also will include Earth and solar observations that help astronauts continue developing critical observation skills while taking advantage of the spacecraft’s unique orbital vantage point. Plant seeds will fly aboard Orion as well, providing opportunities for scientific study and educational engagement following the mission.
paras.zh: 该任务还将包括地球和太阳观测，帮助宇航员继续发展关键的观测技能，同时利用航天器独特的轨道优势。植物种子也将在猎户座飞船上飞行，为任务结束后的科学研究和教育参与提供机会。

paras.en: Mission planners have also built flexibility into the flight timeline, providing additional opportunities to complete test objectives depending on how operations unfold in real time.
paras.zh: 任务规划人员还在飞行时间表中建立了灵活性，根据操作的实时展开情况提供了额外的机会来完成测试目标。

paras.en: When ready, Orion will begin phasing for return, and the crew will configure the cabin for reentry and splashdown, which will occur in the Pacific Ocean, off the coast of California. Orion and its crew will be recovered by NASA personnel and the United States Navy.
paras.zh: 准备就绪后，猎户座将开始分阶段返回，机组人员将配置舱室以进行再入和溅落，这将发生在加利福尼亚州海岸附近的太平洋。猎户座及其船员将由美国宇航局人员和美国海军回收。

paras.en: Every activity performed during Artemis III supports a larger goal: reducing risk before astronauts return to the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯三号期间进行的每项活动都支持一个更大的目标：在宇航员返回月球表面之前降低风险。

paras.en: The mission will provide NASA with experience operating alongside multiple commercial partners while managing complex rendezvous and docking operations involving three different spacecraft. Engineers will gain insight into spacecraft interoperability, mission-control coordination, communications architecture, crew operations, and hardware performance.
paras.zh: 该任务将为美国宇航局提供与多个商业合作伙伴合作的经验，同时管理涉及三个不同航天器的复杂交会对接操作。工程师将深入了解航天器的互操作性、任务控制协调、通信架构、机组人员操作和硬件性能。

paras.en: By the time Artemis III concludes with Orion’s splashdown on Earth, NASA will have demonstrated technologies and operational concepts that future lunar crews will rely on as they travel to and from the Moon.
paras.zh: 当阿耳忒弥斯三号以猎户座溅落地球结束时，美国宇航局将展示未来月球宇航员往返月球时将依赖的技术和操作概念。

paras.en: Most importantly, Artemis III will provide the operational experience needed to transform plans for future lunar landings into proven flight procedures. The lessons learned throughout the mission will help refine future exploration plans, strengthen partnerships with industry, and ensure astronauts are prepared for humanity’s next giant leap at the Moon.
paras.zh: 最重要的是，阿耳忒弥斯三号将提供将未来登月计划转变为经过验证的飞行程序所需的操作经验。在整个任务过程中吸取的经验教训将有助于完善未来的探索计划，加强与工业界的合作伙伴关系，并确保宇航员为人类在月球上的下一次巨大飞跃做好准备。

paras.en: As part of a Golden Age of innovation and exploration, NASA will send Artemis astronauts on increasingly difficult missions near the lunar South Pole to explore more of the Moon than ever before. In addition to providing economic benefits and advancing scientific discovery through its Moon missions, NASA will establish an enduring human presence on the lunar surface and build on the agency’s foundation for the first crewed mission to Mars.
paras.zh: 作为创新和探索黄金时代的一部分，美国宇航局将派遣阿耳忒弥斯宇航员前往月球南极附近执行日益艰巨的任务，以探索比以往更多的月球区域。除了通过月球任务提供经济效益和推进科学发现外，美国宇航局还将在月球表面建立持久的人类存在，并为该机构首次载人火星任务奠定基础。

articles.title: NASA, Partners Accelerate Lander Development for 2028 Moon Missions
articles.author: Lee Mohon

paras.en: As NASA returns humans to the lunar surface and establishes a long-term presence on our closest celestial neighbor, the agency and commercial human landing system providers Blue Origin and SpaceX have streamlined the designs and changed both concepts of operations for its future crewed landers.
paras.zh: 随着美国宇航局 (NASA) 将人类送回月球表面，并在我们最近的天体邻居上建立长期存在，该机构和商业载人着陆系统提供商蓝色起源 (Blue Origin) 和 SpaceX 已经简化了设计，并改变了未来载人着陆器的操作概念。

paras.en: Since NASA established initial contracts with Blue Origin and SpaceX for crewed missions to the Moon, the agency has redefined Artemis III to demonstrate rendezvous and docking capabilities between test versions of landers from each provider and the agency’s Orion spacecraft in low Earth orbit next year. In parallel, the companies are also developing crew and cargo versions of their landers for near-term Artemis missions.
paras.zh: 自从 NASA 与 Blue Origin 和 SpaceX 签订了载人登月任务的初步合同以来，该机构重新定义了 Artemis III，以展示明年各提供商的着陆器测试版本与该机构在近地轨道上的猎户座飞船之间的交会对接能力。与此同时，两家公司还在为近期的阿尔忒弥斯任务开发载人和货运版本的着陆器。

paras.en: “We are executing President Trump’s National Space Policy to complete the long-awaited return of American astronauts to the lunar surface in 2028 and establish a Moon Base,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “We have a proven foundation in SLS and Orion, along with two lunar landers in development with Blue Origin and SpaceX. But NASA has no intention of sitting idly by as all the pieces come together. That is not how Apollo succeeded, and it is not how the near-impossible is achieved. NASA is energized, our core capabilities are being rebuilt, our machine shops are running 24/7, and our experts are in the field attacking the critical path. We are building a Super Bowl-caliber team to safely achieve these objectives and everything that comes next.”
paras.zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 表示：“我们正在执行特朗普总统的国家太空政策，以完成美国宇航员期待已久的 2028 年重返月球表面并建立月球基地的任务。” “我们在 SLS 和猎户座方面拥有经过验证的基础，以及蓝色起源和 SpaceX 正在开发的两个月球着陆器。但 NASA 无意在所有部件组装在一起时袖手旁观。这不是阿波罗成功的方式，也不是实现近乎不可能的任务的方式。NASA 充满活力，我们的核心能力正在重建，我们的机械车间正在 24/7 运行，我们的专家正在现场攻击关键路径。我们正在建造一个超级碗级别的飞船团队安全地实现这些目标以及接下来的一切。”

paras.en: NASA is energized, our core capabilities are being rebuilt, our machine shops are running 24/7, and our experts are in the field attacking the critical path. We are building a Super Bowl-caliber team to safely achieve these objectives and everything that comes next.
paras.zh: NASA 充满活力，我们的核心能力正在重建，我们的机械车间全天候 (24/7) 运行，我们的专家在现场攻克关键路径。我们正在打造一支超级碗级别的团队，以安全地实现这些目标以及接下来的一切。

paras.en: For the initial crewed missions to the Moon, Artemis astronauts will launch in the agency’s Orion spacecraft on top of the SLS (Space Launch System) rocket from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. During each Artemis mission, a commercial human landings system will link up with Orion before taking two crew members to the lunar surface while two remain aboard Orion. To accelerate development toward a 2028 landing, the Artemis landers and Orion will no longer rendezvous in a near-rectilinear halo orbit around the Moon and instead meet up in an orbit that differs for each partner, informed by their systems.
paras.zh: 在最初的载人登月任务中，阿耳忒弥斯宇航员将乘坐该机构的猎户座飞船，搭载在美国宇航局佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心的 SLS（太空发射系统）火箭顶部进行发射。在每次阿耳忒弥斯任务期间，商业载人着陆系统将与猎户座连接，然后将两名宇航员带到月球表面，而猎户座上还有两名宇航员。为了加速 2028 年着陆的开发，阿耳忒弥斯着陆器和猎户座将不再在绕月的近直线光晕轨道上会合，而是在各自系统通知的不同轨道上会合。

paras.en: Both companies are required to perform an uncrewed demonstration mission with their crewed landers prior to the near-term Artemis crewed missions to the Moon. NASA will certify lander systems prior to the crewed missions to ensure safety and mission success.
paras.zh: 在近期的阿耳忒弥斯载人登月任务之前，两家公司都需要用载人着陆器执行无人演示任务。美国宇航局将在载人任务之前对着陆器系统进行认证，以确保安全和任务成功。

paras.en: SpaceX continues to plan for an in-space propellant aggregation approach to transfer super cold, or cryogenic, liquid propellant in space. The company will launch multiple versions of Starship to low Earth orbit prior to the launch of the Starship Human Landing System (HLS) from Florida. Similar to a gas station on Earth, the series of propellant “tanker” Starships in low Earth orbit will transfer propellant to the waiting “depot” Starship. The depot Starship will ultimately fuel the Starship lander for its journey to the Moon.
paras.zh: SpaceX 继续计划采用太空推进剂聚合方法，在太空中传输超冷或低温液体推进剂。在从佛罗里达州发射星舰人类着陆系统（HLS）之前，该公司将向近地轨道发射多个版本的星舰。与地球上的加油站类似，近地轨道上的一系列推进剂“加油机”星舰将把推进剂输送到等待的“仓库”星舰。星舰补给站最终将为星舰着陆器的月球之旅提供燃料。

paras.en: Under the revised operations, Starship HLS will await Orion and its crew in Earth orbit. The lander and Orion will rendezvous and dock in Earth orbit, then the Starship lander will perform a trans-lunar injection burn to send the combined lander and Orion stack to low lunar orbit. NASA is working to modify Orion to enable Starship to push it to the Moon. The lander will bring two crew members to the lunar surface for several days before delivering them back to Orion for the ride back to Earth.
paras.zh: 根据修改后的操作，星舰 HLS 将在地球轨道上等待猎户座及其机组人员。着陆器和猎户座将在地球轨道上交会对接，然后星舰着陆器将进行跨月注入燃烧，将着陆器和猎户座组合体送入低月球轨道。美国宇航局正在努力改造猎户座，使星际飞船能够将其推向月球。着陆器将把两名宇航员带到月球表面几天，然后将他们送回猎户座，然后返回地球。

paras.en: Propellant aggregation in low Earth orbit allows for flexibility in the crew launch timing on SLS, while a trans-lunar injection burn performed by the Starship lander will enable direct access to low lunar orbit. This new concept of operations using low lunar orbit will significantly lower the amount of propellant Starship needs to aggregate in space while reducing the amount of time it can take for astronauts leaving the Moon’s surface in Starship to link back up with Orion. SpaceX will demonstrate the propellant aggregation approach during the uncrewed demonstration mission.
paras.zh: 低地球轨道上的推进剂聚集可以让宇航员在 SLS 上的发射时间具有灵活性，而星舰着陆器进行的跨月喷射燃烧将能够直接进入低月球轨道。这种利用低月球轨道进行操作的新概念将显着降低星际飞船在太空中聚集所需的推进剂数量，同时减少宇航员乘坐星际飞船离开月球表面与猎户座建立联系所需的时间。 SpaceX 将在无人演示任务中展示推进剂聚集方法。

paras.en: For its accelerated 2028 crewed lunar landing mission, Blue Origin will defer propellant transfer and use three transfer stages to send the Blue Moon Mark 2 Alpha Lander to the Moon. Based on existing Mark 1 and Mark 2 hardware, the stages operate like a multistage rocket. They launch into low Earth orbit, followed by the Mark 2 lander. Once docked, the stack departs for an elliptical polar orbit around the Moon, with each transfer stage separating as its propellant depletes. Compared with the previously planned near-rectilinear halo orbit, the elliptical polar orbit offers faster returns from the lunar surface to Orion, reduces Blue Moon lander propellant requirements, and maximizes the performance available by SLS.
paras.zh: 对于 2028 年加速载人登月任务，蓝色起源将推迟推进剂转移，并使用三个转移阶段将蓝月 Mark 2 阿尔法着陆器送上月球。基于现有的 Mark 1 和 Mark 2 硬件，这些级的运行方式就像多级火箭。它们发射到近地轨道，随后是 Mark 2 着陆器。一旦对接，燃料堆就会离开绕月的椭圆极地轨道，每个转移级随着推进剂的耗尽而分离。与之前规划的近直线晕轨道相比，椭圆极轨道可以更快地从月球表面返回猎户座，减少蓝月着陆器推进剂的需求，并最大限度地提高SLS的性能。

paras.en: This architecture provides multiple opportunities for SLS and Orion to launch the crew to elliptical polar orbit and dock with the Blue Moon Mark 2 lander. Two crew members then transfer to the lander and descend to the Moon’s South Pole. After surface operations, the lander returns to Orion, where the crew transfers for their journey back to Earth.
paras.zh: 这种架构为 SLS 和 Orion 提供了多种机会将宇航员送入椭圆极地轨道并与 Blue Moon Mark 2 着陆器对接。然后两名机组人员转移到着陆器并下降到月球的南极。地面操作结束后，着陆器返回猎户座，机组人员在那里转机返回地球。

paras.en: Blue Origin will incorporate lessons from earlier robotic Mark 1 missions supporting the agency’s Moon Base Program and demonstrate the full mission profile in an uncrewed lander transfer stage demonstration mission.
paras.zh: 蓝色起源将吸收早期支持该机构月球基地计划的机器人 Mark 1 任务的经验教训，并在无人登陆器转移阶段演示任务中展示完整的任务概况。

paras.en: Returning American astronauts to the Moon
paras.zh: 让美国宇航员重返月球

paras.en: Ultimately, based on lander readiness, NASA will determine which company will be first selected to safely deliver astronauts to the Moon’s surface and back to lunar orbit in 2028. A second crewed landing opportunity will follow.
paras.zh: 最终，根据着陆器的准备情况，NASA 将确定哪家公司将首先被选中在 2028 年将宇航员安全运送到月球表面并返回月球轨道。第二次载人着陆机会将随之而来。

paras.en: NASA is targeting two, approximately two-hour long lunar surface Moonwalks during initial surface missions. Astronauts will use the Moonwalks to collection lunar samples and test capabilities of the spacesuit provided by Axiom Space.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的目标是在最初的表面任务中进行两次约两小时长的月球表面月球漫步。宇航员将使用月球漫步来收集月球样本并测试 Axiom Space 提供的宇航服的功能。

paras.en: Earlier this year, NASA updated its contracts with Blue Origin and SpaceX for human landing systems and large cargo deliveries to the Moon. The updates align the agency’s human landing system requirements with acceleration efforts announced earlier this year to streamline Artemis mission architecture, expedite a lunar return, and support an increased mission cadence to the Moon.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，美国宇航局更新了与蓝色起源和 SpaceX 的载人着陆系统和向月球运送大型货物的合同。这些更新使该机构的载人着陆系统要求与今年早些时候宣布的加速工作保持一致，以简化阿耳忒弥斯任务架构、加快月球返回并支持增加登月任务节奏。

paras.en: Under the original HLS contracts, SpaceX’s Starship human landing system was assigned to the Artemis III and IV missions, while Blue Origin would use its Blue Moon Mark 2 human landing system for Artemis V. Under the contract realignments, both providers are participating in the Artemis III mission in low Earth orbit and neither lander provider has been assigned to a specific Artemis lunar landing mission.
paras.zh: 根据最初的 HLS 合同，SpaceX 的 Starship 载人着陆系统被分配给 Artemis III 和 IV 任务，而 Blue Origin 将使用其 Blue Moon Mark 2 载人着陆系统执行 Artemis V 任务。根据合同调整，两家提供商都将参与近地轨道的 Artemis III 任务，并且两家着陆器提供商都没有被分配到特定的 Artemis 月球着陆任务。

paras.en: “NASA and our lunar lander providers Blue Origin and SpaceX have been working hand in hand to ensure we can return American astronauts to the Moon by 2028,” said Jeremy Parsons, NASA’s Artemis program manager.“While work to realign with our partners in support of architecture updates announced at Ignition Day in March has been underway since then, updating the contracts ensures NASA and its partners are on the same page with requirements and other milestones to ensure continued insight into lander development to support mission success and the safety of our Moon crews.”
paras.zh: NASA 的 Artemis 项目经理杰里米·帕森斯 (Jeremy Parsons) 表示：“NASA 与我们的月球着陆器提供商 Blue Origin 和 SpaceX 一直携手合作，确保我们能够在 2028 年将美国宇航员送回月球。虽然自那时起我们一直在与合作伙伴重新协调，以支持 3 月份点火日宣布的架构更新，但更新合同可确保 NASA 及其合作伙伴在要求和其他里程碑方面达成共识，以确保持续深入了解着陆器开发支持任务的成功和我们月球宇航员的安全。”

paras.en: Both Blue Origin and SpaceX have added development milestones to provide NASA with more insight into lander development efforts, reducing risk and enhancing astronaut safety in preparation for crewed Moon landings. SpaceX is adding two demonstrations of its crew cabin, called Cabin 1, for its Starship lander. Blue Origin is adding new human-in-the-loop testing and hardware readiness milestones to streamline training development as well as ground and flight operations.
paras.zh: 蓝色起源和 SpaceX 都增加了开发里程碑，让 NASA 能够更深入地了解着陆器的开发工作，降低风险并提高宇航员的安全，为载人登月做好准备。 SpaceX 正在为其 Starship 着陆器添加两个乘员舱演示，称为 Cabin 1。蓝色起源正在增加新的人机交互测试和硬件就绪里程碑，以简化培训开发以及地面和飞行操作。

paras.en: As part of a Golden Age of innovation and exploration, NASA will send Artemis astronauts on increasingly difficult missions near the lunar South Pole to explore more of the Moon than ever before. In addition to providing economic benefits and advancing scientific discovery though its Moon missions, NASA will establish an enduring human presence on the lunar surface and build on the agency’s foundation for the first crewed mission to Mars.
paras.zh: 作为创新和探索黄金时代的一部分，美国宇航局将派遣阿耳忒弥斯宇航员前往月球南极附近执行日益艰巨的任务，以探索比以往更多的月球区域。除了通过月球任务提供经济效益和推进科学发现外，美国宇航局还将在月球表面建立持久的人类存在，并为该机构首次载人火星任务奠定基础。

articles.title: Sudan: Drone strikes killed at least 306 people in three weeks

paras.en: Sudan: Drone strikes killed at least 306 people in three weeks
paras.zh: 苏丹：无人机袭击三周内至少造成 306 人死亡

paras.en: UN human rights chief Volker Türk on Friday strongly condemned an escalation in drone strikes across Sudan this month, which killed at least 306 people and injured hundreds more in the first three weeks of October alone.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克周五强烈谴责本月苏丹各地无人机袭击升级，仅在 10 月的前三周就造成至少 306 人死亡、数百人受伤。

paras.en: The strikes, attributed to both the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), hit homes, markets, hospitals, displacement sites, power stations and water sources in Kordofan, Darfur, Blue Nile, Khartoum and other states, according to the UN human rights office (OHCHR).
paras.zh: 据联合国人权高专办称，苏丹武装部队（SAF）和快速支援部队（RSF）发动的袭击袭击了科尔多凡州、达尔富尔州、青尼罗州、喀土穆和其他州的房屋、市场、医院、流离失所地点、发电站和水源。

paras.en: “The increasing use of drones, already accounting for the majority of conflict-related civilian deaths in Sudan this year, is deeply disturbing and is exacting a horrifying toll,” Mr. Türk said.
paras.zh: 图尔克先生说：“无人机的使用日益增多，已经造成了今年苏丹与冲突有关的平民死亡的大部分，这令人深感不安，造成了可怕的伤亡。”

paras.en: In a particularly disturbing trend, the office documented numerous strikes on displacement sites, where people who had already fled the fighting had sought shelter.
paras.zh: 一个特别令人不安的趋势是，该办公室记录了对流离失所地点的多次袭击，已经逃离战斗的人们在那里寻求庇护。

paras.en: Between 6 and 10 October, alleged drone strikes attributed to military government forces on shelters for displaced people in Ghubeish and El Nuhud in West Kordofan killed at least 25 civilians, including women and children.
paras.zh: 10 月 6 日至 10 日期间，据称军政府部队对西科尔多凡州古拜什 (Ghubeish) 和努胡德 (El Nuhud) 流离失所者避难所发动无人机袭击，造成至少 25 名平民死亡，其中包括妇女和儿童。

paras.en: On 9 October, an alleged RSF drone struck a crowd of displaced people engaged in artisanal gold mining near a displacement site in Abu Shendi, Blue Nile, killing at least 31 people, most of them women and children.
paras.zh: 10 月 9 日，一架据称无国界医生组织的无人机袭击了青尼罗州 Abu Shendi 流离失所地点附近从事手工金矿开采的一群流离失所者，造成至少 31 人死亡，其中大多数是妇女和儿童。

paras.en: On 18 October, at least 139 people were killed when a transportation truck was hit in a “double tap” repeat strike in Dibab, West Kordofan, an area controlled by the RSF militia.
paras.zh: 10 月 18 日，一辆运输卡车在无国界医生组织民兵控制的西科尔多凡州迪巴布的“双击”重复袭击中被击中，造成至少 139 人死亡。

paras.en: Markets and hospitals have also been hit, including an RSF-attributed strike on Um Darfa hospital in Blue Nile on 11 October that seriously injured two health workers and left the facility non-operational.
paras.zh: 市场和医院也受到了打击，包括 10 月 11 日无国界医生组织对青尼罗州 Um Darfa 医院发起的罢工，导致两名医护人员严重受伤，导致该设施无法运营。

paras.en: “Scores of civilians have been killed, including internally displaced persons, and vital infrastructure and services have been eviscerated, driving further displacement and deepening the already severe humanitarian crisis,” said OHCHR Spokesperson Seif Magango.
paras.zh: 人权高专办发言人赛义夫·马甘戈表示：“包括境内流离失所者在内的数十名平民被杀，重要的基础设施和服务被毁，导致更多人流离失所，加剧了本已严重的人道主义危机。”

paras.en: Peacekeepers with the UN Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA) this week visited communities affected by a drone attack on 19 October on Amiet Market and the Todach area in Abyei, the disputed oil-rich region between Sudan and South Sudan. The attack killed more than 80 people.
paras.zh: 联合国阿卜耶伊临时安全部队（联阿安全部队）的维和人员本周走访了受 10 月 19 日无人机袭击影响的社区，阿米耶特市场和阿卜耶伊托达赫地区是苏丹和南苏丹之间有争议的石油资源丰富地区。这次袭击造成80多人死亡。

paras.en: UNISFA troops were the first to reach the scene, where “every shop was burning”, said Lieutenant Colonel Muhammad Farooq, commander of the Mission’s Pakistani battalion.
paras.zh: 联阿安全部队巴基斯坦营指挥官穆罕默德·法鲁克中校说，联阿安全部队部队第一个到达现场，“所有商店都在燃烧”。

paras.en: The Mission deployed quick reaction and firefighting teams to stop the fire spreading and took more than 27 injured people to its hospital in Todach, according to Acting Force Commander Brigadier General Adebowale Ajabge.
paras.zh: 代理部队指挥官阿德博瓦莱·阿贾布准将表示，特派团部署了快速反应和消防小组来阻止火势蔓延，并将超过 27 名伤者送往托达赫的医院。

paras.en: Angelina Musa Diaw, a trader and mother of three, said she had lost everything. “No work, everything is gone,” she said. “I am here with my children. But I need help.”
paras.zh: 安吉丽娜·穆萨·迪奥 (Angelina Musa Diaw) 是一名商人，也是三个孩子的母亲，她说她失去了一切。 “没有工作，一切都消失了，”她说。 “我和我的孩子们在一起。但我需要帮助。”

paras.en: In a statement released Friday, the Security Council condemned the Abyei attack “in the strongest terms”, warning that the death toll is expected to rise as UNISFA continues to verify casualties. They stressed that attacks on civilians could amount to war crimes and called for a full, transparent and prompt investigation, with those responsible held to account.
paras.zh: 在周五发布的一份声明中，安理会“以最强烈的措辞”谴责阿卜耶伊袭击事件，并警告称，随着联阿安全部队继续核实伤亡情况，死亡人数预计还会上升。他们强调，对平民的袭击可能构成战争罪，并呼吁进行全面、透明和迅速的调查，追究责任人的责任。

paras.en: The council reaffirmed that Abyei must remain demilitarized and free of all forces except UNISFA, and called on all actors to end military operations and occupation in the area. Members urged all parties to work with the Mission to protect civilians, aid workers and peacekeepers.
paras.zh: 安理会重申阿卜耶伊必须保持非军事化，不受除联阿安全部队以外的所有部队的影响，并呼吁所有行为体结束该地区的军事行动和占领。成员们敦促各方与特派团合作，保护平民、援助人员和维和人员。

paras.en: Mr. Türk called on the parties to respect their obligations under international humanitarian law (IHL), including by not directing attacks against civilians and civilian objects.
paras.zh: 图尔克先生呼吁各方尊重国际人道法规定的义务，包括不针对平民和民用物体进行攻击。

paras.en: “Broader peace efforts must squarely address the continued influx of arms that is fuelling the conflict and press for an end to the transfer of arms that are used in manifest disregard of the IHL obligations protecting civilians,” he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“更广泛的和平努力必须正视武器不断涌入、加剧冲突的问题，并敦促停止转让武器，因为这些武器明显无视国际人道法保护平民的义务。”

paras.en: “I urge both parties to the conflict, and their affiliates, to commit to a ceasefire,” the High Commissioner added, stressing that a negotiated settlement with human rights at its core, underpinned by accountability, is the only feasible pathway to sustainable peace in Sudan.
paras.zh: 高级专员补充说：“我敦促冲突双方及其附属机构承诺停火。”他强调，以人权为核心、以问责制为基础的谈判解决方案是苏丹实现可持续和平的唯一可行途径。

articles.title: West Bank: Guterres alarmed as Israel imposes sweeping closures after deadly Hebron attack

paras.en: West Bank: Guterres alarmed as Israel imposes sweeping closures after deadly Hebron attack
paras.zh: 西岸：古特雷斯对以色列在希伯伦致命袭击后实施全面封锁感到震惊

paras.en: The UN said on Friday it was “extremely alarmed” by intensifying violence in the occupied West Bank, as Israel moved to seal off the territory following a deadly attack on its soldiers in Hebron.
paras.zh: 联合国周五表示，对被占领的约旦河西岸暴力事件加剧感到“极度震惊”，以色列在希伯伦士兵遭到致命袭击后采取行动封锁了该地区。

paras.en: Two Israeli soldiers were killed and at least five injured when gunmen opened fire near a military checkpoint outside the city, according to news reports. The two Palestinian attackers were also killed.
paras.zh: 据新闻报道，枪手在城外军事检查站附近开枪，造成两名以色列士兵死亡，至少五人受伤。两名巴勒斯坦袭击者也被打死。

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered Hebron sealed, pledged house-to-house raids and home demolitions, and reportedly threatened a wider assault on a scale not seen since the Six-Day War. It is the fourth time in a month that Israel has imposed restrictions across the territory.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡下令封锁希伯伦，承诺进行挨家挨户的突袭和拆除房屋，据报道还威胁要进行更广泛的袭击，其规模是六日战争以来从未有过的。这是以色列一个月内第四次在该领土实施限制。

paras.en: Speaking at the noon briefing in New York, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said Secretary-General António Guterres was deeply concerned by the closures and by reports of home demolitions and possible displacement in Hebron.
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克在纽约中午举行的新闻发布会上表示，秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯对希伯伦的封锁以及有关房屋被拆毁和可能流离失所的报道深表关切。

paras.en: “Those closures severely restrict Palestinians’ freedom of movement, access to basic services and livelihoods,” he said.
paras.zh: “这些封锁严重限制了巴勒斯坦人的行动自由、获得基本服务和生计的机会，”他说。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres condemned “the violence caused by record numbers of attacks by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in 2026”, recalling Israel’s obligation as the occupying power “to protect the Palestinian population from such attacks and to hold perpetrators to account”.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯谴责“2026年以色列定居者对巴勒斯坦人发动创纪录数量的袭击所造成的暴力”，并回顾以色列作为占领国的义务“保护巴勒斯坦人民免受此类袭击并追究肇事者的责任”。

paras.en: Mayy El Sheikh, spokesperson for the UN human rights office (OHCHR) in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, said the lockdown was “yet another episode in a never-ending stream of suffocating measures making life more and more unbearable for Palestinians.”
paras.zh: 联合国人权高专办驻巴勒斯坦被占领土发言人梅伊·谢赫表示，封锁是“永无止境的令人窒息的措施中的又一插曲，使巴勒斯坦人的生活变得越来越难以忍受。”

paras.en: “It follows a pattern of collective punishment whenever Palestinians commit acts of violence against Israeli settlers or soldiers,” she said, noting that similar incidents had previously brought lockdowns, intensified raids and arbitrary detentions.
paras.zh: 她说：“每当巴勒斯坦人对以色列定居者或士兵实施暴力行为时，就会采取集体惩罚的模式。”她指出，类似事件此前曾导致封锁、强化袭击和任意拘留。

paras.en: Hebron’s entrances and exits were closed after Friday’s attack, she said, and the Ibrahimi Mosque was shut, leaving worshippers unable to perform Friday prayers.
paras.zh: 她说，周五袭击事件发生后，希伯伦的出入口被关闭，易卜拉希米清真寺也被关闭，导致信徒无法进行周五祈祷。

paras.en: The closure comes at the height of the olive harvest.
paras.zh: 关闭正值橄榄收获高峰期。

paras.en: “Israeli movement restrictions are already preventing thousands of Palestinian farmers from reaching their olives for the harvest,” Ms. El Sheikh said. “This is bound to have devastating effects on the season.”
paras.zh: “以色列的行动限制已经导致数千名巴勒斯坦农民无法采收橄榄，”谢赫女士说。 “这势必会对本赛季产生毁灭性影响。”

paras.en: OHCHR has documented more than 160 settler attacks in the first two weeks of October alone, involving live ammunition, arson, crop theft and damage to olive groves.
paras.zh: 仅在 10 月的前两周，人权高专办就记录了超过 160 起定居者袭击事件，涉及实弹、纵火、盗窃农作物和破坏橄榄园。

paras.en: Settlers also targeted European Union diplomats, and a Washington Post photojournalist was badly assaulted a week ago by masked settlers while covering the harvest near Ramallah.
paras.zh: 定居者还针对欧盟外交官，一周前《华盛顿邮报》的一名摄影记者在报道拉马拉附近的收成时遭到蒙面定居者的严重袭击。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres also remained deeply concerned about civilian deaths in Gaza, including children, and severe aid restrictions ahead of winter.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生还对加沙平民（包括儿童）的死亡以及冬季到来之前的严格援助限制深感担忧。

paras.en: He called on all parties “to immediately cease all acts of violence, to exercise restraint and refrain from action that could further inflame tensions”.
paras.zh: 他呼吁各方“立即停止一切暴力行为，保持克制，避免采取可能进一步加剧紧张局势的行动”。

articles.title: Blood brothers: WHO chief joins ENHYPEN to celebrate drive success

paras.en: Blood brothers: WHO chief joins ENHYPEN to celebrate drive success
paras.zh: 亲兄弟：世卫组织总干事加入 ENHYPEN 庆祝行动取得成功

paras.en: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus met the band’s six members – Jungwon, Jay, Jake, Sunghoon, Sunoo and Ni-ki – in Korea to celebrate their work with WHO for World Blood Donor Day in June.
paras.zh: 谭德塞 (Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus) 在韩国会见了乐队的六位成员：Jungwon、Jay、Jake、Sunghoon、Sunoo 和 Ni-ki，庆祝他们在 6 月份的世界献血者日与世界卫生组织合作。

paras.en: The campaign harnessed music, social media and the band’s global fan community, known as ENGENE, to encourage voluntary, unpaid blood donation.
paras.zh: 该活动利用音乐、社交媒体和乐队的全球粉丝社区（称为 ENGENE）来鼓励自愿无偿献血。

paras.en: “Blood is the most precious gift that anyone can give to another person – the gift of life,” WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said on Friday.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事谭德塞周五表示：“血液是任何人可以给予他人的最珍贵的礼物，即生命的礼物。”

paras.en: “I am proud of all ENHYPEN members’ commitment and collaboration with WHO to promote blood donation and save lives,” said Tedros.
paras.zh: 谭德塞表示：“我对所有 ENHYPEN 成员在促进献血和拯救生命方面做出的承诺以及与世卫组织的合作感到自豪。”

paras.en: “The last campaign was a great success, reaching millions of people. ENHYPEN and ENGENE have the real power to influence the world.”
paras.zh: “上一次活动取得了巨大成功，覆盖了数百万人。ENHYPEN 和 ENGENE 拥有影响世界的真正力量。”

paras.en: When ENHYPEN got on board World Blood Donor Day with the UN health agency back in June, band members visited a local Red Cross centre in Korea to donate.
paras.zh: 六月，当 ENHYPEN 与联合国卫生机构一起参加世界献血者日时，乐队成员参观了韩国当地的红十字中心进行捐赠。

paras.en: “We launched this campaign hoping our fans would join us and we’re grateful to see ENGENEs from all around the world taking part,” they said. “We hope to continue creating meaningful change together with our fans.”
paras.zh: 他们说：“我们发起了这项活动，希望我们的粉丝能够加入我们，我们很高兴看到来自世界各地的 ENGENE 参与其中。” “我们希望继续与我们的粉丝一起创造有意义的改变。”

paras.en: Part of the band’s efforts including collaborating with WHO to promote the donation drive and publicise the critical importance of blood donations through videos and powerful social media messages.
paras.zh: 乐队的部分努力包括与世卫组织合作，推动献血活动，并通过视频和强大的社交媒体信息宣传献血的重要性。

paras.en: According to WHO, the Drop Your Drop campaign has received more than 9,000 pledges to donate blood from 177 countries, including more than 3,250 ENHYPEN fans.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，“Drop Your Drop”活动已收到来自 177 个国家的 9,000 多人的献血承诺，其中包括超过 3,250 名 ENHYPEN 粉丝。

articles.title: Ouattara rescues point for Brentford at Hull

paras.en: Hull City 1-1 Brentford: Dango Ouattara rescues point for Bees after Oli McBurnie penalty
paras.zh: 赫尔城 1-1 布伦特福德：丹戈·瓦塔拉在奥利·麦克伯尼点球后为蜜蜂队挽救一分

paras.en: Report and free match highlights as Dango Ouattara's second-half equaliser earns Brentford a 1-1 draw at Hull after Oli McBurnie's penalty put the hosts ahead, extending Hull's winless Premier League run to six games
paras.zh: 报告和免费比赛亮点：丹戈·瓦塔拉下半场扳平比分，奥利·麦克伯尼的点球让主队领先，布伦特福德队以 1-1 战平赫尔城，将赫尔城的英超联赛不胜纪录扩大到六场

paras.en: Brentford fought back to earn a 1-1 draw at Hull City after Dango Ouattara cancelled out Oli McBurnie's first-half penalty, extending the hosts' winless run in the Premier League to six games.
paras.zh: 在丹戈·瓦塔拉取消了奥利·麦克伯尼上半场的点球后，布伦特福德队以1-1战平赫尔城，将主队在英超联赛中的不胜纪录扩大到六场。

paras.en: Hull had looked on course for a valuable victory after taking the lead in the 25th minute. Brentford goalkeeper Caoimhin Kelleher played a poor pass towards Aaron Hickey, allowing Everton loanee Tim Iroegbunam to win possession before being brought down by the defender. Hickey received a yellow card and McBurnie calmly converted from the spot to score his first Premier League goal of the season.
paras.zh: 赫尔城在第25分钟取得领先后，有望取得一场宝贵的胜利。布伦特福德门将考伊欣·凯莱赫(Caoimhin Kelleher)向亚伦·希基(Aaron Hickey)传球不佳，让埃弗顿租借球员蒂姆·伊罗格布纳姆(Tim Iroegbunam)赢得控球权，但被后卫放倒。希基吃到黄牌，麦克伯尼冷静地从场上转换，打进了他本赛季的第一个英超进球。

paras.en: - Live Premier League table | Watch FREE PL highlights
paras.zh: - 实时英超联赛积分榜|免费观看 PL 精彩集锦

paras.en: - Got Sky? Watch Premier League games LIVE on your phone📱
paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看英超联赛直播📱

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Get Sky Sports or stream with no contract on NOW 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？立即免费观看天空体育或直播 📺

paras.en: Sergej Jakirovic's side were the better team for much of the first half, disrupting Brentford's rhythm and limiting their attacking threat. Hull also appealed unsuccessfully for a second penalty when Regan Slater went down under a challenge from Sepp van den Berg. At the other end, Semi Ajayi impressed with his defensive work as Brentford struggled to create clear chances.
paras.zh: 谢尔盖·雅基罗维奇的球队在上半场的大部分时间里都是表现更好的球队，扰乱了布伦特福德的节奏并限制了他们的进攻威胁。当雷根·斯莱特在塞普·范登伯格的挑战下摔倒时，赫尔城也对第二个点球提出了上诉，但没有成功。在另一端，塞米·阿贾伊的防守表现给人留下了深刻的印象，而布伦特福德则努力创造明显的机会。

paras.en: Keith Andrews' side improved after the break and found their equaliser in the 63rd minute. Igor Thiago helped keep a ball alive in the box before setting up Ouattara, who finished from close range to bring Brentford level. The visitors grew in confidence after the goal, with substitutes Mikkel Damsgaard and Aaron Anthony helping to inject fresh energy into their attack.
paras.zh: 基思·安德鲁斯的球队在中场休息后有所改善，并在第 63 分钟扳平比分。伊戈尔·蒂亚戈在禁区内帮助球队保住了皮球，然后传球给瓦塔拉，瓦塔拉近距离射门将布伦特福德扳平。进球后客队信心大增，替补出场的米克尔·达姆斯加德和亚伦·安东尼为球队的进攻注入了新的能量。

paras.en: Both sides had opportunities to win it late on. Hull goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis denied a close-range effort from Mohamed-Ali Cho, while substitute Joe Gelhardt was unable to convert a late chance after good work from Cho.
paras.zh: 双方在最后时刻都有机会获胜。赫尔城门将康斯坦丁诺斯·佐拉基斯挡出了穆罕默德·阿里·乔的近距离射门，而替补球员乔·格尔哈特在乔的出色表现后未能在最后时刻抓住机会。

paras.en: The draw leaves Hull still searching for a first league victory in six games, while Brentford return home with a point after recovering from a disappointing first-half display. Brentford are now sixth in the Premier League with 11 points from eight games, while Hull climb to 10th on 10 points.
paras.zh: 这场平局使得赫尔城仍在寻求六场比赛中的首场联赛胜利，而布伦特福德在从上半场令人失望的表现中恢复过来后带着一分回到主场。布伦特福德目前在八场比赛中积 11 分排名英超第六，而赫尔城积 10 分升至第十。

paras.en: 25: GOAL! McBurnie puts Hull ahead from the penalty spot after a dreadful Kelleher pass leaves Hickey in trouble and Iroegbunam is fouled. The striker makes no mistake.
paras.zh: 25：目标！凯莱赫可怕的传球让希基陷入困境，而伊罗格布纳姆也被犯规，麦克伯尼将点球点推向赫尔城。前锋没有犯错。

paras.en: 32: NO PENALTY! Slater goes down in the box under a challenge from van den Berg, but the referee's decision not to award a spot-kick stands after a check.
paras.zh: 32：没有处罚！斯莱特在范登伯格的挑衅下倒地，但裁判在检查后决定不判点球。

paras.en: 63: GOAL! Brentford are level! Thiago keeps the ball alive in the area and tees up Ouattara, who taps home from close range to bring the Bees back into the game.
paras.zh: 63：目标！布伦特福德水平！蒂亚戈在禁区内保持球的活力，并为瓦塔拉开球，瓦塔拉近距离击球得分，将蜜蜂队带回比赛。

paras.en: 71: SAVE! Kelleher produces a superb reaction stop to deny Cho from close range after the ball squeezes through van den Berg's legs.
paras.zh: 71：保存！球穿过范登伯格的双腿后，凯莱赫做出了出色的反应拦截，将曹近距离挡出。

paras.en: 74: SAVE! Tzolakis keeps Brentford at bay, stopping Anthony's header after Ouattara delivers from the right.
paras.zh: 74：保存！佐拉基斯将布伦特福德拒之门外，在瓦塔拉右路传球后阻止了安东尼的头球攻门。

paras.en: 89: BIG CHANCE! Cho drills a ball across the six-yard box and Gelhardt gets a touch, but can only direct his effort wide.
paras.zh: 89：大机会！曹将球传过六码禁区，盖尔哈特触球，但只能将球射偏。

articles.title: Isak on target again as Liverpool beat Brighton

paras.en: Liverpool vs Brighton and Hove Albion; Premier League
paras.zh: 利物浦 vs 布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩；英超联赛

paras.en: Liverpool vs Brighton and Hove Albion. Premier League.
paras.zh: 利物浦对阵布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩。英超联赛。

paras.en: Liverpool 2-0 Brighton: Alexander Isak continues goalscoring hot streak as Reds win at Anfield
paras.zh: 利物浦 2-0 布莱顿：亚历山大·伊萨克继续进球势头，红军在安菲尔德获胜

paras.en: Report and free match highlights as Liverpool move up to fourth with a 2-0 win over third-place Brighton at Anfield; Pascal Gross scored an own goal from a Florian Wirtz shot before Alexander Isak struck for a third consecutive Premier League game
paras.zh: 报道和免费比赛精彩片段，利物浦在安菲尔德 2-0 战胜排名第三的布莱顿，升至第四位；帕斯卡·格罗斯接弗洛里安·维尔茨的射门打进乌龙球，之后亚历山大·伊萨克连续第三场英超比赛进球

paras.en: Alexander Isak scored for a third straight Premier League game as Liverpool inflicted only Brighton's second loss of the season.
paras.zh: 亚历山大·伊萨克连续第三场英超比赛进球，利物浦队只给布莱顿造成了本赛季的第二场失利。

paras.en: Isak's goal, finished emphatically from Bradley Barcola's right-wing cut-back, came four first-half minutes after Pascal Gross had diverted a Florian Wirtz shot into his own net.
paras.zh: 上半场四分钟，帕斯卡·格罗斯将弗洛里安·维尔茨的射门转移到自家球门后，伊萨克的进球主要来自布拉德利·巴克拉的右翼切入。

paras.en: Brighton arrived at Anfield having scored 23 goals in their first seven games of the season but lacked a clinical edge, with Yasin Ayari blazing a golden chance over moments before the opener.
paras.zh: 布莱顿抵达安菲尔德后，在本赛季的前七场比赛中攻入了 23 个进球，但缺乏临床优势，亚辛·阿亚里在揭幕战前不久就创造了绝佳机会。

paras.en: Ayari later struck the post with a curling effort from outside the box as Brighton finished the game with only one shot on target despite having 64 per cent of the possession.
paras.zh: 随后，阿亚里在禁区外一脚弧线射门击中立柱，布莱顿尽管拥有 64% 的控球率，但只有一脚射正。

paras.en: Trey Nyoni, a second-half substitute for Wirtz, who went down the tunnel after taking a knock to his ankle, also made a crucial, last-ditch tackle to deny Maxim De Cuyper in the Liverpool box.
paras.zh: 下半场替补维尔茨的特雷·尼奥尼（Trey Nyoni）在脚踝受伤后走下球员通道，他也做出了关键的最后一搏铲球，将马克西姆·德库珀（Maxim De Cuyper）挡在了利物浦禁区内。

paras.en: The hosts had chances to add to their lead, wasting several counter-attacks and drawing Bart Verbruggen saves from Ronald Araujo and Cody Gakpo. But their first-half flurry proved sufficient to secure a first Premier League home win under Andoni Iraola.
paras.zh: 主队有机会扩大领先优势，但浪费了几次反击机会，并吸引了罗纳德·阿劳霍和科迪·加克波的巴特·维尔布鲁根的扑救。但事实证明，他们上半场的混乱足以确保安多尼·伊劳拉（Andoni Iraola）带领下的英超主场首场胜利。

paras.en: The result takes them above Chelsea into fourth in the Premier League, only a point behind Brighton, who taste defeat for the first time since August. Liverpool's fourth win in a row in all competitions also provides further evidence of their attack finally clicking.
paras.zh: 这一结果使他们在英超联赛中超越切尔西排名第四，仅落后布莱顿一分，布莱顿自八月以来首次尝到失败的滋味。利物浦各项赛事的四连胜也进一步证明了他们的进攻终于奏效了。

paras.en: Isak's goal, his sixth of the season in the Premier League, came after fine work by summer signing Barcola, who stole possession high up the pitch before driving forward and picking out his team-mate.
paras.zh: 伊萨克的进球是他本赛季在英超联赛中的第六粒进球，此前夏天签下的巴科拉表现出色，巴科拉在高位抢断控球权，然后向前推进并挑选了队友。

paras.en: Hurzeler: Only one team was playing to win
paras.zh: 胡泽勒：只有一支球队是为了胜利而战

paras.en: Brighton head coach Fabian Hurzeler speaking to Sky Sports:
paras.zh: 布莱顿主教练法比安·胡尔泽勒在接受天空体育采访时表示：

paras.en: "Everyone felt we could definitely take something away from this game. We came here to play our way. We made two easy mistakes to give them a present to score two goals.
paras.zh: “每个人都觉得我们绝对可以从这场比赛中学到一些东西。我们来到这里是按照自己的方式踢球。我们犯了两个简单的错误，给了他们打进两个进球的机会。”

paras.en: "We had plenty of chances to score. We kept trying. They defended well in the box and have individual quality. We did everything. We have to avoid easy mistakes. We had chances but didn't have luck on our side today.
paras.zh: “我们有很多进球的机会。我们一直在努力。他们在禁区内防守得很好，并且有个人能力。我们做了一切。我们必须避免简单的错误。我们有机会，但今天我们没有运气。”

paras.en: "We had a big chance with Yasin. If that goes in, the game is completely different. We have to learn we don't have to chase the game.
paras.zh: “我们在亚辛身上获得了很大的机会。如果那场比赛成功，比赛就完全不同了。我们必须学会不必追逐比赛。

paras.en: "We lost our structure a little bit at 2-0 down. We wanted to come back as quickly as possible and lost our structure. That's what we have to analyse and do better.
paras.zh: “在0-2落后的情况下，我们有点失去了我们的结构。我们想尽快逆转，但失去了我们的结构。这就是我们必须分析并做得更好的地方。”

paras.en: "In the second half, and also a lot of phases in the first-half, only one team was playing and trying to win."
paras.zh: “下半场以及上半场的很多阶段，只有一支球队在比赛并试图获胜。”

articles.title: Neville fears Carrick on the brink as Carra calls for decision tonight

paras.en: Manchester United: Michael Carrick head coach on brink of losing job after Bournemouth defeat
paras.zh: 曼联：伯恩茅斯失利后主教练迈克尔·卡里克面临失业边缘

paras.en: Michael Carrick looks poised to lose his job as Manchester United head coach following their 3-0 defeat at Old Trafford to Bournemouth, according to Gary Neville and Jamie Carragher.
paras.zh: 加里·内维尔和杰米·卡拉格表示，在老特拉福德以 3-0 输给伯恩茅斯后，迈克尔·卡里克看起来准备失去曼联主教练的工作。

paras.en: The humbling defeat leaves United just above the relegation zone following their worst-ever start to a Premier League season.
paras.zh: 这场耻辱的失利让曼联在英超联赛史上最糟糕的开局之后仅略高于降级区。

paras.en: "It is going to get ridiculously difficult for Michael Carrick to be Manchester United manager moving forward. That's the problem the club have got," said Neville during Sky Sports' match commentary.
paras.zh: “对于迈克尔·卡里克来说，继续担任曼联主帅将变得极其困难。这就是俱乐部面临的问题，”内维尔在天空体育的比赛评论中说道。

paras.en: Carrick struck a defiant tone after the game but his lengthy applause towards the United fans after the final whistle was immediately interpreted as a farewell gesture.
paras.zh: 赛后卡里克语气充满挑衅，但终场哨响后他向曼联球迷长时间鼓掌，立即被解读为告别的姿态。

paras.en: "Michael Carrick needs to be relieved of his duties tonight," added Jamie Carragher. "Not just for the good of Manchester United but also for the good of Michael Carrick.
paras.zh: “迈克尔·卡里克今晚需要被解除职务，”杰米·卡拉格补充道。 “这不仅是为了曼联的利益，也是为了迈克尔·卡里克的利益。

paras.en: "Manchester United need to make that decision tonight."
paras.zh: “曼联今晚需要做出这个决定。”

paras.en: Carrick led United to Champions League football after taking over from Ruben Amorim in mid-season last year, but United are winless in their last eight matches amid a wretched start to the current campaign.
paras.zh: 卡里克在去年赛季中期接替鲁本·阿莫里姆后，带领曼联进入了欧冠联赛，但由于本赛季开局不佳，曼联在过去八场比赛中未尝一胜。

paras.en: "I did think last season that the club should have gone for the best manager they could have got and not given the job to Michael Carrick because I felt this might happen. But this has gone very, very sour very quickly and the club is a mess," said Neville.
paras.zh: “上赛季我确实认为俱乐部应该聘请最好的教练，而不是把这份工作交给迈克尔·卡里克，因为我觉得这种情况可能会发生。但事情很快就变得非常非常糟糕，俱乐部一团糟，”内维尔说。

paras.en: Carrick's name was chanted loudly by the Old Trafford faithful following Bournemouth's game-sealing third goal but Neville fears that time may already be up for his former team-mate.
paras.zh: 在伯恩茅斯打进决定比赛胜局的第三个进球后，老特拉福德的球迷们大声呼喊卡里克的名字，但内维尔担心他的前队友的时间可能已经到了。

paras.en: "Carrick is popular. But the owners, the sporting department and the players are not popular. They have badly let the club down.
paras.zh: “卡里克很受欢迎。但老板、体育部门和球员并不受欢迎。他们让俱乐部严重失望。”

paras.en: "Tomorrow, they will probably make a decision that will disgust Manchester United fans but it is probably necessary.
paras.zh: “明天，他们可能会做出一个让曼联球迷感到厌恶的决定，但这可能是必要的。

paras.en: "The Manchester United fans are singing Carrick's name because the reality tomorrow is: will he be the manager?
paras.zh: “曼联球迷正在高唱卡里克的名字，因为明天的现实是：他会成为主教练吗？

paras.en: Bruno Fernandes was dropped from the match on Sunday after he criticised Carrick's tactics in the wake of Wednesday's 4-1 thrashing at Como in the Champions League. Surprisingly, the United captain stayed on the bench for the entirety of the defeat to Bournemouth.
paras.zh: 布鲁诺·费尔南德斯在周三欧冠联赛中4-1惨败科莫后批评了卡里克的战术，因此在周日的比赛中被除名。令人惊讶的是，曼联队长在输给伯恩茅斯的比赛中一直坐在替补席上。

paras.en: It's become untenable," summarised Carragher. "Carrick wants to be changed. He doesn't want to be sat in the dugout with those players.
paras.zh: 它已经变得站不住脚了，”卡拉格总结道。“卡里克想要改变。他不想和那些球员一起坐在休息室里。

paras.en: "Can you imagine going into the training ground tomorrow with Bruno Fernandes after not bringing him on? It's a rancid dressing room. He wants to be put out of his misery tonight."
paras.zh: “你能想象明天在没有让布鲁诺·费尔南德斯上场后和他一起进入训练场吗？这是一个腐臭的更衣室。他希望今晚能够摆脱痛苦。”

articles.title: Meghan Markle ‘deeply distressed’ by allegations her dad possessed child sexual abuse images
articles.author: Adela Suliman

paras.en: LONDON — Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, said Friday that she was “deeply distressed” by a report alleging that her estranged father, Thomas Markle Sr., possessed child sexual abuse images, adding that she was informed by police of “disturbing allegations” against him in 2018.
paras.zh: 伦敦——苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根周五表示，有报道称她关系疏远的父亲老托马斯·马克尔拥有儿童性虐待图片，她对此感到“深感悲痛”，并补充说，警方在 2018 年向她通报了针对他的“令人不安的指控”。

paras.en: In a statement Friday, Meghan addressed the report that her father was being investigated over claims he kept child sexual abuse videos and images at his home in the Philippines.
paras.zh: 梅根在周五的一份声明中谈到了有关她父亲因涉嫌在菲律宾家中保存儿童性虐待视频和图像而受到调查的报道。

paras.en: “The breadth of what has now been uncovered is more sickening than one could ever imagine,” said Meghan, whose relationship with her father has been limited and fraught in recent years. He did not attend her wedding to Prince Harry in 2018, drawing widespread media scrutiny.
paras.zh: 梅根说：“现在所发现的事情的广度比人们想象的还要令人作呕。”近年来，她与父亲的关系一直有限且令人担忧。他没有参加 2018 年她与哈里王子的婚礼，引起了媒体的广泛关注。

paras.en: The allegations against Markle Sr. were first reported Thursday by The Sun, a British tabloid, which reported that his son had informed police after he said he found “hundreds, if not thousands” of child sex abuse images in boxes at his father’s home. The Sun published a photo it said showed Thomas Markle Jr., signing a sworn statement it said he had submitted to police and quoted him as saying: “I won’t speak to my father ever again unless I’m called to give evidence against him.”
paras.zh: 英国小报《太阳报》周四首次报道了针对老马克尔的指控，该报报道说，他的儿子在父亲家的盒子里发现了“数百甚至数千”的儿童性虐待照片后通知了警方。 《太阳报》刊登了一张据称是小托马斯·马克尔的照片，并签署了一份据称是他向警方提交的宣誓声明，并援引他的话说：“我不会再和我父亲说话，除非我被传唤出庭作证。”

paras.en: Markle Sr., 82, denied the reported allegations, calling them “sick lies” in a statement to Britain’s Daily Mail newspaper. He added they were “the worst thing anyone could accuse me of.”
paras.zh: 82 岁的老马克尔在给英国《每日邮报》的一份声明中否认了所报道的指控，称这些指控是“病态的谎言”。他补充说，这是“任何人都可以指责我的最糟糕的事情。”

paras.en: NBC News was not immediately able to identify a contact for Markle Sr., who the Daily Mail reported was now in a Florida rehab center recovering from surgery.
paras.zh: NBC新闻未能立即确定老马克尔的联系人，据《每日邮报》报道，老马克尔目前正在佛罗里达州的一家康复中心接受手术康复。

paras.en: Markle Jr. told the Sun that he had reported his discovery to the FBI, as well as local Philippine authorities.
paras.zh: 小马克尔告诉《太阳报》，他已向联邦调查局以及菲律宾当地当局报告了这一发现。

paras.en: In a statement, the FBI said it was “aware of the allegations and will provide support, as appropriate, to the Philippine authorities. We will also investigate any related allegations of federal violations of U.S. law.”
paras.zh: 联邦调查局在一份声明中表示，“已了解这些指控，并将酌情向菲律宾当局提供支持。我们还将调查任何有关联邦违反美国法律的相关指控。”

paras.en: The Philippines’ justice department confirmed Friday that “the matter is under investigation” but otherwise declined to “provide further details at this time.”
paras.zh: 菲律宾司法部周五证实，“此事正在调查中”，但拒绝“目前提供进一步的细节”。

paras.en: Police in Cebu City, the location of Markle Sr.’s home in the Philippines, and London’s Metropolitan Police did not immediately respond to requests for comment from NBC News.
paras.zh: 老马克尔在菲律宾的家所在地宿务市警方和伦敦警察厅没有立即回应 NBC 新闻的置评请求。

paras.en: In the rare statement Friday, Meghan said that she had chosen to keep her children, Prince Archie, 7, and Princess Lilibet, 5, away from her father “for one reason: to protect them.”
paras.zh: 在周五罕见的声明中，梅根表示，她选择让自己的孩子——7岁的阿奇王子和5岁的莉莉贝特公主——远离父亲，“原因只有一个：保护他们”。

paras.en: “I am deeply distressed at the news that has come to light in the last 24 hours, and my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed,” she said in the statement.
paras.zh: 她在声明中表示：“我对过去 24 小时内曝光的消息深感悲痛，我的心与所有可能受到伤害的儿童同在。”

paras.en: Meghan said that she had been made aware of a letter sent to the British police and other authorities in 2018, that “made troubling and disturbing allegations against my father and I was given assurances that these were being investigated.”
paras.zh: 梅根表示，她已获悉 2018 年英国警方和其他当局收到的一封信，“对我父亲提出了令人不安和不安的指控，我得到保证，这些指控正在接受调查”。

paras.en: “I hope it can now be understood that, despite certain media publications’ distortion over the years, any distance from my father and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children, was for one reason: to protect them,” she added.
paras.zh: “我希望现在大家能够理解，尽管多年来某些媒体出版物歪曲事实，但我与父亲的任何距离以及我选择不允许他与我们的孩子接触的原因只有一个：保护他们，”她补充道。

paras.en: “Although the breadth of what has now been uncovered is more sickening than one could ever imagine, my sincerest hope is that justice will be fully served and that the priority remains the safety and protection of innocent children,” Meghan said.
paras.zh: 梅根说：“尽管现在所揭露的事情比人们想象的更加令人作呕，但我最真诚的希望是正义能够得到充分伸张，优先事项仍然是无辜儿童的安全和保护。”

paras.en: When asked by NBC News when Meghan was made aware of the letter to the Metropolitan Police, a spokesman for the couple said it was in the summer of 2018, after her wedding with Harry.
paras.zh: 当 NBC 新闻询问梅根何时知道这封写给伦敦警察厅的信时，这对夫妇的发言人表示，那是在 2018 年夏天，她与哈里结婚后。

paras.en: Separately, a source close to the couple told NBC News that Meghan’s decision not to speak publicly eight years ago should be understood in a particular context: “When she was made aware of these allegations in 2018 after they were reported to the police, they remained just that — allegations.”
paras.zh: 另外，一位与这对夫妇关系密切的消息人士告诉 NBC 新闻，梅根八年前不公开发表言论的决定应该在特定背景下理解：“2018 年，当这些指控向警方报案后，她才得知这些指控时，它们仍然只是指控。”

paras.en: “To have repeated them publicly at that stage would not only have potentially exposed her to civil action for making unsubstantiated claims, but she had also been advised that doing so could jeopardize any subsequent investigation,” the source added.
paras.zh: 消息人士补充说：“在那个阶段公开重复这些内容不仅可能会让她因提出未经证实的指控而受到民事诉讼，而且她还被告知这样做可能会危及任何后续调查。”

paras.en: Markle Sr. told the Daily Mail he had not spoken to his son “for months” and said “these terrible lies are being made against me with no proof.” He added that he would “welcome an investigation” into the matter and labeled the accusations “a bunch of lies.”
paras.zh: 老马克尔告诉《每日邮报》，他已经“几个月”没有和儿子说过话了，并说“这些可怕的谎言是针对我的，没有任何证据。”他补充说，他“欢迎对此事进行调查”，并将这些指控称为“一堆谎言”。
