paras.zh: “今天对委内瑞拉人来说是非常重要的一天。我们主权的声音与她一起回归，领导和指导这一进程！”他写道。 “你知道的，这件事到最后为止。”

paras.en: Machado's homecoming after more than 10 months in exile took place as doubts over Venezuela's democratic future — and the U.S.'s role in it — deepen.
paras.zh: 马查多在流亡十多个月后回国之际，人们对委内瑞拉的民主未来以及美国在其中所扮演的角色的疑虑加深。

paras.en: Since Maduro's ouster, Venezuela has been run by acting President Delcy Rodríguez, a longtime Maduro ally who received the Trump administration's blessing to succeed him.
paras.zh: 自马杜罗下台以来，委内瑞拉一直由代理总统德尔西·罗德里格斯领导，他是马杜罗的长期盟友，得到了特朗普政府的批准接替他。

paras.en: Rodríguez has exceeded the time she was authorized to serve as acting president following Maduro's capture and no election is scheduled.
paras.zh: 马杜罗被捕后，罗德里格斯已经超过了她被授权担任代理总统的时间，并且没有安排选举。

paras.en: Machado went into hiding in Venezuela for 11 months after being briefly detained following a protest in January 2025. After leaving the country in a clandestine escape, she reappeared that December in Norway, where she was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for her peaceful challenge to Maduro's authoritarian government.
paras.zh: 马查多在 2025 年 1 月的一次抗议活动后被短暂拘留后，在委内瑞拉躲藏了 11 个月。秘密逃亡离开该国后，她于当年 12 月再次出现在挪威，并因和平挑战马杜罗独裁政府而被授予诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: Machado and her allies have been demanding a date for a presidential election in Venezuela, but U.S. officials have emphasized economic stabilization first.
paras.zh: 马查多和她的盟友一直要求委内瑞拉确定总统选举的日期，但美国官员首先强调经济稳定。

articles.title: Trump immigration win could strengthen admin's hand in looming Supreme Court fight

paras.en: The Trump administration scored a major full-panel victory at the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals Friday, which ruled that detained illegal immigrants who were never formally admitted into the U. S. are not constitutionally entitled to bond hearings while awaiting deportation.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府周五在第五巡回上诉法院取得了全体小组的重大胜利，该法院裁定，从未被正式允许进入美国的被拘留非法移民在等待驱逐出境时，根据宪法无权参加保释听证会。

paras.en: The ruling comes as the Supreme Court prepares to hear Rhoney v. Barbosa da Cunha this term, a closely related fight over whether the federal mandatory-detention statute applies at all to longtime immigrants arrested inside the country — setting up the possibility that the justices could either undercut Friday’s ruling or strengthen the government's hand.
paras.zh: 这项裁决是在最高法院准备本学期审理罗尼诉巴博萨·达库尼亚案之际做出的，这是一场与联邦强制拘留法规是否适用于在该国境内被捕的长期移民密切相关的争论，这使得法官们有可能削弱周五的裁决，也可能加强政府的力量。

paras.en: The Fifth Circuit answered the constitutional question in Ignacio Sosnava Rodriguez v. Sylvester M. Ortega, finding that three immigrant men detained under the mandatory-detention statute are not entitled to bond hearings under the Due Process Clause of the Fifth Amendment. The court held that their years or even decades of residence in the United States, along with ties to the country and their communities, do not create a constitutional right to a bond hearing.
paras.zh: 第五巡回法院回答了伊格纳西奥·索斯纳瓦·罗德里格斯诉西尔维斯特·M·奥尔特加一案中的宪法问题，认为根据强制拘留法规被拘留的三名移民男子无权根据第五修正案的正当程序条款参加保释听证会。法院认为，他们在美国居住了数年甚至数十年，以及与国家和社区的联系，并不构成宪法规定的保释听证会权利。

paras.en: "The Constitution does not entitle them to a bond hearing," the court wrote.
paras.zh: “宪法没有赋予他们举行保释听证会的权利，”法院写道。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the Supreme Court will consider Rhoney, a case out of the Second Circuit, to determine whether the mandatory-detention law applies to longtime immigrants arrested inside the country in the first place.
paras.zh: 与此同时，最高法院将审理第二巡回法院审理的罗尼案，以确定强制拘留法是否适用于在该国境内被捕的长期移民。

paras.en: At the center of the issue is a 9-2 circuit split over which federal detention law applies to immigrants who entered the country illegally, were never formally admitted and were later arrested by immigration authorities after living in the U.S. for years — sometimes decades after crossing the border.
paras.zh: 问题的核心是9比2的分歧，联邦拘留法适用于非法进入美国、从未被正式接纳、在美国生活多年（有时是跨越边境数十年）后被移民当局逮捕的移民。

paras.en: The Fifth and Eighth Circuits have held that those immigrants remain "applicants for admission" under Section 1225 of the Immigration and Nationality Act, subjecting them to mandatory detention without an ordinary bond hearing while their removal proceedings play out. Nine other federal appeals courts have ruled that Section 1226 applies instead, which provides a path for them to seek release on bond.
paras.zh: 第五和第八巡回法院认为，根据《移民和国籍法》第 1225 条，这些移民仍然是“入境申请人”，在遣返程序进行期间，他们在没有举行普通保释听证会的情况下受到强制拘留。其他九个联邦上诉法院已裁定第 1226 条适用，这为他们寻求保释提供了途径。

paras.en: The Supreme Court will essentially decide whether immigrants who entered illegally and have lived in the U.S. for years can be subjected to the same mandatory-detention provision that applies to certain immigrants seeking admission into the country.
paras.zh: 最高法院将主要决定非法进入并在美国居住多年的移民是否可以受到适用于某些寻求进入该国的移民的相同强制拘留条款的约束。

paras.en: If the Supreme Court sides with the Second Circuit, Barbosa da Cunha — a Brazilian national who entered the country illegally roughly two decades ago and was detained in 2025 — would have a path to seek release on bond. Such a ruling would likely apply to the three longtime immigrants at the center of Rodriguez as well, substantially undercutting the significance of Friday’s ruling by eliminating the need to answer the constitutional question of whether due process requires a bond hearing.
paras.zh: 如果最高法院站在第二巡回法院一边，大约二十年前非法进入该国并于 2025 年被拘留的巴西国民巴博萨·达库尼亚 (Barbosa da Cunha) 将有途径寻求保释。这样的裁决可能也适用于罗德里格斯市中心的三名长期移民，通过消除回答正当程序是否需要保释听证会的宪法问题的需要，大大削弱了周五裁决的重要性。

paras.en: Judge Leslie Southwick pointed directly to the looming Supreme Court fight in her dissent.
paras.zh: 莱斯利·索斯威克法官在她的异议中直接指出了即将到来的最高法院之争。

paras.en: Should the Supreme Court eventually determine that this court was wrong as to the statute, then the constitutional issue we address here will have far less significance. It certainly has significance at the moment," Southwick wrote.
paras.zh: 如果最高法院最终判定本法院在该法规方面有误，那么我们在此讨论的宪法问题的意义就会小得多。目前这当然具有重要意义，”索斯威克写道。

paras.en: But conservative legal experts say Rodriguez could also strengthen the administration’s hand in Rhoney by undercutting one argument against the government’s interpretation of Section 1225: that applying the mandatory-detention provision to longtime residents would raise serious constitutional concerns.
paras.zh: 但保守派法律专家表示，罗德里格斯还可以通过削弱反对政府对第 1225 条解释的一个论点来加强政府对罗尼的控制：将强制拘留条款应用于长期居民会引起严重的宪法问题。

paras.en: Michael Morley, a constitutional law professor at Florida State University, said Friday’s ruling could influence how the justices approach that question because courts often consider whether a particular reading of federal law would create constitutional problems.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州立大学宪法学教授迈克尔·莫利表示，周五的裁决可能会影响法官处理该问题的方式，因为法院经常考虑对联邦法律的特定解读是否会产生宪法问题。

paras.en: "The Fifth Circuit’s en banc ruling in Rodriguez today takes the next step by holding that such detention would not violate the U.S. Constitution’s Due Process Clause," Morley said. "This holding may impact the Supreme Court’s reasoning, because an important consideration in disputes over federal laws is whether a particular interpretation would be unconstitutional."
paras.zh: 莫利说：“第五巡回法院今天对罗德里格斯案的全席裁决迈出了下一步，认为此类拘留不会违反美国宪法的正当程序条款。” “这一裁决可能会影响最高法院的推理，因为联邦法律争议中的一个重要考虑因素是特定解释是否违宪。”

paras.en: "If the Court agrees with the Fifth Circuit’s analysis that the Due Process Clause allows such detention, it may be more likely to conclude that federal law permits it, as well, Morley continued.
paras.zh: “如果法院同意第五巡回法院的分析，即正当程序条款允许此类拘留，那么可能更有可能得出联邦法律也允许这种拘留的结论，”莫利继续说道。

paras.en: Hans von Spakovsky, a senior legal fellow at Advancing American Freedom, argued that the decision could bolster the administration as the justices prepare to resolve the circuit split.
paras.zh: 促进美国自由组织的高级法律研究员汉斯·冯·斯帕科夫斯基认为，在大法官们准备解决巡回法庭分歧之际，这一决定可能会支持政府。

paras.en: "I actually think this ruling will help the government in the Rhoney case," von Spakovsky said, pointing to the Fifth Circuit’s position that the applicable immigration statute does not require bond hearings for immigrants who were never admitted to the United States.
paras.zh: 冯·斯帕科夫斯基表示：“实际上，我认为这项裁决将有助于政府处理罗尼案。”他指出，第五巡回法院的立场是，适用的移民法规不要求对从未进入美国的移民举行保释听证会。

paras.en: "There was already a split in the circuit courts on this issue but the Fifth Circuit has consistently held that the applicable immigration statute does not require bond hearings for aliens who were never admitted to the United States," he said. "I will be surprised if a majority of the Supreme Court disagrees when they ultimately issue a decision in the Rhoney case."
paras.zh: 他说：“巡回法院在这个问题上已经存在分歧，但第五巡回法院始终认为，适用的移民法规不要求对从未进入美国的外国人进行保释听证会。” “如果最高法院的大多数人在最终对罗尼案做出裁决时不同意，我会感到惊讶。”

paras.en: The Supreme Court has not yet scheduled oral arguments in Rhoney, which it agreed to hear earlier this month.
paras.zh: 最高法院尚未安排在罗尼举行的口头辩论，本月早些时候已同意听取口头辩论。

articles.title: Selena Gomez's vaping admission highlights hidden health risks doctors say millions face daily

paras.en: When Selena Gomez revealed to her millions of followers that heavy nicotine vaping had noticeably altered her voice, calling the habit "stupid," her confession highlighted a larger issue with the practice.
paras.zh: 当赛琳娜·戈麦斯向她的数百万粉丝透露，大量吸尼古丁电子烟明显改变了她的声音，并称这种习惯“愚蠢”时，她的坦白凸显了这种做法的一个更大问题。

paras.en: For the singer and actress, the physical toll manifested in her vocal cords. But medical professionals emphasize that her experience is only a visible symptom of a deeper health crisis affecting millions of Americans who use e-cigarettes every day.
paras.zh: 对于这位歌手兼演员来说，身体上的伤害体现在她的声带上。但医学专业人士强调，她的经历只是影响数百万每天使用电子烟的美国人的更深层次健康危机的一个明显症状。

paras.en: While often marketed as a safer alternative to conventional cigarettes, e-cigarettes pose significant health risks. Aside from the immediate vocal strain and airway inflammation noted by otolaryngologists, major health institutions warn that regular vaping exposes the body to a cocktail of toxic chemicals, cardiovascular strain and respiratory risks.
paras.zh: 虽然电子烟经常被宣传为传统香烟的更安全替代品，但它却带来了重大的健康风险。除了耳鼻喉科医生指出的直接声音紧张和气道炎症外，主要卫生机构还警告说，经常吸电子烟会使身体暴露在有毒化学物质、心血管紧张和呼吸系统风险的混合物中。

paras.en: Specialists emphasize that e-cigarettes deliver more concentrated doses of nicotine than traditional cigarettes, rapidly driving chemical dependency in the brain.
paras.zh: 专家强调，电子烟比传统香烟提供更浓缩剂量的尼古丁，迅速导致大脑对化学物质的依赖。

paras.en: "With e-cigarettes and vaping, you can get a very high dose of nicotine, and that directly correlates to addiction and how difficult it can be to break these patterns," Trent Carter, a nurse practitioner and CEO of Renew Health in New Mexico, previously told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州 Renew Health 的执业护士兼首席执行官特伦特·卡特 (Trent Carter) 此前对福克斯新闻数字频道表示：“使用电子烟和电子烟，你可以获得非常高剂量的尼古丁，这与成瘾以及打破这些模式的难度直接相关。”

paras.en: Carter notes that high nicotine intake without traditional smoke can carry its own health consequences.
paras.zh: 卡特指出，在没有传统烟雾的情况下摄入大量尼古丁可能会带来健康后果。

paras.en: "It can lead to sleep disturbances, increased anxiety, and if you have underlying cardiac problems or high blood pressure, it’s going to raise your heart rate and elevate your blood pressure, leading to all sorts of issues."
paras.zh: “它会导致睡眠障碍、焦虑增加，如果你有潜在的心脏问题或高血压，它会提高你的心率和血压，从而导致各种问题。”

paras.en: According to the American Lung Association, the aerosol produced by e-cigarettes contains fine chemical particles, heavy metals such as nickel and lead, and organic compounds. Over time, inhaling these irritants can trigger chronic airway inflammation, irreversible lung tissue scarring, and obstructive pulmonary conditions.
paras.zh: 据美国肺脏协会称，电子烟产生的气溶胶含有精细化学颗粒、镍和铅等重金属以及有机化合物。随着时间的推移，吸入这些刺激物会引发慢性气道炎症、不可逆的肺组织疤痕和阻塞性肺部疾病。

paras.en: A major concern among physicians is the chemical composition of e-liquids. Even nicotine-free formulas contain flavorings and solvent agents like propylene glycol and vegetable glycerin.
paras.zh: 医生主要关心的是电子烟液的化学成分。即使不含尼古丁的配方也含有调味剂和溶剂，如丙二醇和植物甘油。

paras.en: When heated by the device’s coil, these liquids break down into toxic compounds, including formaldehyde and acrolein, both known to damage cellular structures in the respiratory system.
paras.zh: 当被设备的线圈加热时，这些液体会分解成有毒化合物，包括甲醛和丙烯醛，这两种化合物都会损害呼吸系统的细胞结构。

paras.en: Doctors stress that because modern e-cigarettes have only been widely used for a little over a decade, long-term health consequences are still unclear. While immediate effects may appear as hoarseness, coughing, or reduced athletic endurance, the larger impact poses risks to long-term vital organ function.
paras.zh: 医生强调，由于现代电子烟的广泛使用才十多年，长期健康后果仍不清楚。虽然直接影响可能表现为声音嘶哑、咳嗽或运动耐力下降，但更大的影响会对长期重要器官功能构成风险。

paras.en: For many attempting to quit vaping, traditional tools like nicotine patches or gum can fall short because they don't address the psychological habit.
paras.zh: 对于许多试图戒烟的人来说，尼古丁贴片或口香糖等传统工具可能效果不佳，因为它们不能解决心理习惯。

paras.en: "While a patch or gum can help with physical cravings, if you aren't addressing the behavioral aspect, you're missing a huge component," Carter said.
paras.zh: 卡特说：“虽然贴片或口香糖可以帮助缓解身体上的渴望，但如果你不解决行为方面的问题，那么你就错过了一个重要的组成部分。”

paras.en: "Vaping can become constant throughout the day. Subconsciously, you might not even realize how frequently you're doing it, or that you're using it to cope with underlying anxiety or lack of sleep."
paras.zh: “吸电子烟可能会整天持续不断。在潜意识里，你甚至可能没有意识到你吸电子烟的频率，或者你正在用它来应对潜在的焦虑或睡眠不足。”

paras.en: For those inspired by Gomez, health professionals urge people to seek comprehensive support rather than simply switch nicotine delivery methods.
paras.zh: 对于那些受到戈麦斯启发的人，卫生专业人员敦促人们寻求全面的支持，而不是简单地改变尼古丁输送方法。

paras.en: "The goal shouldn't be to find another way to consume nicotine, it should be to treat the dependence itself," said Carter.
paras.zh: “我们的目标不应该是寻找另一种摄入尼古丁的方法，而应该是治疗尼古丁依赖本身，”卡特说。

articles.title: 5 victims released from hospital after Florida A&M University shooting, 1 remains critical

paras.en: Five victims of a shooting near Florida A&M University have been released from the hospital, while six others remain hospitalized, including one in critical condition, Tallahassee police announced Sunday morning.
paras.zh: 塔拉哈西警方周日上午宣布，佛罗里达农工大学附近发生的枪击事件的五名受害者已出院，另外六人仍在医院接受治疗，其中一名伤势严重。

paras.en: The updated conditions come hours after gunfire erupted near the university's Bragg Memorial Stadium on Saturday night, leaving 12 people injured, including six children. Of those injured, authorities said 11 sustained gunshot wounds.
paras.zh: 周六晚上，该大学布拉格纪念体育场附近发生枪击事件，造成 12 人受伤，其中包括 6 名儿童。当局称，受伤者中有 11 人受枪伤。

paras.en: Police said they are continuing to investigate the shooting and will provide additional updates as information becomes available.
paras.zh: 警方表示，他们正在继续调查这起枪击事件，并将在获得信息后提供更多最新信息。

paras.en: The shooting happened shortly before 8 p.m. Saturday near the intersection of Perry and Manatee streets, close to the university's football stadium, according to authorities.
paras.zh: 枪击事件发生在晚上八点前不久。据当局称，周六，佩里街和海牛街交叉口附近，靠近大学橄榄球场。

paras.en: Six victims were adults and six were juveniles, with the youngest just 11 years old, Tallahassee Police Chief Lawrence E. Revell said during a Saturday night news conference.
paras.zh: 塔拉哈西警察局长劳伦斯·E·雷维尔 (Lawrence E. Revell) 在周六晚间的新闻发布会上表示，六名受害者是成年人，六名青少年，其中最小的只有 11 岁。

paras.en: Investigators said preliminary information suggests a physical altercation involving two or three individuals broke out before the gunfire.
paras.zh: 调查人员表示，初步信息显示，枪击事件前发生了涉及两到三人的肢体冲突。

paras.en: The shooting occurred during Florida A&M University's homecoming weekend, as students and alumni gathered in Tallahassee for the annual celebrations.
paras.zh: 枪击事件发生在佛罗里达农工大学返校周末期间，当时学生和校友聚集在塔拉哈西参加年度庆祝活动。

paras.en: Lt. Gov. Jay Collins asked for prayers for the victims and the community in a social media post.
paras.zh: 副州长杰伊·柯林斯在社交媒体帖子中请求为受害者和社区祈祷。

paras.en: "My heart goes out to the victims and families impacted by the shooting near FAMU," Collins wrote on X. "Knowing children were among those injured makes this even more heartbreaking."
paras.zh: 柯林斯在 X 上写道：“我的心与受 FAMU 附近枪击事件影响的受害者和家庭同在。”“知道受伤者中有儿童，这让这件事更加令人心碎。”

paras.en: No arrests have been announced as of the latest police update.
paras.zh: 截至警方最新消息，尚未宣布逮捕任何人。

paras.en: The Tallahassee Police Department's Violent Crimes Unit is investigating the shooting as detectives work to identify those responsible.
paras.zh: 塔拉哈西警察局的暴力犯罪部门正在调查这起枪击事件，侦探们正在努力查明责任人。

paras.en: Fox News Digital’s Michael Sinkewicz contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道的迈克尔·辛克维奇 (Michael Sinkewicz) 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Brazilians vote in presidential election runoff pitting leftist Lula against far-right Bolsonaro
articles.author: Tiago Rogero in Rio de Janeiro

paras.en: Brazilians are going to the polls on Sunday in a highly unpredictable runoff in which the leftist president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, is attempting an unprecedented comeback against the far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who won the first-round vote.
paras.zh: 巴西人将于周日参加一场高度不可预测的决选，左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦正试图史无前例地逆转赢得第一轮投票的极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗。

paras.en: Bolsonaro’s surprise victory despite not leading most polls made him the favourite three weeks ago, but since then Lula’s campaign has gained ground, and the two go into the contest virtually tied.
paras.zh: 尽管博尔索纳罗在大多数民意调查中并未领先，但他的意外胜利使他在三周前成为最受欢迎的候选人，但自那以后，卢拉的竞选活动取得了进展，两人在竞选中几乎打成了平手。

paras.en: The gap between them was the narrowest ever recorded in a first round, at less than 2% of the vote, and the 80-year-old president has spent much of the runoff campaign focused on turnout – abstention reached a record high in the first round and disproportionately affects his voters – and on stoking fears over what a return to power by a member of the Bolsonaro family could mean.
paras.zh: 他们之间的差距是第一轮有记录以来最窄的，不到2%的选票，这位80岁的总统在决选活动中把大部分时间都花在了投票率上——第一轮弃权率创历史新高，对他的选民产生了不成比例的影响——以及引发人们对博尔索纳罗家族成员重新掌权可能意味着什么的担忧。

paras.en: A congressman for more than 20 years with few bills passed, the 45-year-old Bolsonaro is the eldest son of the former president Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest serving a 27-year sentence for attempting a coup to overturn his 2022 defeat to Lula.
paras.zh: 45 岁的博尔索纳罗担任国会议员 20 多年，几乎没有通过任何法案。他是前总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗的长子，贾尔·博尔索纳罗因试图发动政变推翻 2022 年输给卢拉的选举而被软禁，服刑 27 年。

paras.en: “I think the time has come for real change,” said Bolsonaro after voting on Sunday morning at a school in Rio de Janeiro’s north zone. “Brazil can’t take another four years the way things are ... Everyone’s life has got worse.”
paras.zh: “我认为真正改变的时候到了，”博尔索纳罗周日早上在里约热内卢北部地区的一所学校投票后说道。 “巴西不能再像现在这样四年了……每个人的生活都变得更糟了。”

paras.en: Lula voted in São Bernardo do Campo, the industrial city where his political career began nearly half a century ago, and said he had “never seen anything like” the leftist demonstrations – many emerging organically among young people – that swept the country in support of him during the runoff.
paras.zh: 卢拉在工业城市圣贝尔纳多·杜坎普投票，这座工业城市是他近半个世纪前开始政治生涯的地方。卢拉表示，他“从未见过像这样的”左翼示威活动 — — 其中许多是在年轻人中自发出现的 — — 在决选期间席卷全国以支持他。

paras.en: “What the people have done for me in these past few days is something I can never repay. It is so much generosity, so much affection, so much love. I will be eternally grateful,” said Lula, adding that he was “confident” the people would not choose Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 卢拉说：“过去几天，人民为我所做的一切是我永远无法报答的。这是如此多的慷慨、如此多的感情、如此多的爱。我将永远感激不已。”他补充说，他“相信”人民不会选择博索纳罗。

paras.en: The senator has promised that if elected he will pardon his father, and with an even more conservative congress taking office next year, he has vowed to “change the constitution and re-democratise this country”, sending chills through those who fear he could follow in his father’s authoritarian footsteps.
paras.zh: 这位参议员承诺，如果当选，他将赦免他的父亲，随着明年更加保守的国会就职，他发誓要“改变宪法，使这个国家重新民主化”，这让那些担心他会追随父亲独裁脚步的人感到不寒而栗。

paras.en: “We’re facing two completely different projects for the country,” said voter Nuno Rau, 63, an architect and writer. “One points towards the end of social rights and the end of democracy itself; on the other side is someone who fought for income distribution and free public education. I may have criticisms of Lula, but there is no way to choose Bolsonaro,” he added.
paras.zh: “我们国家面临着两个完全不同的项目，”63 岁的选民、建筑师兼作家努诺·劳 (Nuno Rau) 说。 “一方指向社会权利的终结和民主本身的终结；另一方是为收入分配和免费公共教育而奋斗的人。我可能对卢拉有批评，但没有办法选择博尔索纳罗，”他补充道。

paras.en: Aparecida Moreira, a 62-year-old lawyer, will vote for Bolsonaro mainly because of the “iron fist” security policy he proposes, including building five “mega-prisons” inspired by those of El Salvador’s populist autocrat Nayib Bukele.
paras.zh: 62岁的律师阿帕雷西达·莫雷拉(Aparecida Moreira)之所以投票支持博尔索纳罗，主要是因为他提出的“铁拳”安全政策，包括受萨尔瓦多民粹主义独裁者纳伊布·布克莱(Nayib Bukele)的启发建造五座“巨型监狱”。

paras.en: “I agree with Bolsonaro’s idea of chemical castration for rapists, because there is no crime worse than rape,” said Moreira, adding that voting for Lula would be the same as voting for the “dictator” Alexandre de Moraes, the justice who, despite not having been appointed by Lula, is widely associated with him by Bolsonaro supporters because he oversaw the former president’s conviction.
paras.zh: 莫雷拉说：“我同意博尔索纳罗对强奸犯进行化学阉割的想法，因为没有比强奸更严重的犯罪了。”他补充说，投票给卢拉就等于投票给“独裁者”亚历山大·德·莫赖斯，这位大法官尽管不是卢拉任命的，但博尔索纳罗的支持者广泛与他联系在一起，因为他监督了前总统的定罪。

paras.en: Both Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula drew large crowds to their final campaign rallies on Saturday in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo and Belo Horizonte.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗和卢拉周六在里约热内卢、圣保罗和贝洛奥里藏特举行的最后竞选集会吸引了大量人群。

paras.en: In northern Minas Gerais state, Iara Pimentel, a councillor from Lula’s party, suffered facial injuries and had to be taken to hospital after the motorcade in which she was travelling was hit by glass bottles and bricks thrown by Bolsonaro supporters. “It is unacceptable for people to be attacked for expressing their political views,” Pimentel posted after leaving hospital.
paras.zh: 在北部米纳斯吉拉斯州，卢拉政党议员伊拉·皮门特尔(Iara Pimentel)所乘坐的车队被博尔索纳罗支持者投掷的玻璃瓶和砖块击中，面部受伤，不得不送往医院。 “人们因表达政治观点而受到攻击是不可接受的，”皮门特尔出院后发帖说。

paras.en: With each side of supporters virtually “crystallised”, the election will be decided by the small number of voters who identify with neither candidate.
paras.zh: 由于每一方支持者几乎都“结晶”，选举结果将由少数不认同任何一位候选人的选民决定。

paras.en: Bolsonaro began the runoff campaign with a lead and the support of most other defeated candidates, but instead of growing, he stagnated in the polls.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗以领先优势和大多数其他落败候选人的支持开始了决选竞选，但他的民调非但没有增长，反而停滞不前。

paras.en: Many analysts saw this as the result of part of the population suddenly waking up to the “fear” of a Bolsonaro returning to power, as well as controversies including the fact that the senator is under investigation in two federal police inquiries over alleged corruption and money laundering.
paras.zh: 许多分析人士认为，这是部分民众突然意识到对博尔索纳罗重新掌权的“恐惧”的结果，同时也是一些争议的结果，其中包括这位参议员因涉嫌腐败和洗钱而在两项联邦警察调查中接受调查。

paras.en: Lula, by contrast, radically changed his digital strategy and benefited from student-led protests across the country, most of which did not even involve the president.
paras.zh: 相比之下，卢拉从根本上改变了他的数字战略，并从全国各地学生领导的抗议活动中受益，其中大部分甚至没有总统的参与。

paras.en: “In the first round, Lula’s campaign failed to connect with the population, but now it has been civil society movements that have driven his growth,” said the political scientist Helcimara de Souza Telles.
paras.zh: “在第一轮中，卢拉的竞选活动未能与民众建立联系，但现在推动他成长的是公民社会运动，”政治学家赫尔西马拉·德·苏萨·泰勒斯说。

paras.en: The final polls published on Saturday showed Bolsonaro still slightly ahead.
paras.zh: 周六公布的最终民意调查显示，博尔索纳罗仍略微领先。

paras.en: The result is expected late Sunday evening, and whatever the outcome, the race is expected to be decided by a narrow margin in Latin America’s largest country, with an electorate of 159 million.
paras.zh: 预计结果将于周日晚间公布，无论结果如何，预计在这个拥有 1.59 亿选民的拉丁美洲最大国家，这场竞选将以微弱优势决出胜负。

paras.en: Many analysts believe that if Lula overturns his first-round defeat, Bolsonaro could follow his father’s example from four years ago and refuse to concede, and that Donald Trump, a longstanding ally of the Bolsonaro clan, could refuse to recognise the result.
paras.zh: 许多分析人士认为，如果卢拉扭转首轮失利，博尔索纳罗可能会效仿他父亲四年前的榜样，拒绝认输，而博尔索纳罗家族的长期盟友唐纳德·特朗普也可能拒绝承认这一结果。

paras.en: “Trump wants to ‘colonise’ all of Latin America in pursuit of its own interests,” said Telles, adding that, with rightwing candidates having won all seven presidential elections held in Latin America since Trump began his second term, Brazil is one of the few countries in the region still offering any resistance to the US president.
paras.zh: 泰勒斯说：“特朗普希望‘殖民’整个拉丁美洲，以追求自身利益。”他补充说，自特朗普开始第二个任期以来，右翼候选人赢得了拉丁美洲举行的全部七次总统选举，巴西是该地区少数几个仍然对美国总统表示抵制的国家之一。

paras.en: “So a Bolsonaro victory would mean losing Brazil to a model of autocracy backed by the US,” she added.
paras.zh: “因此，博尔索纳罗的胜利将意味着巴西将输给美国支持的独裁模式，”她补充道。

articles.title: Portuguese police with dogs and batons dismantle housing protest camps
articles.author: Ashifa Kassam and agencies

paras.en: Police in Portugal have dismantled housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto, baton-charging campaigners in the early hours of Sunday and arresting more than 30 people.
paras.zh: 葡萄牙警方在周日凌晨拆除了里斯本和波尔图的住房抗议营地，向活动人士挥舞警棍，逮捕了 30 多人。

paras.en: The raids were the latest incident in days of clashes between police and campaigners who – inspired by similar camps in Spain – had sought to pitch tents in central squares to protest against the country’s deepening housing crisis.
paras.zh: 这次突击搜查是警察和活动人士几天来发生冲突的最新事件，他们受到西班牙类似营地的启发，试图在中心广场搭帐篷，以抗议该国日益严重的住房危机。

paras.en: Dozens of officers, some with dogs, moved shortly after 2am on Sunday to clear out the more than 100 tents that had sprung up in Lisbon’s Rossio Square. Police said they had also taken down a smaller camp of about 50 tents in Porto’s Dom João I Square.
paras.zh: 周日凌晨 2 点刚过，数十名警察（其中一些还带着狗）出动，清理了里斯本罗西奥广场上涌现的 100 多个帐篷。警方表示，他们还拆除了波尔图若昂一世广场上一个约有 50 个帐篷的小营地。

paras.en: The camp in the heart of Lisbon had been set up after thousands of people marched along one of the Portuguese capital’s main thoroughfares to rail against housing prices that have soared past average incomes in the country.
paras.zh: 数千人沿着葡萄牙首都的一条主干道游行，抗议房价飙升超过该国平均收入，之后在里斯本市中心设立了这个营地。

paras.en: Police described their actions on Sunday as proportionate and said they had earlier urged people to leave the camps of their own accord. The operations in the two cities led to the arrests of 31 people for disobedience and 171 structures were removed, police said on social media. Eleven people were injured, including three police officers.
paras.zh: 警方称他们周日的行动是适当的，并表示他们早些时候曾敦促人们自愿离开营地。警方在社交媒体上表示，这两个城市的行动导致 31 名不服从者被捕，171 座建筑被拆除。共有 11 人受伤，其中包括 3 名警察。

paras.en: Reuters reported that 25 people detained in Lisbon had been released with orders to appear in court on Monday.
paras.zh: 路透社报道称，在里斯本被拘留的 25 人已被释放，并被命令于周一出庭。

paras.en: The group Casa Para Viver (A Home to Live In) contested the police figures, saying the raids had left more than 20 people injured as police moved into the camps with batons, dogs and rubber bullets.
paras.zh: Casa Para Viver（居住之家）组织对警方的数据提出质疑，称警方携带警棍、警犬和橡皮子弹进入营地，突袭行动导致 20 多人受伤。

paras.en: “Choosing the early morning to deploy police dogs and fire rubber bullets at people who were sleeping or peacefully protesting is a political decision,” the group said in a statement as it called for further protests on Wednesday. “It shows that this government would rather crack down on those who speak out against the housing crisis than solve the crisis itself.”
paras.zh: 该组织在一份声明中表示：“选择清晨部署警犬并向正在睡觉或和平抗议的人们发射橡皮子弹是一项政治决定。”该组织呼吁周三举行进一步的抗议活动。 “这表明本届政府宁愿镇压那些公开反对住房危机的人，也不愿解决危机本身。”

paras.en: Fabian Figueiredo, an MP with the Left Bloc, described the police action as a “wound that had been inflicted” on the country’s democracy. “Fighting for a home is a right. So is peaceful protest. The constitution guarantees both,” he said on social media. “Let’s keep going – for the sake of our future.”
paras.zh: 左翼集团议员法比安·菲格雷多 (Fabian Figueiredo) 将警方的行动描述为对该国民主的“伤害”。 “为家园而战是一项权利。和平抗议也是一项权利。宪法保障这两者，”他在社交媒体上表示。 “为了我们的未来，让我们继续前进。”

paras.en: The housing protest camps in Portugal trace back to early October when campaigners began pitching tents in Porto, prompting police to clear them out. Similar actions soon began sprouting up in Lisbon, leading to dozens of arrests and reports of injuries as police repeatedly clashed with campaigners.
paras.zh: 葡萄牙的住房抗议营地可以追溯到十月初，当时活动人士开始在波尔图搭帐篷，促使警方将其清除。类似的行动很快在里斯本兴起，警方多次与活动人士发生冲突，导致数十人被捕，并有报道称有人受伤。

paras.en: As European cities grapple with a wave of discontent, much of the focus in Spain and Portugal has been on housing costs that have priced many local people out of the market.
paras.zh: 随着欧洲城市努力应对一波不满情绪，西班牙和葡萄牙的大部分焦点都集中在住房成本上，住房成本导致许多当地人被挤出市场。

paras.en: House prices in Portugal have more than doubled since 2017, while those seeking to rent have struggled with prices that have nearly doubled, fuelling one of Europe’s most acute home affordability crises.
paras.zh: 自 2017 年以来，葡萄牙的房价上涨了一倍多，而那些寻求租房的人却在几乎翻倍的价格中苦苦挣扎，加剧了欧洲最严重的住房负担能力危机之一。

paras.en: Residents have long told of bearing the brunt of a market that has surged as a result of liberalisation, the issuing of so-called golden visas, digital nomad schemes and the proliferation of short-term rentals.
paras.zh: 长期以来，居民们一直表示，由于自由化、所谓黄金签证的发放、数字游牧计划和短期租赁激增，市场激增，他们首当其冲。

paras.en: Campaigners have called on the centre-right government to scrap proposed legislation that would make evictions easier and end rent caps on new leases. The legislation recently passed a first parliamentary reading.
paras.zh: 活动人士呼吁中右翼政府废除拟议的立法，该立法将使驱逐变得更容易，并结束新租约的租金上限。该立法最近通过了议会一读。

paras.en: In Spain, the sprawling housing camp in the centre of Madrid marked its fourth week on Saturday, becoming one of the most tangible symbols of a widespread protest movement that has led to early general elections on 29 November.
paras.zh: 在西班牙，马德里市中心庞大的住房营地于周六进入第四周，成为广泛抗议运动最明显的象征之一，这场抗议运动导致了 11 月 29 日提前举行大选。

paras.en: With contributions from Reuters and Agence France-Presse
paras.zh: 路透社和法新社供稿

articles.title: Serbia votes as strongman Vučić faces grassroots challenge to 12-year rule – Europe live
articles.author: Jakub Krupa

paras.en: Aleksandar Vučić’s SNS anchors the “United Serbia” list. The party relies on control of the public purse, favourable media coverage and strong nationalist backing, but its campaign has been overshadowed by accusations of systemic voter manipulation.
paras.zh: 亚历山大·武契奇 (Aleksandar Vučić) 的 SNS 是“统一塞尔维亚”名单的主播。该党依靠对公共资金的控制、有利的媒体报道和强大的民族主义支持，但其竞选活动因系统性选民操纵的指控而蒙上阴影。

paras.en: The Student List eschews party hierarchies or a single figurehead, preferring locally respected academics and professionals, and operates through university networks. Its quickfire, humorous campaign has mobilised large numbers of disengaged voters.
paras.zh: 学生名单避开政党等级制度或单一领袖，更喜欢当地受人尊敬的学者和专业人士，并通过大学网络运作。其快速而幽默的竞选活动动员了大批心不在焉的选民。

paras.en: That means Serbia’s traditional opposition parties have been largely marginalised, with their collective support falling from 30% to 10-15%. Some parties have switched allegiance to the Student List. Others, such as European Serbia, may not clear the 3% electoral threshold.
paras.zh: 这意味着塞尔维亚传统反对党在很大程度上被边缘化，他们的集体支持率从30%下降到10-15%。一些政党已经转而效忠学生名单。其他国家，例如欧洲塞尔维亚，可能无法突破 3% 的选举门槛。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Serbia’s rightwing, nationalist bloc is riven with disagreements and has been further weakened by the unexpected withdrawal of the We the Power of the People party over allegations of Russian influence. Some of the nationalist vote may switch to the SNS.
paras.zh: 与此同时，塞尔维亚的右翼民族主义集团因分歧而四分五裂，并因“我们人民力量党”因俄罗斯影响力指控而意外退出而进一步受到削弱。一些民族主义者的投票可能会转向社交网络。

paras.en: Serbia’s former president and now prime ministerial candidate (again) Aleksandar Vučić rose to prominence in the 1990s as a radical nationalist, who supported the policies of Serbian expansion and ethnic cleansing led by Slobodan Milošević, who died of a heart attack in detention in The Hague during his trial on charges of genocide and crimes against humanity committed in Croatia, Bosnia and Kosovo.
paras.zh: 塞尔维亚前总统、现任总理候选人亚历山大·武契奇 (Aleksandar Vučić) 在 20 世纪 90 年代作为激进民族主义者而声名鹊起，他支持斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇 (Slobodan Milošević) 领导的塞尔维亚扩张和种族清洗政策。米洛舍维奇 (Slobodan Milošević) 在海牙被控在克罗地亚、波斯尼亚和科索沃犯下种族灭绝和反人类罪受审期间，在拘留期间因心脏病去世。

paras.en: He served as Milošević’s information minister throughout the Kosovo conflict. His Serbian Progressive Party, or SNS, has been in government since 2012.
paras.zh: 在整个科索沃冲突期间，他担任米洛舍维奇的新闻部长。他领导的塞尔维亚进步党（SNS）自 2012 年以来一直执政。

paras.en: He first spent three years as the prime minister from 2014, before switching to the role of the president in 2017. Unable to run for the third term, he resigned from the post in September, and now wants to lead the government again.
paras.zh: 他从 2014 年开始担任总理三年，然后于 2017 年转任总统。由于无法竞选第三个任期，他于 9 月辞去总理职务，现在希望再次领导政府。

paras.en: As president, Vučić has not emulated his predecessor’s militarism, but he has maintained his nationalist playbook in domestic politics, dismissing the opposition as stooges of unspecified foreign powers.
paras.zh: 作为总统，武契奇并没有效仿其前任的军国主义，但他在国内政治中保持了民族主义策略，将反对派视为未指明的外国势力的走狗。

paras.en: He maintains close ties with Putin’s Russia and Xi’s China, which regularly gets him criticism from the EU and complicates Serbia’s path to the bloc.
paras.zh: 他与普京领导下的俄罗斯和习近平领导下的中国保持着密切关系，这经常招致欧盟的批评，并使塞尔维亚加入欧盟的道路变得复杂化。

paras.en: Serbia has regressed in international rankings for press freedom and corruption in recent years, and its process of joining the EU is effectively stalled. More on that shortly.
paras.zh: 近年来，塞尔维亚在新闻自由和腐败方面的国际排名有所倒退，其加入欧盟的进程实际上陷入停滞。稍后会详细介绍。

paras.en: Vučić is also fairly close with Donald Trump and his associates. He hosted Donald TrumpJr and Jared Kushner in Belgrade, and, as we revealed, personally intervened to advance an allegedly illegal – and definitely very controversial – scheme to hand over a protected site in Belgrade for a Trump tower.
paras.zh: 武契奇与唐纳德·特朗普及其同僚关系也相当密切。他在贝尔格莱德接待了小唐纳德·特朗普和贾里德·库什纳，正如我们透露的那样，他亲自干预推进一项据称非法且绝对非常有争议的计划，将贝尔格莱德的一处受保护地点移交给特朗普大厦。

paras.en: Blog opening: Serbia's strongman Vučić faces sternest test of his 12-year rule
paras.zh: 博客开场：塞尔维亚强人武契奇12年统治面临最严峻考验

paras.en: Dobro veče, or good evening, and welcome to our live coverage of Serbian election night.
paras.zh: Dobro veče，晚上好，欢迎收看我们对塞尔维亚选举之夜的现场报道。

paras.en: The grassroots protest movement, the Student List, is taking on the country’s increasingly authoritarian leader, Aleksandar Vučić, in what is shaping up to be the sternest test of his 12-year grip on power.
paras.zh: 草根抗议运动“学生名单”正在与该国日益独裁的领导人亚历山大·武契奇展开较量，这将是对其 12 年权力掌控的最严峻考验。

paras.en: The vote is a culmination of two years of student-led protests triggered by the collapse of the Novi Sad railway station canopy in November 2024, which killed 16 people and uncovered massive government and institutional corruption.
paras.zh: 这次投票是由学生主导的两年抗议活动的高潮，抗议活动是由 2024 年 11 月诺维萨德火车站顶棚倒塌引发的，导致 16 人死亡，并揭露了大规模的政府和机构腐败。

paras.en: The bottom-up leaderless movement, with 250 candidates democratically elected from people with limited political experience but distinguished professional careers, seeks to end Vučić’s rule and rewire the state, with focus on fighting alleged corruption, clientelism and power abuses of the past.
paras.zh: 这个自下而上的无领导运动由政治经验有限但职业生涯杰出的人士民主选出的 250 名候选人组成，旨在结束武契奇的统治并重组国家，重点打击过去涉嫌的腐败、依附主义和滥用权力。

paras.en: Polls opened at 7am (6am UK time) and close at 8pm (7pm UK time). Until then, we’ll bring you all the key background, explain why it matters for Europe, Ukraine, and you, and give you a flavour of the chatter in the queues outside polling stations from Belgrade to London.
paras.zh: 投票于上午 7 点（英国时间上午 6 点）开始，晚上 8 点（英国时间晚上 7 点）结束。在那之前，我们将为您介绍所有关键背景，解释为什么它对欧洲、乌克兰和您都很重要，并让您了解从贝尔格莱德到伦敦的投票站外排队的聊天内容。

paras.en: I will also keep one eye on the first round of the presidential election in Bulgaria, so expect an odd update on this or two on this.
paras.zh: 我还将密切关注保加利亚第一轮总统选举，因此预计会出现一两个奇怪的更新。

paras.en: It’s Sunday, 25 October 2026, it’s Jakub Krupa here, and this is Europe Live.
paras.zh: 今天是 2026 年 10 月 25 日，星期日，我是 Jakub Krupa，这里是 Europe Live。

articles.title: Suspect in deadly Paris suburb shooting sent for psychiatric observation

paras.en: A man suspected of a deadly gun attack near Paris has left custody and been placed under psychiatric observation, French anti-terrorism officials have said.
paras.zh: 法国反恐官员表示，一名涉嫌在巴黎附近发生致命枪击事件的男子已被释放，并接受精神观察。

paras.en: One person was killed and five others injured on Friday when an attacker opened fire from his car - first in Trappes, and then in nearby La VerriÃ¨re - appearing to target people of migrant origin.
paras.zh: 周五，一名袭击者从他的汽车中开枪——首先在特拉普，然后在附近的拉维里尔——似乎针对的是移民出身的人，造成一人死亡，五人受伤。

paras.en: The suspect, named in French media as 39-year-old Kevin T, will be observed to evaluate whether his "psychiatric health is compatible with pursuing his interrogation", the National Anti-Terrorist Prosecutor's Office (PNAT) said.
paras.zh: 法国媒体称这名嫌疑人为 39 岁的凯文·T，法国国家反恐检察官办公室 (PNAT) 表示，将对他进行观察，以评估他的“精神健康状况是否适合对其进行审讯”。

paras.en: President Emmanuel Macron called it a "racist terrorist attack", adding that people had been targeted over their skin colour or religion.
paras.zh: 总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙称这是一次“种族主义恐怖袭击”，并补充说人们因肤色或宗教而成为攻击目标。

paras.en: It marked a "turning point in the life of our Republic and our nation", the French president said.
paras.zh: 法国总统说，这标志着“我们共和国和我们国家生活的转折点”。

paras.en: PNAT said the move to place the suspect under psychiatric evaluation followed guidance from a psychiatric expert.
paras.zh: PNAT 表示，对嫌疑人进行精神病学评估的举动是在精神病学专家的指导下进行的。

paras.en: The evaluation will determine whether the suspect should remain in police custody and is "likely to last 48 hours", PNAT added.
paras.zh: PNAT 补充说，评估将决定嫌疑人是否应继续被警方拘留，并且“可能会持续 48 小时”。

paras.en: PNAT said the suspect was also found to have cannabis and cocaine in his bloodstream.
paras.zh: PNAT 表示，嫌疑人的血液中还发现了大麻和可卡因。

paras.en: French newspaper Le Monde, external and news agency AFP report that a Bible, a Quran and a copy of Adolf Hitler's Mein Kampf were found at the suspect's home, citing a source close to the investigation.
paras.zh: 法国《世界报》、外部媒体和法新社援引一位接近调查的消息人士的话报道称，在嫌疑人家中发现了一本《圣经》、一本《古兰经》和一本阿道夫·希特勒的《我的奋斗》。

paras.en: The lawyer for Pengo Bossio Wangi, the one person killed during the attack, told French media the move to place the suspect under observation was "very rare".
paras.zh: 袭击中身亡的彭戈·博西奥·万吉(Pengo Bossio Wangi)的律师告诉法国媒体，对嫌疑人进行观察的举动“非常罕见”。

paras.en: He alleged that it was being used to portray the suspect as criminally irresponsible rather than having acted deliberately.
paras.zh: 他声称，这是用来将嫌疑人描绘成不负责任的刑事犯罪者，而不是故意行为。

paras.en: Wangi, a 26-year-old French-Congolese martial artist, was named as the one fatality on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六，一名 26 岁的法裔刚果武术家旺吉 (Wangi) 被确认为死者。

paras.en: The mixed martial arts club where he trained paid tribute to him, saying: "On the mats as off them, he was one of those who lead by example: present, respectful, always ready to lift others up.
paras.zh: 他接受训练的综合武术俱乐部向他致敬，并表示：“无论在垫子上还是在垫子上，他都是以身作则的人之一：在场、尊重他人、时刻准备好激励他人。

paras.en: "His smile, his energy and his generosity will remain etched in our walls and in our hearts."
paras.zh: “他的微笑、他的活力和他的慷慨将铭刻在我们的墙壁和心中。”

paras.en: Three of those injured in the attack were taken to hospital in a serious condition - including a 12-year-old girl who remains in a critical condition.
paras.zh: 袭击中的三名伤者被送往医院，伤势严重，其中包括一名 12 岁女孩，目前情况危急。

paras.en: The mayor of La VerriÃ¨re, Nicolas Dainville, told French radio network France Info on Sunday that he had spoken to the girl's mother over the phone and confirmed she was "doing better".
paras.zh: 拉维里尔市市长尼古拉斯·丹维尔周日告诉法国广播网“法国信息”，他已通过电话与女孩的母亲交谈，并确认她“情况有所好转”。

paras.en: Another injured resident was recovering while a third remained in a critical condition, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，另一名受伤的居民正在康复，三​​分之一的人情况危急。

paras.en: The suspect had been known to police prior to the attack but not to France's intelligence services, local media report. PNAT previously said he had four previous convictions that had been "automatically expunged".
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，警方在袭击发生前就已认识嫌疑人，但法国情报部门并不认识。 PNAT 此前表示，他之前有四次定罪，但已“自动删除”。

paras.en: He is thought to have used an old semi-automatic weapon during the attack, firing in bursts from his car window.
paras.zh: 据信他在袭击过程中使用了一把旧的半自动武器，从车窗连发射击。

articles.title: Early reports suggest record high turnout in Serbia elections

paras.en: Early reports suggest Serbian voters have turned out in large numbers for its parliamentary election, as a student protest movement attempts to end the rule of the country's right-wing populist leader.
paras.zh: 早期报道显示，塞尔维亚选民大批参加议会选举，学生抗议运动试图结束该国右翼民粹主义领导人的统治。

paras.en: Preliminary reports suggest a record high turnout, with 46% having cast their vote by 14:00 local time (13:00 GMT), nearly a million more than the comparable figure for the previous election in December 2023.
paras.zh: 初步报告显示，投票率创历史新高，46% 的人在当地时间 14:00（格林威治标准时间 13:00）之前投票，比 2023 年 12 月上一次选举的可比数字高出近 100 万。

paras.en: The apparent high turnout is fuelling the hopes of opposition party Student List that they can oust Aleksandar VuÄiÄ and his Serbian Progressive Party (SNS), who have been in power since 2012.
paras.zh: 明显的高投票率激发了反对党“学生名单”的希望，他们希望能够推翻自 2012 年以来一直执政的亚历山大·武埃 (Aleksandar Vu?i?) 和他领导的塞尔维亚进步党 (SNS)。

paras.en: The snap elections called by VuÄiÄ follow two years of student protests triggered by the 2024 collapse of a train station canopy, which killed 16 and was seen as emblematic of corruption and negligence in Serbia.
paras.zh: 2024 年火车站顶篷倒塌事件引发了两年的学生抗议活动，导致 16 人死亡，这被视为塞尔维亚腐败和玩忽职守的象征。

paras.en: Anti-corruption movement Student List are running on a manifesto including purging officials who broke rules cracking down on protesters, stopping party loyalists heading public enterprises, and freeing the public broadcaster of political control.
paras.zh: 反腐败运动“学生名单”正在发表一份宣言，其中包括清洗违反镇压抗议者规定的官员、阻止党派忠诚者领导公共企业以及将公共广播公司从政治控制中解放出来。

paras.en: VuÄiÄ and the SNS party deny corruption and seeking to influence the media.
paras.zh: Vu?i? 和 SNS 党否认腐败并试图影响媒体。

paras.en: Most commentators suggest that a high final turnout, 65% or above, would favour the students.
paras.zh: 大多数评论员认为，65% 或以上的高最终投票率对学生有利。

paras.en: Voting ends at 20:00, with first indications of results expected two hours later.
paras.zh: 投票于 20:00 结束，预计两小时后将公布初步结果。

paras.en: Long queues formed outside polling stations in larger cities and smaller towns alike in Serbia, and at polling stations abroad - including Slovenia's capital Ljubljana, Munich, Los Angeles and Chicago. In Paris, Serbian voters waited in line in heavy rain.
paras.zh: 塞尔维亚大城市和小城镇的投票站外以及斯洛文尼亚首都卢布尔雅那、慕尼黑、洛杉矶和芝加哥等国外投票站外都排起了长队。在巴黎，塞尔维亚选民在大雨中排队等候。

paras.en: Tensions are high across Serbia. In Belgrade, police have closed streets around the Republic Electoral Commission (RIK).
paras.zh: 塞尔维亚各地局势紧张。在贝尔格莱德，警方关闭了共和国选举委员会（RIK）周围的街道。

paras.en: In the street nearby, cars at the traffic lights lowered their windows to blast one of the students' anthems from loudspeakers, 'I want three kisses' - a folk song favoured because the Students' List is number three on the ballot paper. Young people on the pavement nearby started dancing.
paras.zh: 在附近的街道上，红绿灯处的汽车降下车窗，从扬声器中播放学生的国歌“我想要三个吻”——这是一首民歌，因为学生名单在选票上排名第三而受到青睐。附近人行道上的年轻人开始跳舞。

paras.en: VuÄiÄ and his SNS party are number one on the ballot paper. He has spent two terms as president and cannot seek a third term, so he is now leading his party with the aim of returning to the post of prime minister, which he left in 2017.
paras.zh: Vu?i? 和他的 SNS 政党在选票上名列第一。他已经担任了两届总统，无法寻求第三届任期，因此他现在领导他的政党，目标是重返2017年辞去的总理职务。

paras.en: He retains strong support among a significant section of Serbia's population. They view him as a strong leader who stands up for the country's interests. He can also point to significant economic growth over the past decade and numerous improvements in infrastructure.
paras.zh: 他在塞尔维亚大部分人口中保持着强有力的支持。他们认为他是一位维护国家利益的强有力的领导人。他还可以指出过去十年经济的显着增长和基础设施的大量改进。

paras.en: VuÄiÄ, who backs Serbia's candidacy for the European Union while refusing to impose sanctions on Russia over its war in Ukraine, has pledged higher pensions and public sector salaries, and investment in state healthcare.
paras.zh: 维埃支持塞尔维亚加入欧盟，同时拒绝因俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争而对俄罗斯实施制裁，他承诺提高养老金和公共部门工资，并对国家医疗保健进行投资。

paras.en: SNS posters plastered around cities show two hands clasped together in solidarity: the hands of doctors and nurses, farmers, construction workers, teachers and parents.
paras.zh: 城市各处张贴的社交网络海报显示了两只团结在一起的双手：医生和护士、农民、建筑工人、教师和家长的手。

paras.en: "These are the hands that hold Serbia in their palms," says VuÄiÄ in his campaign video. "And with these hands, calmly and with dignity, we shall finish what we started."
paras.zh: “这些手将塞尔维亚握在手中，”武艾在他的竞选视频中说道。 “用这双手，平静而有尊严地，我们将完成我们开始的事情。”

paras.en: That is question of this election, continuity or change.
paras.zh: 这就是这次选举的问题，是延续还是改变。

paras.en: Amid fears of electoral fraud by the SNS, the students have delegated at least two observers to each of Serbia's 8,210 voting stations.
paras.zh: 由于担心 SNS 进行选举舞弊，学生们已向塞尔维亚 8,210 个投票站各派出至少两名观察员。

paras.en: Videos circulating on social media on Sunday morning show a cafe in the southern city of Nis, where ballot papers were allegedly filled out in advance in a practice known as 'chain voting'. Signs in the window read "private party". When they realise that they are being filmed, the papers are quickly hidden.
paras.zh: 周日上午在社交媒体上流传的视频显示，南部城市尼什的一家咖啡馆据称提前填写了选票，这种做法被称为“连锁投票”。窗户上的标牌上写着“私人聚会”。当他们意识到自己正在被拍摄时，文件很快就被藏了起来。

paras.en: There have also been reports of attacks on election monitors and journalists at several polling stations.
paras.zh: 还有报道称，几个投票站的选举监督员和记者遭到袭击。

paras.en: "We are witnessing a unique experiment in European contemporary history," Å½arko KoraÄ, a former deputy prime minister and long-term opponent of nationalist parties in Serbia including the SNS, told the BBC.
paras.zh: “我们正在见证欧洲当代历史上的一次独特实验，”塞尔维亚前副总理、塞尔维亚民族主义政党（包括 SNS）的长期反对者奥阿尔科·科拉（Ålarko Kora）告诉英国广播公司（BBC）。

paras.en: Instead of running for office themselves, student-led assemblies at the country's university faculties have chosen 250 candidates to stand in the parliamentary election, with Ilija SrdanoviÄ, professor at Novi Sad University, heading the list.
paras.zh: 该国大学院系的学生主导的议会没有自己竞选公职，而是选出了 250 名候选人参加议会选举，诺维萨德大学教授伊利亚·斯丹诺维 (Ilija Srdanovią) 名列榜首。

paras.en: The Student List of candidates for parliament also includes doctors, actors, academics and sports personalities
paras.zh: 议会候选人的学生名单还包括医生、演员、学者和体育名人

paras.en: "These are people that don't know each other, you have no idea what their political beliefs are, and we now expect them to create a functioning government. So it's anybody's guess what happens after they win," KoraÄ says.
paras.zh: “这些人彼此不认识，你不知道他们的政治信仰是什么，我们现在期望他们建立一个正常运作的政府。所以任何人都可以猜测他们获胜后会发生什么，”科拉说。

paras.en: "On the other hand, if VuÄiÄ declares victory this evening, probably late in the evening, I don't think the students will accept that."
paras.zh: “另一方面，如果 Vuäiä 今晚宣布胜利，可能是在深夜，我认为学生们不会接受这一点。”

paras.en: KoraÄ suggests that many former VuÄiÄ loyalists in high office could change sides at the last moment, if the students win. A close result, however, with both sides claiming victory, could result in weeks or months of political instability.
paras.zh: 科拉表示，如果学生获胜，许多身居高位的前 Vuii 忠诚者可能会在最后一刻改变立场。然而，双方都声称获胜的势均力敌的结果可能会导致数周或数月的政治不稳定。

paras.en: The electorate is 6.45 million in a population of 6.53 million, raising concerns about the reliability of the electoral register. Serbs from Kosovo, and dual Serbian citizens from neighbouring Bosnia also have the right to vote.
paras.zh: 653万人口中有645万选民，这引发了人们对选举登记册可靠性的担忧。来自科索沃的塞族人和来自邻国波斯尼亚的塞尔维亚双重公民也有投票权。

paras.en: Katarina, 29, told the BBC she had travelled from the Netherlands back home to Serbia to vote for Student List, even though she could have cast her ballot remotely.
paras.zh: 29 岁的卡塔琳娜 (Katarina) 告诉 BBC，她从荷兰回到塞尔维亚，为学生名单投票，尽管她本可以远程投票。

paras.en: "I wanted to be a part of this, and I wanted to be part of a movement," she told the BBC outside a polling station in the capital's Zvezdara district.
paras.zh: “我想成为其中的一部分，我想成为一场运动的一部分，”她在首都兹韦兹达拉区的一个投票站外告诉英国广播公司。

paras.en: "I think they have a chance of winning," she said, but expressed doubt about whether such a result would be respected by VuÄiÄ.
paras.zh: “我认为他们有机会获胜，”她说，但对 Vuii 是否会尊重这样的结果表示怀疑。

paras.en: Asked whether the party's selection of candidates from different walks of life might hinder its ability to govern, she responded: "Just because they're politically inexperienced, they are experts in their own fields, which we have not seen thus far."
paras.zh: 当被问及该党选择来自各行各业的候选人是否会妨碍其执政能力时，她回答说：“只是因为他们政治经验不足，他们在自己的领域都是专家，这是我们迄今为止还没有看到的。”

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?

The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.

Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.

It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
- Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.

- Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
- Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.

It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?

The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants

Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil

Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.

High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.

Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities

Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions

In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.

Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery

Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
- Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
- Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
- Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.

To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.

We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.

MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. articles.title: SEMA Industry Honors to Recognize 2026 Hall of Fame Class
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The automotive and powersports aftermarket will recognize its innovators, leaders and visionaries during the 2026 SEMA Industry Honors on Thursday, Nov. 5 at the BleauLive Theater inside the Fontainebleau Las Vegas.

Held during the 2026 SEMA Show, SEMA Industry Honors is the industry’s annual celebration of the people whose creativity, leadership and passion continue to move the automotive and powersports aftermarket forward. The evening will recognize the SEMA Hall of Fame Class of 2026, SEMA Content Creator of the Year, SEMA Person of the Year and the recipient of the Robert E. Petersen Lifetime Achievement Award.

“SEMA Industry Honors brings our community together around the people, ideas and achievements that are shaping the future of the aftermarket,” said Tom Gattuso, vice president of events for SEMA. “By celebrating industry legends alongside today’s most influential leaders and storytellers, the event connects the aftermarket’s proud history with its next chapter. It is an opportunity for everyone at the SEMA Show to recognize excellence, strengthen relationships and be inspired by the individuals moving our industry forward.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The program will be emceed by Kevin Oeste, who will guide attendees through an evening of recognition, personal stories and celebration. Members of the SEMA community and other familiar faces from the automotive world will also take the stage to help honor this year’s award recipients.
Celebrating the Industry’s Highest Achievements

The SEMA Hall of Fame is the association’s highest honor, recognizing individuals whose careers and contributions have helped shape and advance the automotive specialty equipment industry. The 2026 SEMA Hall of Fame class includes Doug Dwyer, Jay Leno, Ellen McKoy and Dennis Overholser.
Members of SEMA’s Councils & Networks will participate in the Hall of Fame presentations, helping recognize the inductees’ contributions and lasting impact on the industry.
SEMA Industry Honors will also recognize outstanding achievements in leadership, automotive storytelling and lifetime contributions to the specialty automotive industry.
The SEMA Person of the Year award honors an individual whose leadership, service and contributions have significantly strengthened the industry and the SEMA community.

The SEMA Content Creator of the Year award recognizes an individual who uses compelling and innovative content to expand the reach of the automotive lifestyle, engages new audiences and inspires greater participation in the industry.

Presented by the Petersen Automotive Museum, the Robert E. Petersen Lifetime Achievement Award honors individuals whose careers and contributions have made a lasting impact on motorsports, particularly drag racing. Named for the museum’s late founder, Robert E. Petersen, the award is considered one of the specialty automotive industry’s highest honors.

“Guests can expect a high-energy evening that blends meaningful recognition with the camaraderie that makes the SEMA Show so special,” said Andy Tompkins, trade show director for SEMA. “From connecting with colleagues during the reception to hearing the stories behind this year’s honorees, attendees will experience an entertaining and inspiring celebration of the people who make the automotive aftermarket extraordinary.”
The evening begins at 6 p.m. with a cocktail reception, followed by the Industry Honors awards program at 7:30 p.m. (Reception will include heavy appetizers; dinner will not be served.)

SEMA Show exhibitors receive two tickets to SEMA Industry Honors and may purchase additional tickets for $50 each through Registration Customer Service. Show attendees may purchase tickets for $50 each when registering for the SEMA Show, or by logging into the Registration Resource Center.

Each ticket includes admission to the cocktail reception and awards ceremony, hors d’oeuvres and an open bar. Space is limited, and exhibitors and attendees are encouraged to secure their tickets early. For more information or to purchase tickets, visit semashow.com/industry-honors.

Spaces are still available for companies interested in exhibiting and connecting with tens of thousands of qualified buyers. For more information, visit semashow.com/exhibitor.
The 2026 SEMA Show opens on Election Day, Nov. 3. SEMA’s Drive the Vote campaign encourages attendees to make a plan to vote before traveling to Las Vegas. Visit sema.org/vote for more information.

articles.title: CCC Intelligent Solutions Adds Azimuth to Diagnostics Network
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) has announced an integration with Azimuth Claims Solutions, bringing Azimuth’s ADAS calibration identification and labor time capabilities to the CCC ONE platform.

The integration connects Azimuth’s ADAS calibration recommendations to CCC ONE, enabling repair facilities to view recommendations within their existing workflow. Azimuth combines OEM procedures, vehicle build data and real-world time studies to help identify required OEM calibration operations and associated labor times.

Repairers will be able to add Azimuth recommendations to the estimate to help reduce manual steps and support more efficient, consistent repair planning. As advanced driver-assistance systems become more common, identifying calibration requirements has become a more complex and critical part of the collision repair process.
Integrating Azimuth with CCC ONE gives repairers access to actionable calibration information earlier in the repair process without requiring them to move between separate systems.

“ADAS technology continues to add complexity to the repair process, making it increasingly important for repairers to have the right information available at the right time,” said Dan Risley, vice president, market solutions, automotive services group at CCC Intelligent Solutions. “By integrating Azimuth with CCC ONE, we’re giving repairers another way to access actionable calibration recommendations within their existing workflow, helping them make informed decisions and keep repairs moving.”

Azimuth’s platform is designed to bring greater transparency and consistency to ADAS calibration planning by identifying required OEM procedures and labor associated with the vehicle and repair. The company’s technology helps insurers and collision repairers navigate increasingly complex calibration requirements as vehicle systems continue to evolve.

“ADAS calibration has become one of the most critical and least standardized components of modern collision repair,” said Charles Rich, CEO of Azimuth Claims Solutions. “With sensors, cameras and software-driven systems now involved in nearly every repair, the industry needs clearer, more consistent guidance to determine what procedures are required. By bringing Azimuth’s calibration identification engine and labor time intelligence into the CCC ONE platform, CCC is helping deliver the level of transparency, consistency and workflow support that repairers and insurers expect from a modern, data-driven ecosystem. This collaboration enables a more informed, unified view of ADAS requirements tied directly to the repair plan, supporting better outcomes as vehicles continue their evolution into software-defined platforms.”

articles.title: Federal bill aims to reform permitting, would reportedly expedite building and manufacturing
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: A recent bill introduced in the U.S. Senate promises cheaper energy, more jobs, and responsible growth nationwide, according to the bill sponsors.

U.S. Sens. Shelley Moore Capito (R-WV), Mike Lee (R-UT), Sheldon Whitehouse (D-RI), and Martin Heinrich (D-NM) introduced the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA) on Sept. 30.

The sponsors say the BAAJA provides certainty that permitted energy and infrastructure projects will retain their permits, except under extraordinary circumstances, violations of law, a court order, or targeted reforms for energy projects.
The bill would expedite project approvals by amending the National Environmental Policy Act, Clean Water Act, Endangered Species Act, and National Historic Preservation Act.

“For far too long, our broken and outdated federal environmental review and permitting processes have stood in the way of energy reliability, secure jobs, modern infrastructure, and economic growth,” said Capito in a press release about the bill. “The bipartisan reforms we secured in this deal will transform our nation’s ability to power our economy and fuel future growth, while continuing to protect the land, water, and wildlife we all cherish.”
Lee added that permitting often delays building infrastructure.

“[W]hat too often stands in the way is a permitting system that takes too long and costs too much,” he said. “After years of work in Congress and many months of negotiations, I’m proud we’ve reached a bipartisan agreement to fix this broken process and get America back to building.”

John Bozzella, president and CEO of the Alliance for Automotive Innovation (Auto Innovators), made a similar argument in support of the bill as it relates to the automotive industry, backing the bill sponsors’ plan to increase domestic production of critical manufacturing elements.

“The auto industry in America supports our economic and national security,” Bozzella wrote in a statement of support for the bill. “For the auto sector to remain competitive in today’s global marketplace, it’s essential to have reliable access to energy and the critical minerals that power our advanced vehicles.

“Sens. Capito, Whitehouse, Lee and Heinrich understand this dynamic and have a plan to make American permitting more predictable by increasing domestic production of elements that are critical to the country’s largest manufacturing sector. We know that when those supply chains are disrupted, it can ripple across the country’s industrial base.”
He added that the bill is key to increasing advanced manufacturing, economic growth, jobs, and protecting the country’s defense base.

The Automotive National and Economic Security Act of 2026 was introduced in the U.S. House in August to study the national and economic security risks foreign adversaries, such as China, pose to the U.S. automotive industry, according to a press release from bill sponsor Rep. Diana Harshbarger’s (R-TN). She co-sponsors the bill with Rep. Debbie Dingell (D-MI).
- “Foreign ownership of, and state-directed investment in, U.S. automakers by foreign military organizations, political parties, and state-owned enterprises.
- “Joint ventures, subsidiaries, and commercial partnerships between U.S. manufacturers and foreign adversaries.
- “Transfers of critical and emerging technologies to foreign adversaries.
- “Impacts on U.S. national security, economic competitiveness, and intellectual property protection.”
The Bipartisan Policy Center published an explainer of the 411-page BAAJA, drilling down to how each environmental and energy act listed above would change if the bill passes.

The National Environmental Policy Act’s procedural provisions would be rewritten “along three lines: scope of review (what agencies must analyze), which projects get reviewed at all, and how long the process takes,” according to the explainer.

The Bipartisan Policy Center adds in its explainer that the BAAJA would amend the Clean Water Act to reduce friction caused by some of the provisions on linear infrastructure and industrial facilities permitting while still protecting waters.
The explainer states the BAAJA would tighten consultation and approval timelines under the Endangered Species Act “without changing the jeopardy standard or the criteria for listing a species.”
BAAJA would “write a narrower definition” into Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act. Section 106 deals with funding and permit issuance for projects that affect historic properties.
“The result is that the federal approval, not the entire project footprint, would set the boundaries of review,” the explainer states.

The Bipartisan Policy Center covers several other aspects of the proposed amendments, including power sector emissions, electricity costs, grid data access, ratepayer protection from data centers, and more.
According to Whitehouse, if the BAAJA passes, the U.S. power grid will be flooded with clean, affordable energy.

“America is entering a new era of energy demand,” he said in the release. “We have an enormous opportunity to build big things again to meet that moment — to build more generation, expand our grid, create more jobs, lower energy costs, and make sure we have the energy we need to compete. It should not take decades to build the infrastructure our country needs.”
Featured image credit: halbergman/iStock

articles.title: IIHS pedestrian, vehicle-to-vehicle tests show struggling cargo vans and pickups
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: New commercial vehicle safety ratings from the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) show that cargo vans and heavy-duty pickups lag behind passenger vehicles in front crash prevention.

While IIHS says marginal and poor ratings are common among the first commercial vehicles put through vehicle-to-vehicle and pedestrian crash avoidance tests, at least one performs well in each test, “showing that meeting the challenge is not out of reach for manufacturers.”

“These results are a wake-up call for commercial vehicle makers,” said IIHS President David Harkey in a press release. “Front crash prevention is especially important for these larger, heavier vans and trucks because of the danger they pose to other road users.”
Cargo vans scored the highest in both tests. The Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2500 earned a good rating for vehicle-to-vehicle front crash prevention.
The Chevrolet BrightDrop 400 and Rivian RCV-Delivery 500 earned good ratings for pedestrian crash avoidance.
IIHS launched its commercial vehicle assessment program in June, including driver protection information.

“That part of the assessment checks for essential features such as standard front and side airbags, advanced seatbelt technology, and effective seatbelt reminders,” the IIHS press release states. “Many government standards for passenger vehicles, including airbag requirements, don’t apply to delivery vans, box trucks, tractor-trailers, and larger work pickups.

“Unlike the driver protection evaluation, the vehicle-to-vehicle front crash prevention and pedestrian front crash prevention evaluations use the Institute’s scale of good, acceptable, marginal, or poor. The test protocols and rating requirements are the same as those used for passenger vehicles.”

IIHS notes that 6,215 people were killed in crashes involving heavy- or medium-duty vehicles or light vans in 2024, accounting for 16% of all roadway fatalities in the U.S. It adds that reducing that toll is a key part of the Institute’s 30×30 vision of reducing fatalities 30% by 2030.

The initial evaluations focus on cargo vans and Class 3 pickup trucks. Class 3 pickups have a gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) of 10,001 to 14,000 pounds. GVWR is the maximum weight a vehicle can safely carry, including passengers, cargo, and the vehicle’s weight.

IIHS will continue to evaluate Class 3 vehicles this year and next, adding ratings for headlights and rear automatic emergency braking (AEB), according to the release. The Institute plans to phase in trucks in classes four through six later.

The Chevrolet Express 2500 and the GMC Savana 2500 cargo vans earn poor ratings in the vehicle-to-vehicle and pedestrian tests because they lack AEB. IIHS says AEB is an optional feature only available on vehicles with a forward collision warning system.

Performance varied widely among the other vans and pickup trucks in the vehicle-to-vehicle test. The test evaluates forward collision warning and AEB at different speeds with a passenger car target and a motorcycle target. It also evaluates forward collision warning with a semitrailer.
The Sprinter 2500 earned a good rating, the BrightDrop 400 an acceptable rating, and the others marginal or poor.
IIHS found that the motorcycle target was the biggest challenge. In most motorcycle trials, several of the systems failed to issue warnings or slow down at all.

At most speeds, others successfully slowed to avoid or mitigate collisions with the motorcycle and passenger car targets, but were downgraded because they didn’t provide timely warnings to the driver.
Overall, the vehicles performed better in the pedestrian evaluation than in the vehicle-to-vehicle test, IIHS said.
The pedestrian test represents common daytime and nighttime crashes involving an adult or child crossing the road or an adult walking in the travel lane.

Among cargo vans, the BrightDrop 400 and RCV-Delivery 500 earned good ratings, and the Sprinter 2500 earned an acceptable rating. Among Class 3 pickups, the F-350 and Ram 3500 earned acceptable ratings.
Several vehicles, including the F-350 and Ram 3500, had a harder time detecting and avoiding the child pedestrian dummy in daylight conditions than the adult at night.

“The problem may be related to the shorter height of the child dummy and the tall front ends of the vehicles,” the release states. “That’s because the sensors used for detection are positioned near the rearview mirror. In some instances, the child dummy was detected at a distance but then ‘disappeared’ as the vehicle got closer.”

The poor and marginal systems also failed to slow down enough in most of the nighttime trials with the adult. Those trials are done with low-beam headlights and then again with high beams. Others performed worse at the slowest test speed.

articles.title: Two Democrats vie for insurance commissioner position in California
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: California will elect its next insurance commissioner on Nov. 3, as incumbent Ricardo Lara is term-limited.
The insurance commissioner seat is elected for four years and is limited to serving two terms.
Sens. Ben Allen and Jane Kim, a consumer advocate and an attorney, will be on this year’s midterm ballot. Both are Democrats.
Allen has served in the state’s legislature since 2014, according to his campaign website. He lists climate and environmental policies as a focus during his tenure.
The website also lists work on strengthening transparency, including expanding ballot access and championing the DISCLOSE Act.
“He has consistently scored tops in the legislature in the California Clean Money Campaign’s reports for his commitment to transparency and political reform,” the website states.
Allen’s plan focuses on strengthening the state’s insurance market as wildfires and climate disasters intensify.

“My plan will restore a competitive insurance market, ensure Californians are treated fairly after disasters, and build resilient communities that can withstand the climate challenges ahead,” he states on his website.
Fighting insurers that “deny and delay” and post-disaster insurer compliance are other planned action items, Allen’s site claims.
This would include higher upfront payments for coverage requiring insurers to clearly explain claim denials and maintain post-disaster real-time reporting on delays and outstanding claims.
modernize customer service and filings infrastructure, improve consumer communication, and provide data transparency.

Kim previously served on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, as California political director for Bernie Sanders, and as California director for the Working Families Party, according to her campaign website.
Her priorities focus on “affordable, available insurance for all,” the website states. She proposes a single-payer disaster insurance policy for state residents.
The website also says she’ll ensure premiums cover claims, or lower them.

“Insurance companies should spend premium dollars on their intended purpose: protecting policyholders,” the website states. “If companies collect more than they need to cover claims and a reasonable profit, that money should go back to policyholders or be invested in statewide resilience, not huge payouts at our expense — like the $27 million salary one insurance company CEO was paid last year.”
Her site states that a long-term goal is to build a public auto insurance option to compete in the market.
She also notes that she’s focused on “fast and fair claims.” This includes freezing rates when a claim is filed, penalizing delays to speed up payments, and immediate payouts.

Under Kim, insurance companies would be held accountable through market conduct examinations and elevated complaint rates, according to the website. She also proposes an insurance performance dashboard that consumers can use to assess insurer risks before choosing a policy.

Oklahoma, California, and Georgia are the states where policyholders are most likely to feel influenced by a new insurance commissioner on their home insurance premiums, according to an Insurify analysis.
California saw a 5% homeowners insurance increase last year, the analysis found. It also found home insurance rates have increased 22% since 2023.

articles.title: NC Collision Shop Brings ADAS Calibration In-House
articles.author: Eric Garbe

paras.en: See how Vann York Collision Center in High Point, NC, is using Autel technology to bring ADAS calibration in-house, streamline collision repair workflows, and reduce reliance on outsourced services.

ASE-Certified Master Automobile Technician Eric visits Vann York to talk with the team about their transition to Autel diagnostic, ADAS calibration and wheel alignment equipment. After working with other scan and calibration tools, the team shares how Autel has helped simplify setup, improve usability and bring alignment and ADAS calibration together in a more efficient workflow.

With guided software, integrated alignment and calibration capabilities, training and technical support, Vann York is building more control into the repair process—and planning to expand its use of Autel equipment as the business grows.
